# tokovpn/tokovpnbot/server.js
const TelegramBot = require('node-telegram-bot-api');
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");
const axios = require('axios');
const qs = require('qs');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const express = require('express');
const { QRISGenerator } = require('autoft-qris');
const schedule = require('node-schedule');
const mysql = require('mysql2/promise');

// ============================
// DATABASE CONFIGURATION
// ============================
const DB_CONFIG = {
    host: 'localhost',
    user: 'root',
    password: '@Toko24VPN',
    database: 'ppob',
    waitForConnections: true,
    connectionLimit: 10,
    queueLimit: 0
};

let pool;

async function initDatabase() {
    try {
        pool = mysql.createPool(DB_CONFIG);

        // Test connection
        const connection = await pool.getConnection();
        logAction('Database MySQL berhasil terhubung.');

        // 1. Tabel Users (id dan chatId diubah ke BIGINT)
        await connection.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
                id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
                chatId BIGINT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                username VARCHAR(255),
                name VARCHAR(255),
                saldo DECIMAL(15,2) DEFAULT 0,
                lastMessageId INT,
                isMonitoringQris BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        `);

        // 2. Tabel Transactions (userId diubah ke BIGINT)
        await connection.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions (
                id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                userId BIGINT NOT NULL,
                trxId VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                time BIGINT NOT NULL,
                productName VARCHAR(500),
                productCode VARCHAR(100),
                phoneNumber VARCHAR(50),
                price DECIMAL(15,2),
                method VARCHAR(50),
                status VARCHAR(100),
                apiMessage TEXT,
                sn TEXT,
                uniqueAmount DECIMAL(15,2),
                is_refunded BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                INDEX idx_userId (userId),
                INDEX idx_trxId (trxId),
                INDEX idx_status (status)
            )
        `);

        // AUTO MIGRATION: Pastikan semua kolom penting ada
        try {
            // Kolom di tabel Users
            const [userCols] = await connection.query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM users LIKE 'isMonitoringQris'");
            if (userCols.length === 0) {
                await connection.query("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN isMonitoringQris BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE");
                logAction('Database: Kolom isMonitoringQris berhasil ditambahkan ke tabel users.');
            }

            // Kolom di tabel Transactions
            const [trxCols] = await connection.query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM transactions LIKE 'is_refunded'");
            if (trxCols.length === 0) {
                await connection.query("ALTER TABLE transactions ADD COLUMN is_refunded BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE AFTER uniqueAmount");
                logAction('Database: Kolom is_refunded berhasil ditambahkan ke tabel transactions.');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Gagal migrasi database:', err.message);
        }

        // 3. Tabel Topups (userId diubah ke BIGINT)
        await connection.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS topups (
                id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                userId BIGINT NOT NULL,
                trxId VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                time BIGINT NOT NULL,
                amount DECIMAL(15,2),
                method VARCHAR(50),
                status VARCHAR(100),
                uniqueAmount DECIMAL(15,2),
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                INDEX idx_userId (userId),
                INDEX idx_trxId (trxId)
            )
        `);

        // 4. Tabel Callbacks (Tetap JSON)
        await connection.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS callbacks (
                id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                timestamp VARCHAR(50),
                data JSON,
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        `);

        // 5. Tabel Schedules (userId diubah ke BIGINT)
        await connection.query(`
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schedules (
                id VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
                userId BIGINT NOT NULL,
                productName VARCHAR(500),
                productCode VARCHAR(100),
                phoneNumber VARCHAR(50),
                price DECIMAL(15,2),
                executeDate DATE,
                executeTime TIME,
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                INDEX idx_userId (userId),
                INDEX idx_execute (executeDate, executeTime)
            )
        `);

        connection.release();
        logAction('Tabel database berhasil diinisialisasi dengan tipe data BIGINT.');

    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[DB ERROR] Gagal inisialisasi database:', error.message);
        process.exit(1);
    }
}

// ============================
// DATABASE HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================

/**
 * Update user balance atomically using SQL transaction or direct UPDATE query.
 */
async function updateBalanceAtomic(chatId, amount, type = 'add', connection = null) {
    const conn = connection || await pool.getConnection();
    try {
        const sign = type === 'add' ? '+' : '-';
        const [result] = await conn.query(
            `UPDATE users SET saldo = saldo ${sign} ? WHERE chatId = ?`,
            [amount, chatId]
        );
        return result.affectedRows > 0;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(`[DB ERROR] updateBalanceAtomic (${type}):`, error.message);
        throw error;
    } finally {
        if (!connection) conn.release();
    }
}

/**
 * Handle refund process with SQL Transaction and Idempotency check.
 */
async function processRefund(refId, userId, amount, productName, method, reason) {
    const connection = await pool.getConnection();
    try {
        await connection.beginTransaction();

        // 1. Lock the transaction row and check status (Idempotency)
        const [rows] = await connection.query(
            'SELECT userId, price, productName, method, status, is_refunded FROM transactions WHERE trxId = ? FOR UPDATE',
            [refId]
        );

        if (rows.length === 0) {
            logAction(`[REFUND ERROR] Transaksi ${refId} tidak ditemukan.`);
            await connection.rollback();
            return false;
        }

        const trx = rows[0];
        if (trx.is_refunded) {
            logAction(`[REFUND SKIPPED] Transaksi ${refId} sudah pernah di-refund.`);
            await connection.rollback();
            return false;
        }

        // 2. Refund Saldo
        await updateBalanceAtomic(userId, amount, 'add', connection);

        // 3. Update Status Transaksi
        await connection.query(
            'UPDATE transactions SET status = ?, is_refunded = TRUE WHERE trxId = ?',
            ['Gagal (Refunded)', refId]
        );

        await connection.commit();
        logAction(`[REFUND SUCCESS] Ref: ${refId}, User: ${userId}, Amount: Rp${formatRupiah(amount)}`);

        // 4. Notifications
        const userData = await getUserById(userId);
        const newSaldo = userData ? userData.saldo : 'N/A';
        const date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

        const refundMessage = `
${separator}
✅ *Status Refund Saldo Sukses*
${separator}
\`Code   :\` \`${refId}\`
\`Produk :\` \`${productName || trx.productName || 'N/A'}\`
\`Status :\` \`GAGAL\`
\`Pesan  :\` \`${reason || 'Transaksi Gagal'}\`
\`Refund :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(amount)}\`
\`Saldo  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(newSaldo)}\`
${separator}`;

        await bot.sendMessage(userId, refundMessage, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' }).catch(err => {});

        const groupRefundMessage = `
${separator}
Status Refund Saldo Sukses
${separator}
\`✧ User  :\` \`${escapeHtml(userData?.name || userData?.username || userId)}\`
\`✧ Code  :\` \`${refId}\`
\`✧ Info  :\` \`${productName || trx.productName || 'N/A'}\`
\`✧ Via   :\` \`${method || trx.method || 'N/A'}\`
\`✧ Plus  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(amount)}\`
\`✧ Date  :\` \`${date}\`
${separator}`;

        await bot.sendMessage(GROUP_NOTIFICATION_ID, groupRefundMessage, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' }).catch(err => {});

        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        await connection.rollback();
        console.error(`[REFUND ERROR] Ref: ${refId}:`, error.message);
        return false;
    } finally {
        connection.release();
    }
}

async function getUserById(userId) {
    try {
        const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE chatId = ?', [userId]);
        return rows[0] || null;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[DB ERROR] getUserById:', error.message);
        return null;
    }
}

async function updateUser(userId, updates) {
    try {
        const fields = [];
        const values = [];

        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(updates)) {
            fields.push(`${key} = ?`);
            values.push(value);
        }

        values.push(userId);
        await pool.query(`UPDATE users SET ${fields.join(', ')} WHERE chatId = ?`, values);
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[DB ERROR] updateUser:', error.message);
        return false;
    }
}

        const [rows] = await pool.query(query, params);
        return rows;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[DB ERROR] getUserTransactions:', error.message);
        return [];
    }
}

        await pool.query('DELETE FROM schedules WHERE id = ?', [scheduleId]);
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[DB ERROR] deleteSchedule:', error.message);
        return false;
    }
}

async function getScheduleById(scheduleId) {
    try {
        const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM schedules WHERE id = ?', [scheduleId]);
        return rows[0] || null;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[DB ERROR] getScheduleById:', error.message);
        return null;
    }
}

async function getDueSchedules(currentDate, currentTime) {
    try {
        const [rows] = await pool.query(
            'SELECT * FROM schedules WHERE executeDate = ? AND executeTime = ?',
            [currentDate, currentTime]
        );
        return rows;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[DB ERROR] getDueSchedules:', error.message);
        return [];
    }
}

async function getOldSchedules(currentDateTime) {
    try {
        const [rows] = await pool.query(
            'SELECT * FROM schedules WHERE CONCAT(executeDate, " ", executeTime) < ?',
            [currentDateTime]
        );
        return rows;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[DB ERROR] getOldSchedules:', error.message);
        return [];
    }
}

function formatWaktu(dateInput) {
    if (!dateInput) return 'N/A';
    const d = new Date(dateInput);

    // Jika input tidak valid
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return dateInput;

    const year = d.getFullYear();
    const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const hours = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    const minutes = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');

    return `${year}-${month}-${day} ${hours}:${minutes}`;
}

function formatTglJadwal(dateInput, timeInput) {
    if (!dateInput) return 'N/A';

    // 1. Proses Tanggal
    const d = new Date(dateInput);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return dateInput;

    const year = d.getFullYear();
    const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');

    // 2. Proses Jam (Safety Check untuk String atau Objek)
    let time = "00:00";
    if (timeInput) {
        // Pastikan dikonversi ke string dulu sebelum di-split
        const timeStr = timeInput.toString();
        if (timeStr.includes(':')) {
            time = timeStr.split(':').slice(0, 2).join(':');
        }
    }

    return `${year}-${month}-${day} ${time}`;
}

class CustomQrisPaymentChecker {
    constructor(config) {
        this.auth_token = config.auth_token;
        this.auth_username = config.auth_username;
        this.API_ENDPOINT = 'https://pg-tokovpn.pages.dev/api/orderkuota';
    }

    async checkPaymentStatus(reference, uniqueAmount, startTime) {
        const payload = qs.stringify({
            username: this.auth_username,
            token: this.auth_token
        });

        const expectedKreditString = uniqueAmount.toString();
        const truncatedStartDate = new Date(startTime);
        truncatedStartDate.setSeconds(0, 0);
        const truncatedStartTime = truncatedStartDate.getTime();

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(this.API_ENDPOINT, payload, {
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
                    "Origin": "https://payment-tokovpn.pages.dev",
                    "Referer": "https://payment-tokovpn.pages.dev/",
                    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"
                },
                timeout: 10000
            });

            if (response.status !== 200 || !response.data || !response.data.results) {
                console.log(`[QRIS API ERROR] Response tidak valid:`, response.data);
                return { 
                    success: false, 
                    data: { 
                        status: 'ERROR', 
                        message: `API Response Invalid` 
                    } 
                };
            }

            const foundTransaction = response.data.results.find(trx => {
                const isIN = trx.status === 'IN';

                const actualKreditClean = (trx.kredit || '').toString().replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
                const isAmountMatch = actualKreditClean === expectedKreditString;

                if (!trx.tanggal) return false;

                const [datePart, timePart] = trx.tanggal.split(' ');
                const [day, month, year] = datePart.split('/');

                const trxTime = new Date(
                    year,
                    month - 1,
                    day,
                    ...(timePart ? timePart.split(':') : [0,0,0])
                ).getTime();

                const isTimeValid = trxTime >= truncatedStartTime;

                return isIN && isAmountMatch && isTimeValid;
            });

            if (foundTransaction) {
                return { 
                    success: true, 
                    data: { 
                        status: 'PAID', 
                        message: `Pembayaran ditemukan: ${foundTransaction.keterangan}` 
                    } 
                };
            } else {
                return { 
                    success: true, 
                    data: { 
                        status: 'UNPAID', 
                        message: 'Nominal belum ditemukan atau belum tercatat.' 
                    } 
                };
            }

        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error.response 
                ? JSON.stringify(error.response.data) 
                : error.message;

            console.error(`[CUSTOM QRIS CHECKER ERROR]`, errorMessage);

            return { 
                success: false, 
                data: { 
                    status: 'ERROR', 
                    message: `API Call Failed: ${errorMessage.substring(0, 100)}` 
                } 
            };
        }
    }
}

function generateRandomUsername() {
    return Math.floor(10000 + Math.random() * 90000).toString();
}

async function isUsernameUnique(username) {
    try {
        const [rows] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM users WHERE username = ?', [username]);
        return rows[0].count === 0;
    } catch (error) {
        return true;
    }
}

async function generateUniqueUsername() {
    let randomUsername;
    let maxAttempts = 100;
    for (let i = 0; i < maxAttempts; i++) {
        randomUsername = `User_${generateRandomUsername()}`;
        if (await isUsernameUnique(randomUsername)) {
            return randomUsername;
        }
    }
    console.error("[ERROR] Gagal menghasilkan username unik setelah 100 percobaan.");
    return `User_FAIL_${Date.now()}`;
}

function generateUniqueQrisAmount(baseAmount) {
    const uniqueNumber = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101) + 100;
    const uniqueAmount = Math.floor(baseAmount) + uniqueNumber;
    return { uniqueAmount, uniqueNumber };
}

function logAction(description) {
    const date = new Date();
    const isoString = date.toISOString();
    const timePart = isoString.substring(0, 10) + ' ' + isoString.substring(11, 19);
    console.log(`[LOG] [${timePart}] ${description}`);
}

function formatRupiah(price) {
    const numPrice = typeof price === 'string' ? parseFloat(price) : price;
    if (isNaN(numPrice) || numPrice === null) return 'N/A';
    return Math.floor(numPrice).toLocaleString('id-ID', { minimumFractionDigits: 0 });
}

function getRuntime() {
    const uptime = Date.now() - startTime;

    const units = [
        { label: "h", value: 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 },
        { label: "j", value: 1000 * 60 * 60 },
        { label: "m", value: 1000 * 60 },
        { label: "d", value: 1000 }
    ];

    let result = [];
    let remaining = uptime;

    for (const u of units) {
        const val = Math.floor(remaining / u.value);
        if (val > 0 || u.label === "d") result.push(`${val}${u.label}`);
        remaining %= u.value;
    }

    return result.join(" ");
}

function sanitizeRupiahInput(input) {
    if (!input) return 0;
    const cleaned = String(input).replace(/[Rp.,\s]/gi, '');
    return parseInt(cleaned) || 0;
}

const escapeHtml = (text) => text ? String(text).replace(/[<>&]/g, (c) => {
    if (c === '<') return '&lt;';
    if (c === '>') return '&gt;';
    return '&amp;';
}) : '';

const delay = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function normalizePhoneNumber(phone) {
    if (!phone) return null;
    let normalized = phone.replace(/[^0-9+]/g, '');

    if (normalized.startsWith('+62')) {
        normalized = '0' + normalized.substring(3);
    } else if (normalized.startsWith('62')) {
        normalized = '0' + normalized.substring(2);
    } else if (!normalized.startsWith('08')) {
        return null;
    }

    if (normalized.startsWith('08') && normalized.length >= 10 && normalized.length <= 13) {
        return normalized;
    }

    return null;
}

function getPriceConfig() {
    try {
        if (fs.existsSync(PRICE_CONFIG_FILE)) {
            return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(PRICE_CONFIG_FILE, 'utf8'));
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Gagal baca price.json:", e.message);
    }
    return { margin: 15, max_fee: 2000 };
}

function calculateSellingPrice(modalPrice) {
    const config = getPriceConfig();
    const MARGIN_PERCENTAGE = config.margin / 100;
    const MAX_FEE = config.max_fee;

    const calculatedFee = modalPrice * MARGIN_PERCENTAGE;
    const finalFee = Math.min(calculatedFee, MAX_FEE);

    let sellingPrice = modalPrice + finalFee;
    return Math.round(sellingPrice);
}

function getProductByCode(code) {
    for (const category in groupedProducts) {
        for (const brand in groupedProducts[category]) {
            for (const type in groupedProducts[category][brand]) {
                const product = groupedProducts[category][brand][type].find(p => p.code === code);
                if (product) return product;
            }
        }
    }
    return null;
}

async function getFavoriteProducts(userId) {
    try {
        const transactions = await getUserTransactions(userId);
        const successTrx = transactions.filter(t => t.status === 'Sukses');
        const counts = {};

        successTrx.forEach(t => {
            const name = t.productName;
            counts[name] = (counts[name] || 0) + 1;
        });

        return Object.keys(counts)
            .map(name => ({ name: name, count: counts[name] }))
            .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[ERROR] getFavoriteProducts:', error.message);
        return [];
    }
}

function findProductByName(name) {
    for (const category in groupedProducts) {
        for (const brand in groupedProducts[category]) {
            for (const type in groupedProducts[category][brand]) {
                const product = groupedProducts[category][brand][type].find(p => p.name === name);
                if (product) return { type: 'PPOB', data: product };
            }
        }
    }
    return null;
}

function scanProductsInText(text) {
    const foundProducts = [];
    const seenNames = new Set();
    let allAvailableProducts = [];

    for (const category in groupedProducts) {
        for (const brand in groupedProducts[category]) {
            for (const type in groupedProducts[category][brand]) {
                allAvailableProducts.push(...groupedProducts[category][brand][type].map(p => ({ type: 'PPOB', data: p })));
            }
        }
    }

    allAvailableProducts.forEach(item => {
        const index = text.indexOf(item.data.name);
        if (index !== -1 && !seenNames.has(item.data.name)) {
            foundProducts.push({
                ...item,
                pos: index
            });
            seenNames.add(item.data.name);
        }
    });

    return foundProducts.sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos);
}

async function initializeUser(user) {
    const userId = user.id;
    let userData = await getUserById(userId);

    if (!userData) {
        let finalUsername = user.username || await generateUniqueUsername();

        const newUserData = {
            chatId: userId,
            username: finalUsername,
            name: user.first_name || 'Pengguna',
            saldo: 0,
            lastMessageId: null,
            isMonitoringQris: false
        };

        await createUser(newUserData);
        // Ambil ulang data setelah insert
        userData = await getUserById(userId);
    }

    // PENGAMAN: Jika database error dan userData tetap null, hentikan proses agar tidak crash
    if (!userData) {
        console.error(`[CRITICAL] Gagal inisialisasi user ${userId}. Cek tipe data BIGINT di database!`);
        return { name: user.first_name, chatId: userId, saldo: 0, username: 'Guest' };
    }

    if (!userData.username || userData.username === 'N/A' || userData.username.startsWith('User_')) {
        const newUsername = user.username || await generateUniqueUsername();
        await updateUser(userId, { username: newUsername });
        userData.username = newUsername;
    }

    return userData;
}

function loadAndGroupProducts() {
    try {
        const filePath = path.join(__dirname, PRICELIST_PREPAID_FILE);
        if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
            console.error(`[ERROR] File produk tidak ditemukan: ${filePath}. Mencoba update dari API...`);
            return false;
        }

        const rawData = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
        const jsonContent = JSON.parse(rawData);
        const products = Array.isArray(jsonContent) ? jsonContent : (jsonContent.data || []);
        const tempGrouped = {};
        let productCount = 0;

        for (const p of products) {
            const code = p.buyer_sku_code || 'N/A';
            if (code === 'N/A') continue;
            productCount++;

            const category = p.category || "Tanpa Kategori";
            const brand = p.brand || "Tanpa Brand";
            const type = p.type || "Umum";
            const sellingPrice = calculateSellingPrice(p.price);

            if (!tempGrouped[category]) tempGrouped[category] = {};
            if (!tempGrouped[category][brand]) tempGrouped[category][brand] = {};
            if (!tempGrouped[category][brand][type]) tempGrouped[category][brand][type] = [];

            tempGrouped[category][brand][type].push({
                name: p.product_name,
                price: p.price,
                sellingPrice: sellingPrice,
                desc: customDescriptions[p.product_name] || p.desc,
                code: code,
                buyerStatus: p.buyer_product_status,
                sellerStatus: p.seller_product_status,
                unlimitedStock: p.unlimited_stock,
                stock: p.stock || 0,
                multi: p.multi,
                startCutOff: p.start_cut_off,
                endCutOff: p.end_cut_off,
                sellerName: p.seller_name
            });
        }

        for (const category in tempGrouped) {
            for (const brand in tempGrouped[category]) {
                for (const type in tempGrouped[category][brand]) {
                    tempGrouped[category][brand][type].sort((a, b) => a.sellingPrice - b.sellingPrice);
                }
            }
        }

        groupedProducts = tempGrouped;
        logAction(`Berhasil memuat dan mengelompokkan ${productCount} produk.`);
        return true;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(`[ERROR] Gagal memuat data produk (Parsing/IO): ${error.message}`);
        return false;
    }
}

async function calculateGlobalStats() {
    try {
        const [userRows] = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) as totalUsers FROM users');
        const totalUsers = userRows[0].totalUsers;

        const [trxRows] = await pool.query(`
            SELECT COUNT(*) as count, SUM(price) as value 
            FROM transactions 
            WHERE status = 'Sukses'
        `);

        const totalTrxCount = trxRows[0].count || 0;
        const totalTrxValue = trxRows[0].value || 0;

        return {
            totalUsers,
            totalTrxCount,
            totalTrxValue,
            digiflazzTrxCount: totalTrxCount,
            digiflazzTrxValue: totalTrxValue
        };
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[ERROR] calculateGlobalStats:', error.message);
        return {
            totalUsers: 0,
            totalTrxCount: 0,
            totalTrxValue: 0,
            digiflazzTrxCount: 0,
            digiflazzTrxValue: 0
        };
    }
}

async function calculateMonthlyStats() {
    try {
        const now = new Date();
        const currentMonth = now.getMonth() + 1;
        const currentYear = now.getFullYear();

        const startOfMonth = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth - 1, 1).getTime();
        const endOfMonth = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth, 0, 23, 59, 59, 999).getTime();

        const [topupRows] = await pool.query(`
            SELECT SUM(amount) as total 
            FROM topups 
            WHERE status = 'Sukses' AND time >= ? AND time <= ?
        `, [startOfMonth, endOfMonth]);

        const [trxRows] = await pool.query(`
            SELECT COUNT(*) as count, SUM(price) as total 
            FROM transactions 
            WHERE status = 'Sukses' AND time >= ? AND time <= ?
        `, [startOfMonth, endOfMonth]);

        return {
            monthlyTopup: topupRows[0].total || 0,
            digiflazzMonthlyTrx: trxRows[0].total || 0,
            digiflazzMonthlyTrxCount: trxRows[0].count || 0
        };
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[ERROR] calculateMonthlyStats:', error.message);
        return {
            monthlyTopup: 0,
            digiflazzMonthlyTrx: 0,
            digiflazzMonthlyTrxCount: 0
        };
    }
}

async function calculateDailyStats() {
    try {
        const now = new Date();
        const startOfDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 0, 0, 0, 0).getTime();
        const endOfDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 23, 59, 59, 999).getTime();

        const [trxRows] = await pool.query(`
            SELECT COUNT(*) as count, SUM(price) as total 
            FROM transactions 
            WHERE status = 'Sukses' AND time >= ? AND time <= ?
        `, [startOfDay, endOfDay]);

        return {
            digiflazzDailyTrx: trxRows[0].total || 0,
            digiflazzDailyTrxCount: trxRows[0].count || 0
        };
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[ERROR] calculateDailyStats:', error.message);
        return {
            digiflazzDailyTrx: 0,
            digiflazzDailyTrxCount: 0
        };
    }
}

async function sendTrxNotificationToGroup(trxData, type, foundUser) {
    let messageBody;
    const date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const userDisplay = foundUser.name || foundUser.username;

    if (type === 'topup') {
        messageBody = `
${separator}
Status TopUp Sukses
${separator}
\`✧ User  :\` \`${escapeHtml(userDisplay)}\`
\`✧ Code  :\` \`${trxData.trxId}\`
\`✧ TopUp :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(trxData.amount)}\`
\`✧ Date  :\` \`${date}\`
${separator}
        `.trim();
    } else {
        const productInfo = trxData.productName;

        messageBody = `
${separator}
Status Transaksi Sukses
${separator}
\`✧ User  :\` \`${escapeHtml(userDisplay)}\`
\`✧ Code  :\` \`${trxData.trxId}\`
\`✧ Info  :\` \`${escapeHtml(productInfo)}\`
\`✧ Via   :\` \`${trxData.method}\`
\`✧ Pay   :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(trxData.price)}\`
\`✧ Date  :\` \`${date}\`
${separator}
        `.trim();
    }

    try {
        await bot.sendMessage(GROUP_NOTIFICATION_ID, messageBody, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
        logAction(`Notifikasi ${type.toUpperCase()} sukses dikirim ke grup ID ${GROUP_NOTIFICATION_ID}.`);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(`[GROUP NOTIF ERROR] Gagal mengirim pesan ke grup: ${e.message}`);
    }
}

async function sendAdminTransactionHistory(chatId, targetId, type, page = 1, messageId = null) {
    const targetData = await getUserById(targetId);
    if (!targetData) {
        await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ User ID <code>${escapeHtml(targetId)}</code> tidak ditemukan.`, { parse_mode: 'HTML' });
        return;
    }

    const totalItems = type === 'trx' ? await countUserTransactions(targetId) : await countUserTopups(targetId);
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalItems / MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
    const startIdx = (page - 1) * MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE;

    const dataArray = type === 'trx'
        ? await getUserTransactions(targetId, MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE, startIdx)
        : await getUserTopups(targetId, MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE, startIdx);

    const title = type === 'trx' ? 'Riwayat Pesanan' : 'Riwayat TopUp';
    const detailAction = type === 'trx' ? 'trx_admin_detail' : 'topup_admin_detail';
    const actionPrefix = type === 'trx' ? 'admin_view_trx' : 'admin_view_topup';
    const sep = escapeHtml(separator);

    let nextText = '';
    nextText += `${sep}\n`;
    nextText += `<b>👥 ${escapeHtml(targetData.name)}</b>\n`;
    nextText += `<b>🔎 ${escapeHtml(title)}</b> [ ${totalItems} Item ]\n`;
    nextText += `Halaman <b>${page}</b> dari <b>${totalPages || 1}</b>\n`;
    nextText += `${sep}\n`;

    const detailButtons = [];
    const itemLines = [];

    if (dataArray.length > 0) {
        dataArray.forEach((item, index) => {
            const itemNumber = startIdx + index + 1;
            const statusIcon = item.status === 'Sukses' ? '✅' : (item.status && item.status.startsWith && item.status.startsWith('Gagal') ? '⛔️' : '⏳');

            const mainInfo = type === 'trx'
                ? escapeHtml(item.productName || '-')
                : `Rp${escapeHtml(formatRupiah(item.amount || item.price || 0).toString())} - ${escapeHtml(item.method || '-')}`;

            itemLines.push(`<b>${itemNumber}.</b> ${statusIcon} ${mainInfo}`);
            detailButtons.push({ text: `${itemNumber}`, callback_data: `${detailAction}_${targetId}_${item.trxId || item.id}_${page}` });
        });

        nextText += itemLines.join('\n') + `\n${sep}\nPilih Angka Untuk Detail Informasi!\n${sep}\n`;
    } else {
        nextText += `<i>Tidak ada riwayat yang tercatat.</i>\n`;
    }

    const detailRows = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < detailButtons.length; i += 3) {
        detailRows.push(detailButtons.slice(i, i + 3));
    }

    const paginationButtons = [];
    if (page > 1) {
        paginationButtons.push({ text: `⬅️ Hal. ${page - 1}`, callback_data: `${actionPrefix}_${targetId}_${page - 1}` });
    }
    if (page < totalPages) {
        paginationButtons.push({ text: `Hal. ${page + 1} ➡️`, callback_data: `${actionPrefix}_${targetId}_${page + 1}` });
    }

    const keyboard = [
        ...detailRows,
        ...(paginationButtons.length ? [paginationButtons] : []),
        [{ text: '↩️ Kembali Ke Detail User', callback_data: `admin_user_detail_${targetId}_1` }]
    ];

    const options = {
        chat_id: chatId,
        message_id: messageId,
        parse_mode: 'HTML',
        reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: keyboard },
        disable_web_page_preview: true
    };

    try {
        if (messageId) {
            await bot.editMessageText(nextText, options);
        } else {
            await bot.sendMessage(chatId, nextText, options);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(`[ADMIN TRX HISTORY ERROR] Gagal mengirim riwayat Admin: ${e.message}`);
        await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ Gagal memuat riwayat: ${escapeHtml(e.message)}`, { parse_mode: 'HTML' });
    }
}

function generateDigiflazzSign(refId) {
    const rawString = DIGIFLAZZ_USERNAME + DIGIFLAZZ_API_KEY + refId;
    return crypto.createHash('md5').update(rawString).digest('hex');
}

function makePricelistSign() {
    return crypto
        .createHash("md5")
        .update(DIGIFLAZZ_USERNAME + DIGIFLAZZ_API_KEY + "pricelist")
        .digest("hex");
}

async function updatePriceList(isInitialLoad = false) {
    const cmd = "prepaid";
    const sign = makePricelistSign();
    const payload = { cmd, username: DIGIFLAZZ_USERNAME, sign };

    try {
        const response = await axios.post(PRICELIST_ENDPOINT, payload, {
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        });

        if (response.data?.data?.rc === "83") {
            logAction("⚠️ Digiflazz: Sudah mencapai limitasi pengecekan pricelist.");
            return { success: false, message: "Sudah mencapai limitasi pengecekan pricelist (RC 83)." };
        }

        const products = Array.isArray(response.data?.data) ? response.data.data : (Array.isArray(response.data?.data?.data) ? response.data.data.data : []);

        if (!products.length) {
            logAction("⚠️ Digiflazz: Tidak ada data produk, respons tidak sesuai harapan.");
            return { success: false, message: "Tidak ada data produk dari API Digiflazz." };
        }

        const filePath = path.join(__dirname, PRICELIST_PREPAID_FILE);
        fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(products, null, 2), "utf-8");
        loadAndGroupProducts();

        const successMessage = `✅ Daftar harga ${cmd.toUpperCase()} berhasil diperbarui (${products.length} produk).`;
        logAction(successMessage);
        return { success: true, message: successMessage };

    } catch (error) {
        const errorMessage = `⛔️ Gagal ambil daftar harga: ${error.response?.data?.data?.message || error.message}`;
        console.error(errorMessage);
        return { success: false, message: errorMessage };
    }
}

async function callDigiflazzAPI(refId, sku, customerNo) {
    const sign = generateDigiflazzSign(refId);
    const requestData = {
        username: DIGIFLAZZ_USERNAME,
        buyer_sku_code: sku,
        customer_no: customerNo,
        ref_id: refId,
        sign: sign
    };

    logAction(`API: Mempersiapkan request untuk Ref: ${refId}`);

    try {
        const response = await axios.post(DIGIFLAZZ_ENDPOINT, requestData, {
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
        });

        logAction(`API: Respon sukses (Status ${response.status}) diterima untuk Ref: ${refId}`);

        if (response.data && response.data.data) {
            return response.data.data;
        } else {
            throw new Error(`Invalid API response structure. Response: ${JSON.stringify(response.data)}`);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        const errorMessage = error.response ? `HTTP Error ${error.response.status}: ${JSON.stringify(error.response.data)}` : error.message;
        console.error(`[DEBUG: API ERROR] Digiflazz call failed for ${refId}:`, errorMessage);
        logAction(`API: Gagal memanggil API untuk Ref: ${refId}. Error: ${errorMessage.substring(0, 50)}...`);

        return {
            ref_id: refId,
            customer_no: customerNo,
            buyer_sku_code: sku,
            message: `Koneksi Error, Hubungi atau teruskan pesan ini ke admin segera!`,
            // message: `Koneksi Error: ${errorMessage}`,
            status: "Gagal",
            rc: "99"
        };
    }
}

async function startQrisCheck(chatId, userId, reference, uniqueAmount, type, qrisMessageId) {
    const timeout = 10 * 30 * 1000;
    const startTime = Date.now();
    let finalStatus = 'Gagal (Expired)';
    let isPaid = false;

    try {
        const userData = await getUserById(userId);
        if (!userData) throw new Error("User data not found");

        await updateUser(userId, { isMonitoringQris: true });

        while (Date.now() - startTime < timeout) {
            const updatedUserData = await getUserById(userId);
            if (!updatedUserData || !updatedUserData.isMonitoringQris) {
                finalStatus = 'Dibatalkan Pengguna';
                logAction(`QRIS CHECK: Monitoring Ref ${reference} dihentikan oleh pengguna.`);
                break;
            }

            console.log(`[QRIS CHECK LOG] Checking Ref ${reference} with Unique Amount ${uniqueAmount}...`);
            const result = await paymentChecker.checkPaymentStatus(reference, uniqueAmount, startTime);

            if (result.success && result.data.status === 'PAID') {
                finalStatus = 'Sukses';
                isPaid = true;
                break;
            }
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 15000));
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error(`[QRIS CHECK ERROR] Ref ${reference}:`, error.message);
        finalStatus = 'Gagal (Error API)';
    } finally {
        await updateUser(userId, { isMonitoringQris: false });
        logAction(`QRIS CHECK: Monitoring Ref ${reference} selesai. Status: ${finalStatus}`);
    }

    const userData = await getUserById(userId);
    if (!userData) return;

    let transaction;

    if (type === 'topup') {
        transaction = await getTopupByTrxId(reference);
    } else {
        transaction = await getTransactionByTrxId(reference);
    }

    if (!transaction || transaction.status !== 'Pending') return;

    const originalAmount = transaction.amount || transaction.price;
    let apiStatus = finalStatus;
    let apiMessage = `Pembayaran ${finalStatus}`;

    try {
        await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, qrisMessageId);
    } catch (e) { }

    if (type === 'topup') {
        if (isPaid) {
            apiStatus = 'Sukses';
            await updateTopup(reference, { status: apiStatus });

            await updateBalanceAtomic(userId, originalAmount, 'add');

            const updatedTopup = await getTopupByTrxId(reference);
            await sendTrxNotificationToGroup(updatedTopup, 'topup', userData);
        } else {
            await updateTopup(reference, { status: finalStatus });
        }
    } else if (type === 'trx' && isPaid) {
        const apiResult = await callDigiflazzAPI(reference, transaction.productCode, transaction.phoneNumber);
        apiStatus = apiResult.status;
        apiMessage = apiResult.message;

        await updateTransaction(reference, {
            status: apiStatus,
            sn: apiResult.sn || apiResult.message
        });

        if (apiStatus === 'Gagal') {
            await processRefund(reference, userId, originalAmount, transaction.productName, transaction.method, apiMessage);
        }

        if (apiStatus === 'Sukses') {
            const updatedTrx = await getTransactionByTrxId(reference);
            await sendTrxNotificationToGroup(updatedTrx, 'trx', userData);
        }
    } else {
        if (type === 'trx') {
            await updateTransaction(reference, { status: finalStatus });
        } else {
            await updateTopup(reference, { status: finalStatus });
        }
    }

    const updatedUserData = await getUserById(userId);
    const finalTransaction = type === 'trx' ? await getTransactionByTrxId(reference) : await getTopupByTrxId(reference);
    const finalTrxStatus = finalTransaction.status || finalStatus;

    let notificationIcon = '⛔️';
    if (finalTrxStatus.includes('Sukses')) {
        notificationIcon = '✅';
    } else if (finalTrxStatus.includes('Pending')) {
        notificationIcon = '⏳';
    }

    let apiStatusDetail = '';
    if (type === 'trx' && isPaid && apiStatus !== 'Sukses' && apiStatus !== finalStatus) {
        apiStatusDetail = `\n\`Pesan  :\` \`Transaksi ${apiStatus}\``;
    }

    const notificationMessage = `
${separator}
${notificationIcon} Status Pembayaran User
${separator}
\`ID TRX :\` \`${reference}\`
\`Status :\` \`${finalTrxStatus.toUpperCase()}\`${apiStatusDetail}
${type === 'topup' ? `\`TopUp  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(originalAmount)}\`` : `\`Harga  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(originalAmount)}\``} ${type === 'topup' && finalTrxStatus.includes('Sukses') ? `\`\nSaldo  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(updatedUserData.saldo)}\`` : ''}
${separator}`;

    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, notificationMessage, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });

    if (!(type === 'trx' && (apiStatus === 'Sukses' || apiStatus === 'Pending'))) {
        await delay(2000);
        await sendMainMenuFinal(chatId, updatedUserData);
    }
}

async function findPendingQris(userId) {
    try {
        const userData = await getUserById(userId);
        if (!userData || !userData.isMonitoringQris) return null;

        const [trxRows] = await pool.query(
            "SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE userId = ? AND method = 'QRIS' AND status = 'Pending' LIMIT 1",
            [userId]
        );

        if (trxRows.length > 0) return trxRows[0];

        const [topupRows] = await pool.query(
            "SELECT * FROM topups WHERE userId = ? AND method = 'QRIS' AND status = 'Pending' LIMIT 1",
            [userId]
        );

        if (topupRows.length > 0) return topupRows[0];

        return null;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[ERROR] findPendingQris:', error.message);
        return null;
    }
}

async function sendPendingQrisWarning(chatId, userData, pendingTransaction) {
    const type = pendingTransaction.productName ? 'Transaksi' : 'TopUp';
    const amountDisplay = pendingTransaction.price ? pendingTransaction.price : pendingTransaction.amount;
    const uniqueAmount = pendingTransaction.uniqueAmount;
    const qrCode = pendingTransaction.trxId;
    const timeElapsed = (Date.now() - pendingTransaction.time) / 1000;
    const timeRemaining = Math.max(0, 300 - Math.floor(timeElapsed));
    const minutes = Math.floor(timeRemaining / 60);
    const seconds = timeRemaining % 60;
    const timeStr = `${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;

    const message = `
${separator}
⚠️ *Masih Ada QRIS Pending*
${separator}
\`ID TRX : \` \`${qrCode}\`
\`Type   : \` \`${type}\`
\`Harga  : \` \`Rp${formatRupiah(amountDisplay)}\`
\`Total  : \` \`Rp${formatRupiah(uniqueAmount)}\`
\`Expiry : \` \`${timeStr}\`
${separator}
Harap segera selesaikan pembayaran di atas atau klik *Batalkan Proses* untuk membuat QRIS baru.
${separator}`;

    const keyboard = {
        inline_keyboard: [
            [{ text: `⛔️ Batalkan Proses`, callback_data: 'cancel_tx' }]
        ]
    };

    try {
        // Hapus pesan sebelumnya agar tidak menumpuk
        await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, userData.lastMessageId).catch(() => { });

        // GENERATE ULANG GAMBAR QRIS
        const qrString = qrisGen.generateQrString(uniqueAmount, qrCode);
        const qrBuffer = await qrisGen.generateQRWithLogo(qrString);
        const qrImagePath = path.join(__dirname, `re_qr_${chatId}.png`);
        fs.writeFileSync(qrImagePath, qrBuffer);

        // KIRIM ULANG SEBAGAI FOTO
        const sentMessage = await bot.sendPhoto(chatId, qrImagePath, {
            caption: message,
            parse_mode: 'Markdown',
            reply_markup: keyboard
        });

        // Update ID pesan terakhir dan hapus file temporary
        await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });
        fs.unlinkSync(qrImagePath);

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("[WARNING QRIS ERROR]:", error.message);
        // Jika gagal kirim foto, kirim teks saja sebagai backup
        const sentMessage = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, message, {
            parse_mode: 'Markdown',
            reply_markup: keyboard
        });
        await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });
    }
}

async function sendMainMenuFinal(chatId, userData, messageId = null) {
    const transactions = await getUserTransactions(userData.chatId);
    const topups = await getUserTopups(userData.chatId);

    const totalTopup = topups

    const totalTrx = transactions
        .filter(t => t.status === 'Sukses')
        .reduce((sum, t) => sum + parseFloat(t.price), 0);

    const nextMenuText = `
█▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀█
█░░╦─╦╔╗╦─╔╗╔╗╔╦╗╔╗░░█
█░░║║║╠─║─║─║║║║║╠─░░█
█░░╚╩╝╚╝╚╝╚╝╚╝╩─╩╚╝░░█
█▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄█

๑۞๑ ${escapeHtml(userData.name)}
${separator}
<code>Chat ID  :</code> <code>${userData.chatId}</code>
<code>Balance  :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(userData.saldo)}</code>
${separator}
<code>TopUp    :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(totalTopup)}</code>
<code>Done TRX :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(totalTrx)}</code>
${separator}
<code>Order Vpn Web</code> <a href="https://tokovpn.com">TokoVPN.com</a>
${separator}
    `;

    const categoryKeys = Object.keys(groupedProducts);
    const categoryItems = categoryKeys.map(cat => ({
        text: cat,
        callback_data: `cat_${cat}`
    }));

    const mainKeyboard = [];

    mainKeyboard.push(
        ...categoryItems.reduce((rows, item, index) => {
            if (index % 2 === 0) rows.push([]);
            rows[rows.length - 1].push(item);
            return rows;
        }, [])
    );

    mainKeyboard.push(
        [{ text: '💎 Cek Status Pesanan', callback_data: 'info_cekstatus' }],
        [{ text: '⭐ Favorit', callback_data: 'info_favpage_1' }, { text: '📶 Cek Kuota', callback_data: 'info_cek_xl' }],
        [{ text: '📅 Daftar Jadwal', callback_data: 'sched_list_1' }],
        [
            { text: '📘 Panduan', callback_data: 'info_panduan' },
            { text: '💰 TopUp', callback_data: 'info_topup' }
        ],
        [{ text: '♻️ Refresh', callback_data: 'info_refresh' }]
    );

    if (messageId) {
        try {
            const sentMessage = await bot.editMessageText(nextMenuText, {
                chat_id: chatId,
                message_id: messageId,
                parse_mode: 'HTML',
                reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: mainKeyboard }
            });
            await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });
        } catch (error) {
            const sentMessage = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, nextMenuText, {
                parse_mode: 'HTML',
                reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: mainKeyboard }
            });
            await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });
        }
    } else {
        const sentMessage = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, nextMenuText, {
            parse_mode: 'HTML',
            reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: mainKeyboard }
        });
        await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });
    }
}

function formatResult(text) {
    return text
        .replace(/(Paket\s+\d+:\s+)Paket\s+/gm, "$1")
        .replace(/^Nomor:/gm, "📱 *Nomor:*")
        .replace(/^Tipe Kartu:/gm, "💳 *Tipe Kartu:*")
        .replace(/^Status 4G:/gm, "📶 *Status 4G:*")
        .replace(/^Status Dukcapil:/gm, "🧾 *Status Dukcapil:*")
        .replace(/^Umur Kartu:/gm, "⏳ *Umur Kartu:*")
        .replace(/^Masa Aktif:/gm, "📆 *Masa Aktif:*")
        .replace(/^Masa Berakhir Tenggang:/gm, "⛔️ *Akhir Tenggang:*")
        .replace(/^Detail Kuota:/gm, "💎 *Detail Kuota:*")
        .replace(/^Paket\s+(\d+):/gm, "🗂️ *Paket $1:*")
        .replace(/^\s*Benefit\s*:/gm, "🎁 *Benefit:*")
        .replace(/^Aktif Hingga:/gm, "⏳ *Aktif Hingga:*")
        .replace(/^- /gm, "🔹 ");
}

async function cekXL(nomor) {
    try {
        const url = `https://bendith.my.id/end.php?check=package&number=${nomor}&version=2`;

        const res = await axios.get(url, {
            headers: {
                "accept": "application/json",
                "user-agent": "Mozilla/5.0"
            }
        });

        if (!res.data || !res.data.success) {
            return {
                success: false,
                data: "Status Pengecekan Gagal."
            };
        }

        const subs = res.data.data?.subs_info;
        const packages = res.data.data?.package_info?.packages || [];

        if (!subs) {
            return {
                success: false,
                data: "Data pelanggan tidak ditemukan."
            };
        }

        let rawText = 
`Nomor: ${subs.msisdn}
Tipe Kartu: ${subs.operator}
Status 4G: ${subs.net_type}
Status Dukcapil: ${subs.id_verified}
Umur Kartu: ${subs.tenure}
Masa Aktif: ${subs.exp_date}
Masa Berakhir Tenggang: ${subs.grace_until}

Detail Kuota:
`;

        if (packages.length > 0) {
            packages.forEach((pkg, index) => {
                rawText += `
Paket ${index + 1}: ${pkg.name}
Aktif Hingga: ${pkg.expiry}
Benefit:
`;

                if (pkg.quotas && pkg.quotas.length > 0) {
                    pkg.quotas.forEach(q => {
                        rawText += `- ${q.name}\n`;
                        rawText += `  Sisa: ${q.remaining} / ${q.total} (${q.percent}%)\n`;
                    });
                } else {
                    rawText += `- Tidak ada detail kuota\n`;
                }
            });
        } else {
            rawText += `Tidak ada paket aktif.\n`;
        }

        return {
            success: true,
            data: rawText.trim() + "\n"
        };

    } catch (err) {
        return {
            success: false,
            data: "Status Pengecekan Gagal (Error API)."
        };
    }
}

async function handleCekKuotaXL(chatId, userData, messageId) {
    userStates[chatId] = { step: 'AWAITING_XL_NUMBER', lastMenu: 'main_menu' };
    const infoMessage = `
${separator}
🔍 *Cek Kuota XL/Axis*
${separator}
📝 Kirim Nomor XL/Axis yang Ingin Dicek!

_Kirim nomor tujuan [ contoh: 0812345xxxx ].
Jika No hp: ✅ 08xx ✅ 628xx ✅ +628xx
Untuk Membatalkan, Klik Tombol Batalkan Proses di Bawah._
${separator}`;

    const keyboard = [
        [{ text: '⛔️ Batalkan Proses', callback_data: 'cancel_tx' }]
    ];

    try {
        await bot.editMessageText(infoMessage, {
            chat_id: chatId,
            message_id: messageId,
            parse_mode: 'Markdown',
            reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: keyboard },
            disable_web_page_preview: true
        });
        await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: messageId });
    } catch (error) {
        if (!error.message.includes('message is not modified')) {
            const sentMessage = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, infoMessage, {
                parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: keyboard }
            });
            await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });
        }
    }
}

async function setMaintenanceMode(status) {
    isMaintenanceModeOtomatis = status;
    logAction(`Mode Maintenance ditetapkan: ${status ? 'Aktif' : 'Nonaktif'}`);
}

function scheduleMaintenance() {
    schedule.scheduleJob('30 23 * * *', function () {
        logAction('Waktu 23:30: Mengaktifkan Maintenance Mode.');
        setMaintenanceMode(true);
    });

    schedule.scheduleJob('30 0 * * *', function () {
        logAction('Waktu 00:30: Menon-aktifkan Maintenance Mode.');
        setMaintenanceMode(false);
    });

    logAction('Penjadwalan Maintenance Mode telah diatur.');
}

const createKeyboard = (items, backData, twoColumns = true) => {
    const keyboard = [];
    let row = [];
    const maxCols = twoColumns ? 2 : 1;

    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        row.push(items[i]);
        if (row.length === maxCols || i === items.length - 1) {
            keyboard.push(row);
            row = [];
        }
    }

    if (backData) {
        keyboard.push([{ text: '↩️ Kembali', callback_data: backData }]);
    }
    if (backData) {
        keyboard.push([{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]);
    }

    return keyboard;
};

    const userData = await initializeUser(user);
    const userName = escapeHtml(userData.name);
    const runtime = getRuntime();

    if (userData.lastMessageId) {
        try {
            await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, userData.lastMessageId);
        } catch (e) { }
        await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: null });
    }

    const globalStats = await calculateGlobalStats();
    const monthlyStats = await calculateMonthlyStats();
    const dailyStats = await calculateDailyStats();

    const message = `
█▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀█
█░░╦─╦╔╗╦─╔╗╔╗╔╦╗╔╗░░█
█░░║║║╠─║─║─║║║║║╠─░░█
█░░╚╩╝╚╝╚╝╚╝╚╝╩─╩╚╝░░█
█▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄█

๑۞๑ ${escapeHtml(userName)}
${separator}
<code>TELEBOT TOKO PPOB BERGARANSI</code>
${separator}
<code>Name     :</code> <code>${escapeHtml(userName)}</code>
<code>Username :</code> <code>${escapeHtml(userData.username)}</code>
<code>Chat ID  :</code> <code>${escapeHtml(String(userData.chatId))}</code>
<code>Runtime  :</code> <code>${runtime}</code> 
${separator}
<blockquote><code>Total User •¯•» ${escapeHtml(String(globalStats.totalUsers))}</code></blockquote>
${separator}
<code>TRX HARIAN  :</code> <code>Rp${escapeHtml(formatRupiah(dailyStats.digiflazzDailyTrx))}</code>
<code>TRX BULANAN :</code> <code>Rp${escapeHtml(formatRupiah(monthlyStats.digiflazzMonthlyTrx))}</code>
<code>TRX GLOBAL  :</code> <code>Rp${escapeHtml(formatRupiah(globalStats.digiflazzTrxValue))}</code>
${separator}
<code>Order Vpn Web</code> <a href="https://tokovpn.com">TokoVPN.com</a>
${separator}
`;

    const keyboardOptions = {
        reply_markup: {
            inline_keyboard: [
                [
                    { text: '🔔 Channel', url: 'https://t.me/tokovpninfo' },
                    { text: '👥 Group', url: 'https://t.me/tokovpngrub' }
                ],
                [
                    { text: '🏠 Main Menu', callback_data: 'main_menu' }
                ]
            ]
        },
        parse_mode: 'HTML',
        disable_web_page_preview: true
    };

    try {
        const sentMessage = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, message, keyboardOptions);
        await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Gagal mengirim pesan /start:", error.message);
    }
}

async function showMonthPicker(chatId, messageId) {
    const now = new Date();
    const currentMonth = now.getMonth();
    const currentYear = now.getFullYear();

    const buttons = [];
    const totalMonths = 12 - currentMonth;

    for (let i = 0; i < totalMonths; i++) {
        const d = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth + i, 1);
        const monthShort = d.toLocaleString('id-ID', { month: 'short' });

        buttons.push({
            text: monthShort,
            callback_data: `sch_m_${d.getMonth()}_${d.getFullYear()}`
        });
    }

    const rows = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < buttons.length; i += 4) {
        rows.push(buttons.slice(i, i + 4));
    }

    rows.push([{ text: '⛔️ Batalkan Proses', callback_data: 'cancel_tx' }]);

    await bot.editMessageText(
        `📅 *Pilih Bulan Penjadwalan*\n\n` +
        `Silakan pilih bulan yang tersedia. Bulan ditampilkan dari sekarang hingga akhir tahun *${currentYear}*.`,
        {
            chat_id: chatId,
            message_id: messageId,
            parse_mode: 'Markdown',
            reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: rows }
        }
    );
}

async function showDayPicker(chatId, messageId, month, year) {
    const nowWIB = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "Asia/Jakarta" }));
    const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
    const buttons = [];

    for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
        const targetDate = new Date(year, month, i, 23, 59);
        if (targetDate >= nowWIB) {
            buttons.push({
                text: `${i}`,
                callback_data: `sch_d_${i}_${month}_${year}`
            });
        }
    }

    const rows = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < buttons.length; i += 7) {
        rows.push(buttons.slice(i, i + 7));
    }

    rows.push([{ text: '↩️ Kembali ke Bulan', callback_data: 'sched_start' }]);

    await bot.editMessageText(
        `📆 *Pilih Tanggal Penjadwalan*\n\n` +
        `Silakan pilih tanggal yang tersedia. Tanggal yang telah berlalu tidak ditampilkan.`,
        {
            chat_id: chatId,
            message_id: messageId,
            parse_mode: 'Markdown',
            reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: rows }
        }
    );
}

async function showTimePicker(chatId, messageId, d, m, y) {
    const nowWIB = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "Asia/Jakarta" }));

    const hours = [
        '01:00', '02:00', '03:00', '04:00', '05:00', '06:00',
        '07:00', '08:00', '09:00', '10:00', '11:00', '12:00',
        '13:00', '14:00', '15:00', '16:00', '17:00', '18:00',
        '19:00', '20:00', '21:00', '22:00'
    ];

    const buttons = [];
    hours.forEach(h => {
        const [hour, minute] = h.split(':');
        const targetTime = new Date(y, m, d, Number(hour), Number(minute));
        if (targetTime > nowWIB) {
            buttons.push({
                text: h,
                callback_data: `sch_t_${d}_${m}_${y}_${h}`
            });
        }
    });

    const rows = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < buttons.length; i += 4) {
        rows.push(buttons.slice(i, i + 4));
    }

    rows.push([{ text: '↩️ Ubah Tanggal', callback_data: `sch_m_${m}_${y}` }]);

    const formattedDate = `${y}-${String(parseInt(m) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d).padStart(2, '0')}`;

    await bot.editMessageText(
        `🕒 *Pilih Jam Penjadwalan*\n\n` +
        `Tanggal terpilih: *${formattedDate}*\n` +
        `Jam yang telah berlalu tidak dapat dipilih.`,
        {
            chat_id: chatId,
            message_id: messageId,
            parse_mode: 'Markdown',
            reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: rows }
        }
    );
}

async function renderJadwalList(chatId, message_id, page = 1) {
    const totalSchedules = await countUserSchedules(chatId);

    if (totalSchedules === 0) {
        return await bot.editMessageText(
            `${separator}\n📅 *Daftar Jadwal Saya*\n${separator}\n` +
            `⚠️ Belum Ada Jadwal\n` +
            `_Belum ada riwayat penjadwalan._\n${separator}`,
            {
                chat_id: chatId,
                message_id: message_id,
                parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                reply_markup: {
                    inline_keyboard: [
                        [{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]
                    ]
                }
            }
        );
    }

    const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalSchedules / MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
    const startIdx = (page - 1) * MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
    const pageData = await getUserSchedules(chatId, MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE, startIdx);

    let nextText = `${separator}\n<blockquote><code>Menu •¯•» Jadwal Aktif</code></blockquote>\n${separator}\n<code>Daftar Jadwal [ ${page} / ${totalPages} ]</code>\n${separator}\n`;

    pageData.forEach((j, index) => {
        const productResult = findProductByName(j.productName);
        const latestProduct = productResult ? productResult.data : null;
        const displayPrice = latestProduct ? latestProduct.sellingPrice : j.price;

        nextText += `<b>${startIdx + index + 1}. ✅ ${escapeHtml(j.productName)}</b>\n` +
            `<code>Tujuan :</code> <code>${j.phoneNumber}</code>\n` +
            `<code>Harga  :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(displayPrice)}</code>\n` +
            `<code>Waktu  :</code> <code>${formatTglJadwal(j.executeDate, j.executeTime)}</code>\n${separator}\n`;
    });

    const numButtons = pageData.map((j, index) => ({
        text: `${startIdx + index + 1}`,
        callback_data: `sched_del_confirm_${j.id}_${page}`
    }));

    const numRows = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < numButtons.length; i += 3) numRows.push(numButtons.slice(i, i + 3));

    const navButtons = [];
    if (page > 1) navButtons.push({ text: '⬅️', callback_data: `sched_list_${page - 1}` });
    if (page < totalPages) navButtons.push({ text: '➡️', callback_data: `sched_list_${page + 1}` });

    const keyboard = [...numRows, ...(navButtons.length ? [navButtons] : []), [{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]];

    return await bot.editMessageText(nextText, {
        chat_id: chatId,
        message_id: message_id,
        parse_mode: 'HTML',
        reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: keyboard }
    });
}

// ============================
// BOT MESSAGE HANDLERS
// ============================
bot.onText(/\/start/, async (msg) => {
    const chatId = msg.chat.id;
    const user = msg.from;

    if (msg.chat.type === 'group' || msg.chat.type === 'supergroup') {
        return;
    }

    delete userStates[chatId];
    await initializeUser(user);

    await sendStartMessage(chatId, user);
});

bot.on('callback_query', async (callbackQuery) => {
    const msg = callbackQuery.message;
    let data = callbackQuery.data;
    const chatId = msg.chat.id;
    const messageId = msg.message_id;
    const user = callbackQuery.from;
    const userData = await initializeUser(user);
    const userId = user.id;

    console.log(`\n[DEBUG] Klik Terdeteksi: ${data} | User: ${chatId}`);

    if (isMaintenanceMode || isMaintenanceModeOtomatis) {
        const maintMsg = isMaintenanceMode ? globalMaintenanceMessage : "Bot sedang dalam mode maintenance harian (23:30 - 00:30). Mohon coba lagi nanti.";
        await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, {
            text: `🛠️ ${maintMsg}`,
            show_alert: true
        });
        return;
    }

    const currentTime = Date.now();
    const lastClickTime = callbackCooldowns[userId] || 0;

    if (currentTime - lastClickTime < CALLBACK_COOLDOWN_MS) {
        await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, {
            text: "⚠️ Mohon tunggu sejenak sebelum menekan lagi.",
            show_alert: false
        });
        return;
    }
    callbackCooldowns[userId] = currentTime;

    if (!data.startsWith('buy_') && !data.startsWith('confirm_tx_') && !data.startsWith('admin_') &&
        !data.startsWith('info_qris_') &&
        data !== 'admin_cancel_broadcast' && data !== 'cancel_tx' &&
        !data.startsWith('sched_') && !data.startsWith('sch_')) {
        await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id).catch(() => { });
    }

    if (data.startsWith('favbuy_')) {
        const b64Part = data.split('_')[1];
        let targetProductName = null;
        const favorites = await getFavoriteProducts(userId);
        const foundFav = favorites.find(f => Buffer.from(f.name).toString('base64').substring(0, 30) === b64Part);

        if (foundFav) {
            targetProductName = foundFav.name;
        } else {
            let foundInGlobal = null;
            for (const cat in groupedProducts) {
                for (const brd in groupedProducts[cat]) {
                    for (const typ in groupedProducts[cat][brd]) {
                        const match = groupedProducts[cat][brd][typ].find(p =>
                            Buffer.from(p.name).toString('base64').substring(0, 30) === b64Part
                        );
                        if (match) { foundInGlobal = match.name; break; }
                    }
                    if (foundInGlobal) break;
                }
                if (foundInGlobal) break;
            }
            targetProductName = foundInGlobal;
        }

        if (!targetProductName) {
            return bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, { text: "⛔️ Produk sudah tidak tersedia atau ID expired.", show_alert: true });
        }

        const productInfo = findProductByName(targetProductName);
        if (!productInfo) {
            return bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, { text: "⛔️ Data produk tidak ditemukan di pusat.", show_alert: true });
        }

        const p = productInfo.data;
        const currentPrice = p.sellingPrice;

        userStates[chatId] = {
            step: 'AWAITING_PHONE',
            productCode: p.code,
            productName: p.name,
            price: currentPrice
        };

        let panduanInput = `_Kirim nomor tujuan [ contoh: 0812345xxxx ].\nJika No hp: ✅ 08xx ✅ 628xx ✅ +628xx_`;
        const nameLower = p.name.toLowerCase();

        if (nameLower.includes("free fire")) {
            panduanInput = `_Kirimkan ID Akun Free Fire Anda.\nContoh: 123456789_`;
        } else if (nameLower.includes("mobile legend") || nameLower.includes("mobilelegend")) {
            panduanInput = `_Kirimkan ID + Server Mobile Legends Anda.\nContoh: 12345678(1234) tanpa tanda kurung_`;
        }

        const instructionMessage = `
${separator}
*Detail Pembelian Produk*
${separator}
\`Produk :\` \`${escapeHtml(p.name)}\`
\`Code   :\` \`${escapeHtml(p.code)}\`
\`Detail :\` \`${escapeHtml(p.desc)}\`
\`Harga  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(currentPrice)}\`
${separator}
📝 *Transaksi diproses otomatis. Pastikan nomor/ID tujuan benar. Kesalahan input di luar tanggung jawab penjual.*

${panduanInput}
_Setelah dikirim, konfirmasi Bayar atau Batalkan Proses._
${separator}`;

        try {
            await bot.editMessageText(instructionMessage, {
                chat_id: chatId,
                message_id: messageId,
                parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '⛔️ Batalkan Proses', callback_data: 'cancel_tx' }]] }
            });

            await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: messageId });

        } catch (e) {
            const sentMsg = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, instructionMessage, {
                parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '⛔️ Batalkan Proses', callback_data: 'cancel_tx' }]] }
            });

            await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMsg.message_id });
        }
        await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id);
        return;
    }

    if (data === 'sched_start') {
        if (!userStates[chatId] || !userStates[chatId].productName) {
            return bot.editMessageText("⚠️ *Sesi Berakhir Otomatis*\n\nSesi pembelian terputus karena bot baru saja dimulai ulang. Silakan pilih produk kembali dari Menu Utama.", {
                chat_id: chatId,
                message_id: messageId,
                parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                reply_markup: {
                    inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]]
                }
            });
        }

        if (!userStates[chatId].tempSchedules) userStates[chatId].tempSchedules = [];
        await showMonthPicker(chatId, messageId);
        return;
    }

    if (data.startsWith('sch_m_') || data.startsWith('sch_d_') || data.startsWith('sch_t_')) {
        if (!userStates[chatId] || !userStates[chatId].productName) {
            return bot.editMessageText("⚠️ *Sesi Berakhir Otomatis*\n\nSesi pembelian terputus karena bot baru saja dimulai ulang. Silakan pilih produk kembali dari Menu Utama.", {
                chat_id: chatId,
                message_id: messageId,
                parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                reply_markup: {
                    inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]]
                }
            });
        }
    }

    if (data.startsWith('sch_m_')) {
        const [, , m, y] = data.split('_');
        await showDayPicker(chatId, messageId, parseInt(m), parseInt(y));
    }

    if (data.startsWith('sch_d_')) {
        const [, , d, m, y] = data.split('_');
        await showTimePicker(chatId, messageId, d, m, y);
    }

    if (data.startsWith('sch_t_')) {
        const [, , d, m, y, h] = data.split('_');
        const fullDate = `${y}-${String(parseInt(m) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d).padStart(2, '0')}`;

        if (!userStates[chatId].tempSchedules) {
            userStates[chatId].tempSchedules = [];
        }

        userStates[chatId].tempSchedules.push({ date: fullDate, time: h });

        const list = userStates[chatId].tempSchedules
            .map((s, i) => `*${i + 1}.* ${s.date} ✧ ${s.time} WIB`)
            .join('\n');

        const txt =
            `${separator}\n🗓️ *Ringkasan Order Penjadwalan*\n${separator}\n` +
            `*Produk*\n${userStates[chatId].productName}\n\n` +
            `*Jadwal Terpilih*\n${list}\n\n` +
            `⚠️ *Penting*\n` +
            `Pastikan saldo bot *sudah terisi dan mencukupi* sebelum waktu eksekusi. Jika saldo tidak mencukupi, proses akan *gagal secara otomatis*.\n${separator}\n+ Silakan tambahkan jadwal lain atau simpan untuk melanjutkan.\n${separator}`;
        const kb = [
            [
                { text: '➕ Tambah Jadwal', callback_data: 'sched_start' },
                { text: '✅ Simpan Jadwal', callback_data: 'sched_confirm_all' }
            ],
            [{ text: '⛔️ Batalkan Proses', callback_data: 'cancel_tx' }]
        ];

        await bot.editMessageText(txt, {
            chat_id: chatId,
            message_id: messageId,
            parse_mode: 'Markdown',
            reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: kb }
        });
    }

    if (data === 'sched_confirm_all') {
        const state = userStates[chatId];

        if (!state || !state.productName || !state.tempSchedules) {
            return bot.editMessageText("⚠️ *Sesi Berakhir Otomatis*\n\nSesi pembelian terputus karena bot baru saja dimulai ulang. Silakan pilih produk kembali dari Menu Utama.", {
                chat_id: chatId,
                message_id: messageId,
                parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                reply_markup: {
                    inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]]
                }
            });
        }

        let rincianJadwal = state.tempSchedules.map((s, i) =>
            `*${i + 1}.* ${s.date} ✧ ${s.time} WIB`
        ).join('\n');

        for (const s of state.tempSchedules) {
            await createSchedule({
                id: 'JDL' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5).toUpperCase(),
                userId: chatId,
                productName: state.productName,
                productCode: state.productCode,
                phoneNumber: state.phoneNumber,
                price: state.price,
                executeDate: s.date,
                executeTime: s.time
            });
        }

        await bot.editMessageText(
            `${separator}\n` +
            `✅ *Jadwal Berhasil Disimpan*\n` +
            `${separator}\n` +
            `\`Produk :\` \`${state.productName}\`\n` +
            `\`Nomor  :\` \`${state.phoneNumber}\`\n\n` +
            `*Daftar Antrean :*\n${rincianJadwal}\n` +
            `${separator}\n` +
            `⚠️ *Penting*\n` +
            `Semua jadwal telah dicatat dan akan diproses otomatis. Pastikan saldo bot *mencukupi* sebelum waktu eksekusi agar tidak gagal otomatis.\n` +
            `${separator}`,
            {
                chat_id: chatId,
                message_id: messageId,
                parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                reply_markup: {
                    inline_keyboard: [
                        [{ text: '🏠 Kembali ke Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]
                    ]
                }
            }
        );

        delete userStates[chatId];
    }

    if (data.startsWith('sched_list_')) {
        const page = parseInt(data.split('_')[2]) || 1;
        await renderJadwalList(chatId, messageId, page);
        return;
    }

    if (data.startsWith('sched_del_exe_')) {
        const parts = data.split('_');
        const jdlId = parts[3];
        const currentPage = parseInt(parts[4]) || 1;

        await deleteSchedule(jdlId);
        await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, {
            text: "✅ Berhasil! Jadwal telah dihapus.",
            show_alert: false
        }).catch(() => { });

        const userSchedulesRemaining = await countUserSchedules(chatId);

        if (userSchedulesRemaining > 0) {
            const maxPageNew = Math.ceil(userSchedulesRemaining / MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
            const finalPage = currentPage > maxPageNew ? maxPageNew : currentPage;
            await renderJadwalList(chatId, messageId, finalPage);

*4. Order Terjadwal* ⏰
