                ...productRows,
                ...(navButtons.length ? [navButtons] : []),
                [{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]
            ];

            await bot.editMessageText(nextText, {
                chat_id: chatId,
                message_id: messageId,
                parse_mode: 'HTML',
                reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: keyboard },
                disable_web_page_preview: true
            });
            return;
        }

        else if (action === 'refresh') {
            loadAndGroupProducts();
            try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, messageId); } catch (e) { }
            await sendMainMenuFinal(chatId, userData);
            return;
        }
    }

    else if (data.startsWith('buy_')) {
        const productCode = data.substring(4);
        const product = getProductByCode(productCode);
        const isAvailable = product && product.buyerStatus && product.sellerStatus && (product.unlimitedStock || (product.stock > 0));

        if (!product || !isAvailable) {
            return bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, {
                text: "⛔️ Produk ini sedang tidak aktif/habis. Silakan pilih produk lain yang bertanda ✅.",
                show_alert: true
            });
        } else {
            userStates[chatId] = {
                step: 'AWAITING_PHONE',
                productCode: product.code,
                productName: product.name,
                price: product.sellingPrice
            };

            let panduanInput = `_Kirim nomor tujuan [ contoh: 0812345xxxx ].\nJika No hp: ✅ 08xx ✅ 628xx ✅ +628xx_`;
            const nameLower = product.name.toLowerCase();

            if (nameLower.includes("free fire")) {
                panduanInput = `_Kirimkan ID Akun Free Fire Anda.\nContoh: 123456789_`;
            } else if (nameLower.includes("mobile legend") || nameLower.includes("mobilelegend")) {
                panduanInput = `_Kirimkan ID + Server Mobile Legends Anda.\nContoh: 12345678(1234) tanpa tanda kurung_`;
            }

            const instructionMessage = `
${separator}
*Detail Pembelian Produk*
${separator}
\`Produk :\` \`${escapeHtml(product.name)}\`
\`Code   :\` \`${escapeHtml(product.code)}\`
\`Detail :\` \`${escapeHtml(product.desc || '-')}\`
\`Harga  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(product.sellingPrice)}\`
${separator}
📝 *Transaksi diproses otomatis. Pastikan nomor/ID tujuan benar. Kesalahan input di luar tanggung jawab penjual.*

${panduanInput}
_Setelah dikirim, konfirmasi Bayar atau Batalkan Proses._
${separator}`;

            const cancelKeyboard = {
                inline_keyboard: [
                    [{ text: '⛔️ Batalkan Proses', callback_data: 'cancel_tx' }]
                ]
            };

            try {
                await bot.editMessageText(instructionMessage, {
                    chat_id: chatId,
                    message_id: messageId,
                    parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                    reply_markup: cancelKeyboard
                });
                await updateUser(chatId, { lastMessageId: messageId });
            } catch (error) {
                if (!error.message.includes('message is not modified')) {
                    const sentMsg = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, instructionMessage, {
                        parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                        reply_markup: cancelKeyboard
                    });
                    await updateUser(chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMsg.message_id });
                }
            }
            await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id);
            return;
        }
    }

    else if (data === 'cancel_tx') {
        await updateUser(userData.chatId, { isMonitoringQris: false });

        const pendingTrx = await pool.query(
            "SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE userId = ? AND status = 'Pending' AND (method = 'QRIS' OR method = 'Saldo Bot') ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1",
            [userData.chatId]
        );

        if (pendingTrx[0].length > 0) {
            await updateTransaction(pendingTrx[0][0].trxId, {
                status: 'Gagal (Dibatalkan)',
                sn: 'N/A'
            });
        } else {
            const pendingTopup = await pool.query(
                "SELECT * FROM topups WHERE userId = ? AND method = 'QRIS' AND status = 'Pending' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1",
                [userData.chatId]
            );

            if (pendingTopup[0].length > 0) {
                await updateTopup(pendingTopup[0][0].trxId, {
                    status: 'Gagal (Dibatalkan)',
                });
            }
        }

        delete userStates[chatId];

        await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, { text: "⛔️ Proses dibatalkan oleh pengguna." });
        try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, messageId); } catch (e) { }
        await sendMainMenuFinal(chatId, userData);
        return;
    }

    else if (data === 'confirm_tx_bot') {
        const state = userStates[chatId];
        const userId = callbackQuery.from.id;

        // 1. Anti-Spam Lock: Cek apakah user sedang dalam proses transaksi
        if (userProcessingLock[userId]) {
            return bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, {
                text: "⚠️ Transaksi sedang diproses, mohon tunggu...",
                show_alert: true
            });
        }

        // 2. Proteksi State
        if (!state || !state.productCode || !state.price) {
            return bot.editMessageText(
                `⚠️ *Sesi Berakhir Otomatis*\n\nSesi pembelian terputus karena bot baru saja dimulai ulang. Silakan pilih produk kembali dari Menu Utama.`,
                {
                    chat_id: chatId,
                    message_id: messageId,
                    parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                    reply_markup: {
                        inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]]
                    }
                }
            ).catch(() => { });
        }

        if (state.step === 'AWAITING_CONFIRM') {
            // Aktifkan pengunci agar klik berikutnya diabaikan
            userProcessingLock[userId] = true;

            const connection = await pool.getConnection();
            try {
                await connection.beginTransaction();

                // Ambil data user fresh dari DB untuk cek saldo terbaru dengan Row Lock
                const [userRows] = await connection.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE chatId = ? FOR UPDATE', [chatId]);
                const currentUserData = userRows[0];

                if (!currentUserData) {
                    await connection.rollback();
                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Data pengguna tidak ditemukan.");
                    return;
                }

                await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, { text: "⏳ Memproses pembayaran Saldo Bot..." });

                const sellingPrice = Number(state.price);
                const refId = `TRX${Date.now()}`;
                let currentSaldo = Number(currentUserData.saldo);

                // 3. Cek Saldo
                if (currentSaldo < sellingPrice) {
                    await connection.rollback();
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Saldo Anda tidak mencukupi untuk melakukan transaksi ini.");
                }

                // Potong Saldo di DB secara Atomis
                await updateBalanceAtomic(chatId, sellingPrice, 'subtract', connection);

                // 4. Panggil API Digiflazz (Di luar transaksi DB jika lambat, tapi di sini kita simpan record dulu sebagai Pending)
                // Kita panggil API sekarang, jika gagal kita rollback saldo.
                const apiResult = await callDigiflazzAPI(refId, state.productCode, state.phoneNumber);
                let status = apiResult.status;
                let apiMessage = apiResult.message;
                let snDetail = apiResult.sn || apiResult.message;

                // Jika API lapor Gagal total, kita kembalikan saldo SEBELUM commit
                if (status === 'Gagal') {
                    await connection.rollback(); // Rollback balance subtraction
                    status = 'Gagal (Error API)';
                    snDetail = 'N/A';
                    
                    // Kita buat record Gagal saja (tanpa potong saldo)
                    await createTransaction({
                        userId: chatId,
                        trxId: refId,
                        time: Date.now(),
                        productName: state.productName,
                        productCode: state.productCode,
                        phoneNumber: state.phoneNumber,
                        price: sellingPrice,
                        method: 'Saldo Bot',
                        status: status,
                        apiMessage: apiMessage,
                        sn: snDetail
                    });
                } else {
                    // Jika sukses atau pending, kita commit pengurangan saldo
                    await connection.query(
                        'INSERT INTO transactions (userId, trxId, time, productName, productCode, phoneNumber, price, method, status, apiMessage, sn) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
                        [chatId, refId, Date.now(), state.productName, state.productCode, state.phoneNumber, sellingPrice, 'Saldo Bot', status, apiMessage, snDetail]
                    );
                    await connection.commit();
                    currentSaldo -= sellingPrice; // Update local variable for UI
                }

                const icon = (status === 'Sukses') ? '✅' : (status === 'Pending' ? '⏳' : '⛔️');

                // 6. Susun Tampilan
                const finalMessage = `
${separator}
${icon} Pembayaran Saldo Bot
${separator}
\`Status :\` \`${status}\`
\`Produk :\` \`${escapeHtml(state.productName)}\`
\`Nomor  :\` \`${state.phoneNumber}\`
\`Harga  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(sellingPrice)}\`
\`Saldo  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(currentSaldo)}\`
${separator}
${status === 'Sukses' ? 'Pemesanan diproses.' : status === 'Pending' ? 'Pesanan Sedang Diproses Otomatis.' : 'Transaksi Dibatalkan atau Gagal.'}
${separator}`;

                delete userStates[chatId];

                // 7. Update Pesan & Simpan messageId ke DB
                const sentMessage = await bot.editMessageText(finalMessage, {
                    chat_id: chatId,
                    message_id: messageId,
                    parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                    reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]] }
                }).catch(() => { });

                if (sentMessage) {
                    await updateUser(chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });
                }

                // Jika gagal, hapus pesan konfirmasi dan kembali ke menu utama setelah 2 detik
                if (status.includes('Gagal')) {
                    await delay(2000);
                    try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, messageId); } catch (e) { }
                    const updatedUser = await getUserById(chatId);
                    await sendMainMenuFinal(chatId, updatedUser);
                }

            } catch (error) {
                console.error("[ERROR TRX BOT]:", error.message);
                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Terjadi kesalahan sistem saat memproses transaksi.");
            } finally {
                // WAJIB: Buka kunci agar user bisa melakukan transaksi lagi nanti
                delete userProcessingLock[userId];
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    else if (data === 'confirm_tx_qris') {
        const state = userStates[chatId];
        const userId = callbackQuery.from.id;

        // 1. Anti-Spam Lock: Cek apakah user sedang dalam proses
        if (userProcessingLock[userId]) {
            return bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, {
                text: "⚠️ Sedang menyiapkan QRIS, mohon tunggu...",
                show_alert: true
            });
        }

        // 2. Proteksi State
        if (!state || !state.productCode || !state.price) {
            return bot.editMessageText(
                `⚠️ *Sesi Berakhir Otomatis*\n\nSesi pembelian terputus karena bot baru saja dimulai ulang. Silakan pilih produk kembali dari Menu Utama.`,
                {
                    chat_id: chatId,
                    message_id: messageId,
                    parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                    reply_markup: {
                        inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: 'main_menu' }]]
                    }
                }
            ).catch(() => { });
        }

        if (state && state.step === 'AWAITING_CONFIRM') {
            // Aktifkan pengunci
            userProcessingLock[userId] = true;

            try {
                // Cek apakah ada QRIS yang masih menggantung
                const pending = await findPendingQris(userData.chatId);
                if (pending) {
                    await sendPendingQrisWarning(chatId, userData, pending);
                    await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, { text: "⚠️ Masih Ada Transaksi QRIS Pending!", show_alert: true });
                    // Langsung keluar dari blok try jika ada pending, lock akan dibuka di finally
                    return;
                }

                // Alert proses
                await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, { text: "⏳ Mempersiapkan QRIS..." });

                const sellingPrice = parseFloat(state.price);
                const reference = `TRX${Date.now()}`;
                const { uniqueAmount, uniqueNumber } = generateUniqueQrisAmount(sellingPrice);
                const currentUserId = callbackQuery.from.id;

                // Generate Gambar QRIS
                const qrString = qrisGen.generateQrString(uniqueAmount, reference);
                const qrBuffer = await qrisGen.generateQRWithLogo(qrString);

                const finalMessage = `
${separator}
💳 *Scan QRIS Untuk Bayar*
${separator}
\`Produk :\` \`${escapeHtml(state.productName)}\`
\`Nomor  :\` \`${state.phoneNumber}\`
\`Harga  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(sellingPrice)}\`
\`Fee    :\` \`Rp${uniqueNumber}\`
\`Total  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(uniqueAmount)}\`
${separator}
_Harap bayar nominal sesuai QRIS.\nPembayaran akan terbatalkan otomatis dalam 5 menit jika tidak ada transaksi masuk._
${separator}`;

                // Kirim Foto QRIS
                const sentQr = await bot.sendPhoto(chatId, qrBuffer, {
                    caption: finalMessage,
                    parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                    reply_markup: {
                        inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '⛔️ Batalkan Transaksi', callback_data: 'cancel_tx' }]]
                    }
                });

                // Catat Transaksi di DB
                await createTransaction({
                    userId: userData.chatId,
                    trxId: reference,
                    time: Date.now(),
                    productName: state.productName,
                    productCode: state.productCode,
                    phoneNumber: state.phoneNumber,
                    price: sellingPrice,
                    method: 'QRIS',
                    status: 'Pending',
                    uniqueAmount: uniqueAmount
                });

                // Hapus pesan tombol konfirmasi sebelumnya
                try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, messageId); } catch (e) { }

                // Jalankan checker mutasi
                startQrisCheck(chatId, currentUserId, reference, uniqueAmount, 'trx', sentQr.message_id);

                // Reset state user
                delete userStates[chatId];

            } catch (error) {
                console.log(`\n[FATAL ERROR QRIS]: ${error.message}`);
                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ Gagal memproses QRIS: ${error.message}`);
            } finally {
                // WAJIB: Buka kunci agar user bisa klik tombol lain nanti
                delete userProcessingLock[userId];
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    if (showAlert) {
        await bot.answerCallbackQuery(callbackQuery.id, {
            text: showAlert, show_alert: true
        });
    }

    if (data === 'main_menu') {
        await sendMainMenuFinal(chatId, userData, messageId);
        return;
    }

    else if (data.startsWith('cat_')) {
        const topups = await getUserTopups(userData.chatId);
        const transactions = await getUserTransactions(userData.chatId);

        const totalTopup = topups.filter(t => t.status === 'Sukses').reduce((sum, t) => sum + parseFloat(t.amount), 0);
        const totalTrx = transactions.filter(t => t.status === 'Sukses').reduce((sum, t) => sum + parseFloat(t.price), 0);

        const category = data.substring(4);
        const brands = groupedProducts[category] ? Object.keys(groupedProducts[category]) : [];
        const newBackData = 'main_menu';

        const nextMenuText = `
█▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀█
█░░╦─╦╔╗╦─╔╗╔╗╔╦╗╔╗░░█
█░░║║║╠─║─║─║║║║║╠─░░█
█░░╚╩╝╚╝╚╝╚╝╚╝╩─╩╚╝░░█
█▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄█

๑۞๑ ${escapeHtml(userData.name)}
${separator}
<code>Chat ID  :</code> <code>${userData.chatId}</code>
<code>Balance  :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(userData.saldo)}</code>
${separator}
<code>TopUp    :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(totalTopup)}</code>
<code>Done TRX :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(totalTrx)}</code>
${separator}
<blockquote><code>Kategori •¯•» ${escapeHtml(category)}</code></blockquote>
${separator}
<code>Pilih Brand Andalan Kalian!</code>
${separator}
    `;
        const brandItems = brands.map(brand => ({
            text: brand,
            callback_data: `brand_${escapeHtml(category)}_${escapeHtml(brand)}`
        }));

        const mainKeyboard = [
            ...brandItems.reduce((rows, item, index) => {
                if (index % 2 === 0) rows.push([]);
                rows[rows.length - 1].push(item);
                return rows;
            }, []),
            [{ text: '🏠 Menu Utama', callback_data: newBackData }]
        ];

        await bot.editMessageText(nextMenuText, {
            chat_id: chatId,
            message_id: messageId,
            parse_mode: 'HTML',
            reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: mainKeyboard },
            disable_web_page_preview: true
        });

        return;
    }

    else if (data.startsWith('brand_')) {
        const topups = await getUserTopups(userData.chatId);
        const transactions = await getUserTransactions(userData.chatId);

        const totalTopup = topups.filter(t => t.status === 'Sukses').reduce((sum, t) => sum + parseFloat(t.amount), 0);
        const totalTrx = transactions.filter(t => t.status === 'Sukses').reduce((sum, t) => sum + parseFloat(t.price), 0);

        const parts = data.split('_');
        const category = parts[1];
        const brand = parts[2];
        const types = groupedProducts[category] && groupedProducts[category][brand] ? Object.keys(groupedProducts[category][brand]) : [];
        const newBackData = `cat_${category}`;

        const nextMenuText = `
█▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀█
█░░╦─╦╔╗╦─╔╗╔╗╔╦╗╔╗░░█
█░░║║║╠─║─║─║║║║║╠─░░█
█░░╚╩╝╚╝╚╝╚╝╚╝╩─╩╚╝░░█
█▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄█

๑۞๑ ${escapeHtml(userData.name)}
${separator}
<code>Chat ID  :</code> <code>${userData.chatId}</code>
<code>Balance  :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(userData.saldo)}</code>
${separator}
<code>TopUp    :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(totalTopup)}</code>
<code>Done TRX :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(totalTrx)}</code>
${separator}
<blockquote><code>Brand •¯•» ${escapeHtml(brand)}</code></blockquote>
${separator}
<code>Pilih Produk Andalan Kalian!</code>
${separator}
    `;
        const typeItems = types.map(type => ({
            text: type,
            callback_data: `type_${escapeHtml(category)}_${escapeHtml(brand)}_${escapeHtml(type)}`
        }));

        const mainKeyboard = createKeyboard(typeItems, newBackData);

        await bot.editMessageText(nextMenuText, {
            chat_id: chatId,
            message_id: messageId,
            parse_mode: 'HTML',
            reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: mainKeyboard },
            disable_web_page_preview: true
        });

        return;
    }

    else if (data.startsWith('type_')) {
        const parts = data.split('_');
        const category = parts[1];
        const brand = parts[2];
        const type = parts[3];
        const page = parseInt(parts[4]) || 1;

        const products = groupedProducts[category][brand][type] || [];
        const totalPages = Math.ceil(products.length / MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
        const startIdx = (page - 1) * MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
        const endIdx = startIdx + MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
        const pageProducts = products.slice(startIdx, endIdx);

        const newBackData = `brand_${category}_${brand}`;
        let nextText = `${separator}\n<blockquote><code>Tipe •¯•» ${escapeHtml(type)}</code></blockquote>\n${separator}\n<code>Daftar Produk [ ${page} / ${totalPages} ]</code>\n${separator}\n`;

        if (pageProducts.length === 0) {
            nextText += "\n⚠️ Data produk tidak ditemukan.";
        } else {
            pageProducts.forEach((p, index) => {
                const isAvailable = p.buyerStatus && p.sellerStatus && (p.unlimitedStock || (p.stock > 0));
                const statusIcon = isAvailable ? '✅' : '⛔️';
                nextText += `<b>${startIdx + index + 1}. ${statusIcon} ${escapeHtml(p.name)}</b>\n` +
                    `Harga : Rp${formatRupiah(p.sellingPrice)}\n` +
                    `Deskripsi : <i>${escapeHtml(p.desc || 'N/A')}</i>\n${separator}\n`;
            });
        }

        const productButtons = pageProducts.map((p, index) => ({
            text: `${startIdx + index + 1}`,
            callback_data: `buy_${escapeHtml(p.code)}`
        }));

        const productRows = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < productButtons.length; i += 3) {
            productRows.push(productButtons.slice(i, i + 3));
        }

        const navButtons = [];
        if (page > 1) navButtons.push({ text: '⬅️', callback_data: `type_${category}_${brand}_${type}_${page - 1}` });
        if (page < totalPages) navButtons.push({ text: '➡️', callback_data: `type_${category}_${brand}_${type}_${page + 1}` });

        const backButton = [{ text: '↩️ Kembali', callback_data: newBackData }];
        const mainButton = [{ text: '🏠 Main Menu', callback_data: 'main_menu' }];

        const keyboard = [...productRows];
        if (navButtons.length) keyboard.push(navButtons);
        keyboard.push(backButton);
        keyboard.push(mainButton);

        try {
            const sentMessage = await bot.editMessageText(nextText, {
                chat_id: chatId,
                message_id: messageId,
                parse_mode: 'HTML',
                reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: keyboard },
                disable_web_page_preview: true
            });
            await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Gagal mengedit pesan (type_):", error.message);
            const sentMessage = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, nextText, {
                parse_mode: 'HTML',
                reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: keyboard },
                disable_web_page_preview: true
            });
            await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });
        }
        return;
    }
});

bot.on('message', async (msg) => {
    const chatId = msg.chat.id;
    const text = msg.text ? msg.text.toLowerCase().trim() : '';
    const rawText = msg.text ? msg.text.trim() : '';
    const isCommand = text.startsWith('/');
    const state = userStates[chatId];
    const userData = await initializeUser(msg.from);
    if (isCommand) {
        const adminId = ADMIN_ID;
        const parts = rawText.split(/\s+/);
        const command = parts[0].toLowerCase();

        if (chatId == adminId) {
            if (command === '/pesan' && parts.length > 1) {
                const content = rawText.substring(7).trim();
                const [targetIdRaw, ...messageParts] = content.split('|');
                const targetId = targetIdRaw ? targetIdRaw.trim() : null;
                const messageToSend = messageParts.join('|').trim();

                if (!targetId || !messageToSend) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Format salah!\nContoh: `/pesan 12345678|Halo kak`", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                const targetUser = await getUserById(targetId);
                if (!targetUser) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ User ID tidak ditemukan.");
                }

                try {
                    await bot.sendMessage(targetId, `📩 *Pesan dari Admin : *\n\n${messageToSend}`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });

                    const successAdmin = `
${separator}
✅ *Pesan Admin Terkirim*
${separator}
\`Nama     :\` \`${escapeHtml(targetUser.name)}\`
\`Chat ID  :\` \`${targetId}\`
\`Status   :\` \`TERKIRIM\`
${separator}`;

                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, successAdmin, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                    logAction(`ADMIN MESSAGE: Mengirim pesan ke ${targetId}`);
                } catch (error) {
                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ Gagal mengirim pesan: ${error.message}`);
                }
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/editnama' && parts.length > 1) {
                const content = rawText.substring(10).trim();
                const [targetId, ...nameParts] = content.split(' ');
                const newName = nameParts.join(' ').trim();

                if (!targetId || !newName) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Format salah!\nContoh: `/editnama 12345678 Nama Baru`", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                const targetUser = await getUserById(targetId);
                if (targetUser) {
                    const oldName = targetUser.name;
                    await updateUser(targetId, { name: newName });

                    const successEdit = `
${separator}
✅ *Nama User Berhasil Diubah*
${separator}
\`Chat ID   :\` \`${targetId}\`
\`Old Name  :\` \`${escapeHtml(oldName)}\`
\`New Name  :\` \`${escapeHtml(newName)}\`
${separator}`;

                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, successEdit, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                    logAction(`ADMIN EDIT: Mengubah nama user ${targetId} menjadi ${newName}`);
                } else {
                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ User ID tidak ditemukan.");
                }
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/edit' && parts.length > 1) {
                const content = rawText.substring(6);
                const [targetName, newDesc] = content.split('|').map(item => item.trim());

                if (!targetName || !newDesc) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Format salah!\nContoh: `/edit XL Xtra Edukasi 15 GB 7 Hari|Deskripsi baru`", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                customDescriptions[targetName] = newDesc;
                saveCustomDesc();
                loadAndGroupProducts();

                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `✅ *Deskripsi Berhasil Diubah!*\n\nProduk : \`${targetName}\` \nDeskripsi Baru : \`${newDesc}\``, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/price' && parts.length === 3) {
                const newMargin = parseInt(parts[1]);
                const newMaxFee = parseInt(parts[2]);

                if (isNaN(newMargin) || isNaN(newMaxFee)) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Format salah. Contoh: `/price 15 2000`", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                const newConfig = { margin: newMargin, max_fee: newMaxFee };

                try {
                    fs.writeFileSync(PRICE_CONFIG_FILE, JSON.stringify(newConfig, null, 2));
                    loadAndGroupProducts();
                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `✅ *Harga Berhasil Diubah!*\n\nMargin : \`${newMargin}%\` \nMax Fee : \`Rp${formatRupiah(newMaxFee)}\`\n\n_Daftar harga telah diperbarui secara otomatis._`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                } catch (error) {
                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Gagal menyimpan konfigurasi harga.");
                }
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/donetopup' && parts.length === 2) {
                const topupIdToDone = parts[1];
                const topup = await getTopupByTrxId(topupIdToDone);

                if (!topup) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ ID TopUp \`${topupIdToDone}\` tidak ditemukan.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                if (topup.status === 'Sukses') {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⚠️ TopUp ini sudah berstatus SUKSES sebelumnya.`);
                }

                const amount = topup.amount;
                const foundUser = await getUserById(topup.userId);

                await updateBalanceAtomic(topup.userId, amount, 'add');
                await updateTopup(topupIdToDone, { status: 'Sukses' });

                const updatedUser = await getUserById(topup.userId);
                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `✅ TopUp \`${topupIdToDone}\` sukses. Saldo User +Rp${formatRupiah(amount)}.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                await bot.sendMessage(foundUser.chatId, `🎉 TopUp Anda ID \`${topupIdToDone}\` sebesar *Rp${formatRupiah(amount)}* telah dikonfirmasi oleh Admin.\nSaldo sekarang: *Rp${formatRupiah(updatedUser.saldo)}*`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });

                const updatedTopup = await getTopupByTrxId(topupIdToDone);
                await sendTrxNotificationToGroup(updatedTopup, 'topup', foundUser);
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/donetrx' && parts.length === 2) {
                const trxIdToDone = parts[1];
                const currentTrx = await getTransactionByTrxId(trxIdToDone);

                if (!currentTrx) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ ID Transaksi \`${trxIdToDone}\` tidak ditemukan.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                if (currentTrx.status === 'Sukses') {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⚠️ Transaksi ini sudah berstatus SUKSES sebelumnya.`);
                }

                const foundUser = await getUserById(currentTrx.userId);
                if (!foundUser) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ Data user untuk transaksi ini tidak ditemukan.`);
                }

                // Variabel untuk template pesan Anda
                const ref_id = trxIdToDone;
                const status = 'Sukses';
                const message = 'Transaksi telah diselesaikan manual oleh Admin';
                const sn = `Manual by Admin (${new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID')})`;
                const icon = '✅';

                // 1. Update status di database lokal
                await updateTransaction(trxIdToDone, { 
                    status: 'Sukses',
                    sn: sn
                });

                // 2. Format pesan sesuai style yang Anda minta
                const updateMessage = `
${separator}
${icon} *Update Cek Status Pesanan*
${separator}
\`Code   :\` \`${ref_id}\`
\`Produk :\` \`${currentTrx.productName || 'N/A'}\`
\`Nomor  :\` \`${currentTrx.phoneNumber || 'N/A'}\`
\`Status :\` \`${status.toUpperCase()}\`
\`Pesan  :\` \`${message}\`
\`Detail :\` \`${sn || 'N/A'}\`
${separator}`;

                // Kirim ke Admin (Konfirmasi)
                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `✅ Berhasil Diselesaikan! \`${trxIdToDone}\``, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });

                // Kirim ke Pengguna (Notifikasi)
                await bot.sendMessage(foundUser.chatId, `${updateMessage}`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });

                // 3. Kirim Notifikasi ke Grup
                try {
                    const updatedTrx = await getTransactionByTrxId(trxIdToDone);
                    await sendTrxNotificationToGroup(updatedTrx, 'pembelian', foundUser);
                    logAction(`ADMIN DONE: Menyelesaikan trx ${trxIdToDone} secara manual.`);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error(`[GROUP NOTIF ERROR] Gagal mengirim ke grup: ${e.message}`);
                }
                
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/refundtrx' && parts.length === 2) {
                const trxIdToRefund = parts[1];
                const trx = await getTransactionByTrxId(trxIdToRefund);

                if (!trx) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ Transaksi dengan ID \`${trxIdToRefund}\` tidak ditemukan.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                if (trx.status.includes('Refund')) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⚠️ Transaksi ini sudah pernah di-refund sebelumnya.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                const refundAmount = trx.price;
                const foundUser = await getUserById(trx.userId);

                if (!foundUser) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ Data user untuk transaksi ini tidak ditemukan.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                const newSaldo = parseFloat(foundUser.saldo) + parseFloat(refundAmount);
                await updateUser(trx.userId, { saldo: newSaldo });
                await updateTransaction(trxIdToRefund, {
                    status: 'Gagal (Admin Refund)',
                    sn: `Refund manual oleh Admin (${new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID')})`
                });

                const date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
                const groupRefundMessage = `
${separator}
Status Refund Saldo Sukses
${separator}
\`✧ User  :\` \`${escapeHtml(foundUser.name || foundUser.username)}\`
\`✧ Code  :\` \`${trxIdToRefund}\`
\`✧ Info  :\` \`${trx.productName || 'N/A'}\`
\`✧ Plus  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(refundAmount)}\`
\`✧ Date  :\` \`${date}\`
${separator}`;

                try {
                    await bot.sendMessage(GROUP_NOTIFICATION_ID, groupRefundMessage, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                    logAction(`Notifikasi REFUND manual untuk ${trxIdToRefund} dikirim ke grup.`);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error(`[GROUP NOTIF ERROR] Gagal mengirim pesan REFUND ke grup: ${e.message}`);
                }

                const adminNotif = `
${separator}
✅ *Status Refund Saldo Sukses*
${separator}
\`ID TRX :\` \`${trxIdToRefund}\`
\`User   :\` \`${escapeHtml(foundUser.name)}\`
\`Refund :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(refundAmount)}\`
\`Saldo  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(newSaldo)}\`
${separator}`;

                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, adminNotif, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                await bot.sendMessage(foundUser.chatId, `🎉 *Refund Berhasil!*\n\nAdmin telah melakukan refund manual untuk transaksi *${trxIdToRefund}* sebesar *Rp${formatRupiah(refundAmount)}*.\n\nSaldo baru: *Rp${formatRupiah(newSaldo)}*`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/mt') {
                const customMessage = parts.slice(1).join(' ');
                isMaintenanceMode = !isMaintenanceMode;
                const statusText = isMaintenanceMode ? 'Aktif' : 'Nonaktif';

                if (isMaintenanceMode && customMessage) {
                    globalMaintenanceMessage = customMessage;
                } else if (!isMaintenanceMode) {
                    globalMaintenanceMessage = "Bot sedang dalam mode maintenance. Mohon coba lagi nanti.";
                }

                let replyMessage = `🛠️ Mode Maintenance *${statusText}*.\n`;
                replyMessage += `Pesan Saat Ini : _${escapeHtml(globalMaintenanceMessage)}_\n`;
                replyMessage += `Semua tombol bot akan memunculkan peringatan maintenance.`;

                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, replyMessage, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/broadcast') {
                userStates[chatId] = { step: 'AWAITING_BROADCAST_MESSAGE' };

                const keyboard = {
                    inline_keyboard: [
                        [{ text: '⛔️ Batalkan Proses', callback_data: 'admin_cancel_broadcast' }]
                    ]
                };

                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "📣 *Mode Broadcast Aktif* 📣\n\nKirim pesan (teks, foto, atau forward pesan lain) yang ingin Anda broadcast ke semua pengguna sekarang.", {
                    parse_mode: 'Markdown',
                    reply_markup: keyboard
                });
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/alluser') {
                const allUsers = await getAllUsers();
                const totalUsers = allUsers.length;
                const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalUsers / MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
                const page = 1;
                const startIdx = 0;
                const endIdx = MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
                const currentPageUsers = allUsers.slice(startIdx, endIdx);

                let nextText = `${separator}\n👥 DAFTAR SELURUH PENGGUNA\n${separator}\n`;
                nextText += `Halaman *${page}* dari *${totalPages}*\n${separator}\n`;

                const detailButtons = [];
                if (currentPageUsers.length > 0) {
                    currentPageUsers.forEach((u, index) => {
                        const itemNumber = startIdx + index + 1;
                        nextText += `*${itemNumber}. ${escapeHtml(u.name)}*\n`;
                        nextText += `\`Chat ID :\` \`${u.chatId}\` \`\nSaldo   :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(u.saldo)}\`\n`;
                        detailButtons.push({
                            text: `${itemNumber}`,
                            callback_data: `admin_user_detail_${u.chatId}_${page}`
                        });
                    });
                    nextText += `${separator}\nPilih Angka Untuk Detail Informasi!\n${separator}`;
                } else {
                    nextText += "Tidak ada data pengguna.";
                }

                const detailRows = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < detailButtons.length; i += 3) {
                    detailRows.push(detailButtons.slice(i, i + 3));
                }

                const paginationButtons = [];
                if (page < totalPages) { paginationButtons.push({ text: `Hal. ${page + 1} ➡️`, callback_data: `admin_alluser_page_${page + 1}` }); }

                const keyboard = [...detailRows];
                if (paginationButtons.length) keyboard.push(paginationButtons);

                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, nextText, { parse_mode: 'Markdown', reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: keyboard } });
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/update') {
                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⏳ Memulai pembaruan daftar harga (Prepaid) dari Digiflazz...", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                const result = await updatePriceList();
                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, result.message, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                if (result.success) { await sendMainMenuFinal(chatId, userData); }
                return;
            }

            if (command === '/info' && parts.length === 2 && /^\d+$/.test(parts[1])) {
                const targetId = parseInt(parts[1]);
                const targetData = await getUserById(targetId);

                if (!targetData) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ User ID \`${targetId}\` tidak ditemukan di database bot.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                const topups = await getUserTopups(targetId);
                const transactions = await getUserTransactions(targetId);

                const totalTopup = topups.filter(t => t.status === 'Sukses').reduce((sum, t) => sum + parseFloat(t.amount || 0), 0);
                const totalTrx = transactions.filter(t => t.status === 'Sukses').reduce((sum, t) => sum + parseFloat(t.price || 0), 0);

                const infoMessage = `
${separator}
*Detail Info Pengguna*
${separator}
\`Name     :\` \`${escapeHtml(targetData.name)}\`
\`User     :\` \`${escapeHtml(targetData.username || '-')}\`
\`Chat ID  :\` \`${targetId}\`
${separator}
\`Saldo    :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(targetData.saldo)}\`
\`Topup    :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(totalTopup)}\`
\`DoneTRX  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(totalTrx)}\`
${separator}`;

                const keyboard = {
                    inline_keyboard: [
                        [{ text: '💎 Cek Status Pesanan', callback_data: `admin_view_trx_${targetId}_1` }],
                        [{ text: '📒 Histori TopUp', callback_data: `admin_view_topup_${targetId}_1` }]
                    ]
                };

                return bot.sendMessage(chatId, infoMessage, { parse_mode: 'Markdown', reply_markup: keyboard });
            }
            if (command === '/topup' && parts.length === 3 && /^\d+$/.test(parts[1]) && /^\d+$/.test(parts[2])) {
                const targetId = parseInt(parts[1]);
                const nominal = parseInt(parts[2]);
                const targetData = await getUserById(targetId);

                if (!targetData) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ User ID \`${targetId}\` tidak ditemukan di database bot.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }
                if (nominal <= 0) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Nominal topup harus lebih besar dari Rp0.");
                }

                await updateBalanceAtomic(targetId, nominal, 'add');
                const updatedUser = await getUserById(targetId);
                const newSaldo = updatedUser.saldo;

                const trxId = `ADMT${Date.now()}`;
                await createTopup({
                    userId: targetId,
                    trxId: trxId,
                    time: Date.now(),
                    amount: nominal,
                    method: 'ADMIN',
                    status: 'Sukses'
                });

                await bot.sendMessage(targetId, `🎉 *TopUp Berhasil!*\n\nAdmin telah menambahkan saldo *Rp${formatRupiah(nominal)}* ke akun Anda. Saldo baru : *Rp${formatRupiah(newSaldo)}*`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });

                const adminNotif = `${separator}\n\`Status TopUp Sukses\`\n${separator}\n\`✧ User  :\` \`${escapeHtml(targetData.name)}\`\n\`✧ Code  :\` \`${trxId}\`\n\`✧ TopUp :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(nominal)}\`\n\`✧ Date  :\` \`${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}\`\n${separator}`.trim();
                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, adminNotif, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });

                const topupData = await getTopupByTrxId(trxId);
                await sendTrxNotificationToGroup(topupData, 'topup', targetData);

                return;
            }

            if (command === '/min' && parts.length === 3 && /^\d+$/.test(parts[1]) && /^\d+$/.test(parts[2])) {
                const targetId = parseInt(parts[1]);
                const nominal = parseInt(parts[2]);
                const targetData = await getUserById(targetId);

                if (!targetData) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ User ID \`${targetId}\` tidak ditemukan di database bot.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }
                if (nominal <= 0) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Nominal pengurangan harus lebih besar dari Rp0.");
                }

                if (parseFloat(targetData.saldo) < nominal) {
                    return bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ Saldo pengguna \`${targetId}\` tidak cukup. Saldo saat ini : Rp${formatRupiah(targetData.saldo)}.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }

                await updateBalanceAtomic(targetId, nominal, 'subtract');
                const updatedUser = await getUserById(targetId);
                const newSaldo = updatedUser.saldo;

                const trxId = `ADMM${Date.now()}`;
                await createTopup({
                    userId: targetId,
                    trxId: trxId,
                    time: Date.now(),
                    amount: nominal * -1,
                    method: 'ADMIN',
                    status: 'Sukses'
                });

                await bot.sendMessage(targetId, `⚠️ *Pengurangan Saldo!*\n\nAdmin telah mengurangi saldo sebesar *Rp${formatRupiah(nominal)}* dari akun Anda. Saldo baru : *Rp${formatRupiah(newSaldo)}*`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });

                const adminNotif = `${separator}\n\`Pengurangan Saldo Sukses\`\n${separator}\n\`✧ User  :\` \`${escapeHtml(targetData.name)}\`\n\`✧ Code  :\` \`${trxId}\`\n\`✧ Minus :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(nominal)}\`\n\`✧ Saldo :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(newSaldo)}\`\n\`✧ Date  :\` \`${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}\`\n${separator}`.trim();
                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, adminNotif, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });

                return;
            }

            if (command === '/infotrx' && parts.length === 2) {
                const trxId = parts[1];
                const trx = await getTransactionByTrxId(trxId);

                if (trx) {
                    const foundUser = await getUserById(trx.userId);

                    const infoMessage = `
${separator}
*Detail Pesanan Produk*
${separator}
\`User     :\` \`${escapeHtml(foundUser ? foundUser.name : 'Unknown')}\`
\`Chat ID  :\` \`${trx.userId}\`
${separator}
\`ID TRX   :\` \`${trx.trxId}\`
\`Waktu    :\` \`${formatWaktu(trx.time)}\`
\`Produk   :\` \`${escapeHtml(trx.productName)}\`
\`Tujuan   :\` \`${trx.phoneNumber}\`
\`Metode   :\` \`${trx.method}\`
\`Harga    :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(trx.price)}\`
\`Status   :\` \`${trx.status}\`
\`Detail   :\` \`${trx.sn || '-'}\`
${separator}`;

                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, infoMessage, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                } else {
                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ Transaksi dengan ID \`${trxId}\` tidak ditemukan.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }
                return;
            }
            if (command === '/infotopup' && parts.length === 2) {
                const trxId = parts[1];
                const topup = await getTopupByTrxId(trxId);

                if (topup) {
                    const foundUser = await getUserById(topup.userId);

                    const infoMessage = `
${separator}
*Detail TopUp Pengguna*
${separator}
\`User     :\` \`${escapeHtml(foundUser ? foundUser.name : 'Unknown')}\`
\`Chat ID  :\` \`${topup.userId}\`
${separator}
\`ID TRX   :\` \`${topup.trxId}
\`Waktu    :\` \`${formatWaktu(topup.time)}\`
\`TopUp    :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(topup.amount)}\`
\`Metode   :\` \`${topup.method}\`
\`Status   :\` \`${topup.status}\`
${separator}`;

                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, infoMessage, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                } else {
                    await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ TopUp dengan ID \`${trxId}\` tidak ditemukan.`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    if (state && state.step === 'AWAITING_BROADCAST_MESSAGE' && chatId === ADMIN_ID) {
        const broadcastText = msg.text || msg.caption || "";
        const foundItems = scanProductsInText(broadcastText);
        let broadcastKeyboard = null;

        if (foundItems.length > 0) {
            const numButtons = foundItems.slice(0, 9).map((item, index) => ({
                text: `${index + 1}`,
                callback_data: `favbuy_${Buffer.from(item.data.name).toString('base64').substring(0, 30)}`
            }));

            const rows = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < numButtons.length; i += 3) {
                rows.push(numButtons.slice(i, i + 3));
            }
            broadcastKeyboard = { inline_keyboard: rows };
        }

        const allUsers = await getAllUsers();
        const allUserIds = allUsers.map(u => u.chatId);
        let successCount = 0;
        let failCount = 0;
        const initialStatus = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⏳ Memulai Broadcast ke *${allUserIds.length}* user...`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });

        for (const targetId of allUserIds) {
            try {
                await bot.copyMessage(targetId, chatId, msg.message_id, {
                    reply_markup: broadcastKeyboard
                });
                successCount++;
            } catch (e) {
                failCount++;
            }
            await delay(50);
        }

        await bot.editMessageText(
            `${separator}\n✅ Broadcast Selesai\n${separator}\n` +
            `\`Sukses :\` \`${successCount}\` user\n` +
            `\`Gagal  :\` \`${failCount}\` user\n` +
            `\`Produk :\` \`${foundItems.length}\` item\n${separator}`,
            { chat_id: chatId, message_id: initialStatus.message_id, parse_mode: 'Markdown' }
        );

        delete userStates[chatId];
        return;
    }

    if (text === 'batal' || text === 'exit' || text === '/batal') {
        if (state && state.step !== 'AWAITING_CONFIRM') {
            await updateUser(userData.chatId, { isMonitoringQris: false });
            delete userStates[chatId];
            await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Transaksi dibatalkan oleh pengguna. Kembali ke Menu Utama.", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
            await sendMainMenuFinal(chatId, userData);
            return;
        }
    }

    if (state && (state.step === 'AWAITING_PHONE' || state.step === 'AWAITING_TOPUP_AMOUNT' || state.step === 'AWAITING_XL_NUMBER')) {

        const sanitizedAmount = sanitizeRupiahInput(rawText);
        const nameLower = (state.productName || "").toLowerCase();
        const isGame = nameLower.includes("free fire") || nameLower.includes("mobile legend") || nameLower.includes("mobilelegend");

        let isInputValidPhone = false;
        if (state.step === 'AWAITING_PHONE' || state.step === 'AWAITING_XL_NUMBER') {
            if (isGame) {
                const cleanDigits = text.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
                isInputValidPhone = cleanDigits.length >= 3;
            } else {
                isInputValidPhone = !!normalizePhoneNumber(text);
            }
        }

        const isInputValidAmount = state.step === 'AWAITING_TOPUP_AMOUNT' && sanitizedAmount >= 1;

        if (isCommand || (!isInputValidPhone && !isInputValidAmount)) {
            await updateUser(userData.chatId, { isMonitoringQris: false });
            delete userStates[chatId];

            if (isCommand) { return; }

            try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, userData.lastMessageId); } catch (e) { }

            await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⚠️ Input dibatalkan otomatis karena format salah atau menerima pesan non-transaksi.", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
            await sendMainMenuFinal(chatId, userData);
            return;
        }
    }

    if (state) {
        if (state.step === 'AWAITING_TOPUP_AMOUNT') {
            const amount = sanitizeRupiahInput(rawText);

            if (isNaN(amount) || amount < 1000) {
                try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, userData.lastMessageId); } catch (e) { }

                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Nominal Harus Angka dan Minimal *Rp1000*. Mohon Masukkan Nominal yang Benar:", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                return;
            }

            try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, userData.lastMessageId); } catch (e) { }

            const loadingMessage = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⏳ Mempersiapkan pembayaran QRIS...", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
            const { uniqueAmount, uniqueNumber } = generateUniqueQrisAmount(amount);
            const amountToShow = amount;
            const reference = `TOPUP${Date.now()}`;
            const userId = userData.chatId;

            try {
                const qrString = qrisGen.generateQrString(uniqueAmount, reference);
                const qrBuffer = await qrisGen.generateQRWithLogo(qrString);
                const qrImagePath = path.join(__dirname, `qr_topup_${chatId}_${reference}.png`);
                fs.writeFileSync(qrImagePath, qrBuffer);

                try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, loadingMessage.message_id); } catch (e) { }

                const sentQr = await bot.sendPhoto(chatId, qrImagePath, {
                    caption: `💳 <b>Scan QRIS Untuk Bayar</b>\n\n` +
                        `<code>ID TRX :</code> <code>${reference}</code>\n` +
                        `<code>TopUp  :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(amountToShow)}</code>\n` +
                        `<code>Fee    :</code> <code>Rp${uniqueNumber}</code>\n` +
                        `<code>Total  :</code> <code>Rp${formatRupiah(uniqueAmount)}</code>\n\n` +
                        `<i>Harap bayar nominal sesuai QRIS.\nPembayaran akan terbatalkan otomatis dalam 5 menit jika tidak ada transaksi masuk.</i>`,
                    parse_mode: 'HTML',
                    reply_markup: {
                        inline_keyboard: [
                            [{ text: '⛔️ Batalkan Transaksi', callback_data: 'cancel_tx' }]
                        ]
                    }
                });

                await createTopup({
                    userId: userData.chatId,
                    trxId: reference,
                    time: Date.now(),
                    amount: amount,
                    method: 'QRIS',
                    status: 'Pending',
                    uniqueAmount: uniqueAmount
                });
                startQrisCheck(chatId, userId, reference, uniqueAmount, 'topup', sentQr.message_id);

                delete userStates[chatId];
                fs.unlinkSync(qrImagePath);

                await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentQr.message_id });

            } catch (error) {
                console.error("[QRIS TOPUP ERROR] Gagal membuat/mengirim QRIS:", error.message);

                try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, loadingMessage.message_id); } catch (e) { }

                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, `⛔️ Gagal memproses QRIS: ${error.message}`, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                delete userStates[chatId];
            }
        }

        else if (state.step === 'AWAITING_XL_NUMBER') {
            try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, userData.lastMessageId); } catch (e) { }
            const normalizedPhone = normalizePhoneNumber(text);

            if (!normalizedPhone || normalizedPhone.length < 10 || normalizedPhone.length > 13) {
                await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Nomor tujuan tidak valid. Mohon masukkan Kembali:", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                return;
            }

            const loadingMessage = await bot.sendMessage(
                chatId,
                `⏳ Sedang melakukan pengecekan kuota untuk nomor \`${normalizedPhone}\`...`,
                { parse_mode: 'Markdown' }
            );

            const messageId = loadingMessage.message_id;

            const result = await cekXL(normalizedPhone);
            let finalMessage;

            if (result.success && result.data) {
                finalMessage =
                    `${separator}\n` +
                    `✅ *Hasil Cek Kuota XL/Axis*\n` +
                    `${separator}\n` +
                    formatResult(result.data) +
                    `${separator}\nCek Kuota By @Gemilangstorebot\n${separator}`;
            } else {
                finalMessage =
                    `${separator}\n❌ *Cek Kuota Gagal*\n${separator}\n` +
                    result.data +
                    `\n${separator}\nCek Kuota By @Gemilangstorebot\n${separator}`;
            }

            await bot.editMessageText(finalMessage, {
                chat_id: chatId,
                message_id: messageId,
                parse_mode: 'Markdown'
            });

            delete userStates[chatId];
            await delay(2000);

            await sendMainMenuFinal(chatId, userData);
        }

        else if (state.step === 'AWAITING_PHONE') {
            try { await bot.deleteMessage(chatId, userData.lastMessageId); } catch (e) { }

            const nameLower = state.productName.toLowerCase();
            let finalDestination = rawText;
            let isGame = nameLower.includes("free fire") || nameLower.includes("mobile legend") || nameLower.includes("mobilelegend");

            if (isGame) {
                finalDestination = rawText.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
                if (finalDestination.length < 3) {
                    const sentMsg = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ ID Akun tidak valid. Harap masukkan angka saja.\nMohon Masukkan Kembali:", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                    await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMsg.message_id });
                    return;
                }
            } else {
                const normalized = normalizePhoneNumber(rawText);
                if (!normalized) {
                    const sentMsg = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⛔️ Format Nomor Tujuan Tidak Valid (Gunakan 08xx, 628xx, atau +628xx). Mohon Masukkan Kembali:", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                    await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMsg.message_id });
                    return;
                }
                finalDestination = normalized;
            }

            state.phoneNumber = finalDestination;
            state.step = 'AWAITING_CONFIRM';
            userStates[chatId] = state;

            const confirmationMessage = `
${separator}
*Konfirmasi Detail Transaksi*
${separator}
\`Produk :\` \`${escapeHtml(state.productName)}\`
\`Code   :\` \`${escapeHtml(state.productCode)}\`
\`Harga  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(state.price)}\`
${separator}
\`Tujuan :\` \`${finalDestination}\`
*Pastikan ${isGame ? 'ID Akun' : 'Nomor Tujuan'} Sudah Benar!*
${separator}`;

            const keyboardOptions = {
                reply_markup: {
                    inline_keyboard: [
                        [
                            { text: '💰 Saldo Bot', callback_data: 'confirm_tx_bot' },
                            { text: '💳 Bayar QRIS', callback_data: 'confirm_tx_qris' }
                        ],
                        [{ text: '⏰ Buat Jadwal', callback_data: 'sched_start' }],
                        [{ text: '⛔️ Batalkan Proses', callback_data: 'cancel_tx' }]
                    ]
                },
                parse_mode: 'Markdown'
            };

            const sentMessage = await bot.sendMessage(chatId, confirmationMessage, keyboardOptions);
            await updateUser(userData.chatId, { lastMessageId: sentMessage.message_id });

        } else if (state.step === 'AWAITING_CONFIRM') {
            await bot.sendMessage(chatId, "⚠️ Mohon tekan tombol *Bayar* atau *Batalkan Proses* di pesan sebelumnya.", { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
        }
    }
});

// ============================
// WEBHOOK HANDLER
// ============================
const app = express();
app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
app.post('/digiflazz-callback', async (req, res) => {
    const digiSignature = req.headers['x-hub-signature'];
    const secretKey = 'gemilangkinasih';
    const payload = req.rawBody || JSON.stringify(req.body);
    const signature = crypto
        .createHmac('sha1', secretKey)
        .update(payload)
        .digest('hex');
    const selfSignature = 'sha1=' + signature;
    if (digiSignature !== selfSignature) {
        logAction(`[WEBHOOK ATTACK] Signature : ${digiSignature}`);
        logAction(`[WEBHOOK ATTACK] Self Signature : ${selfSignature}`);
        logAction(`[WEBHOOK ATTACK] Signature tidak valid dari IP : ${req.ip}`);
        return res.status(401).send('Invalid Signature');
    }

    await saveCallback(req.body);

    const callbackData = req.body.data;


    res.status(200).send({ status: 'success', message: 'Callback received' });

    if (!callbackData || !callbackData.ref_id) {
        return;
    }

    // [RESELLER MULTI-BOT] Forward webhook ke bot reseller yang sesuai berdasarkan suffix _Sn
    const RESELLER_PORT_MAP = {
        '_S2': 12001,
        '_S3': 12002,
        // Tambahkan reseller baru di sini: '_S4': 12003, '_S5': 12004, dst.
    };

    const matchedSuffix = Object.keys(RESELLER_PORT_MAP).find(suffix => callbackData.ref_id.endsWith(suffix));
    if (matchedSuffix) {
        const targetPort = RESELLER_PORT_MAP[matchedSuffix];
        logAction(`[WEBHOOK FORWARD] Meneruskan webhook ke Bot (suffix: ${matchedSuffix}, port: ${targetPort}) untuk Ref: ${callbackData.ref_id}`);

        // Kirim notif ke grup server.js berdasarkan status transaksi reseller
        if (callbackData.status === 'Sukses' || callbackData.status === 'Gagal') {
            try {
                const [mainTrx] = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE trxId = ?', [callbackData.ref_id]);
                const resellerUser = mainTrx.length > 0 ? await getUserById(mainTrx[0].userId) : null;
                if (mainTrx.length > 0 && resellerUser) {
                    const date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
                    const isSukses = callbackData.status === 'Sukses';
                    const statusLabel = isSukses ? 'Status Transaksi Sukses' : 'Status Refund Saldo Sukses';

                    const notifMsg = `
${separator}
${statusLabel}
${separator}
\`✧ Owner :\` \`${escapeHtml(resellerUser.name || resellerUser.username)}\`
\`✧ Code  :\` \`${callbackData.ref_id}\`
\`✧ Info  :\` \`${escapeHtml(mainTrx[0].productName || 'N/A')}\`
\`✧ Via   :\` \`Reseller API\`
\`✧ Pay   :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(mainTrx[0].price)}\`
\`✧ Date  :\` \`${date}\`
${separator}`.trim();
                    await bot.sendMessage(GROUP_NOTIFICATION_ID, notifMsg, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' }).catch(e => {});
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error(`[WEBHOOK RESELLER NOTIF ERROR]: ${e.message}`);
            }
        }

        // Forward ke bot reseller yang sesuai
        axios.post(`http://localhost:${targetPort}/digiflazz-callback`, req.body, {
            headers: { 'x-hub-signature': digiSignature }
        }).catch(e => console.error(`[WEBHOOK FORWARD ERROR] Gagal meneruskan ke port ${targetPort}: ${e.message}`));
        return; // Setop eksekusi di server 1
    }

    const { ref_id, status, message, sn } = callbackData;
    logAction(`WEBHOOK: Callback diterima - Ref: ${ref_id}, Status: ${status}`);

    const foundTransaction = await getTransactionByTrxId(ref_id);
    const foundTopup = foundTransaction ? null : await getTopupByTrxId(ref_id);
    const transactionType = foundTransaction ? 'trx' : (foundTopup ? 'topup' : null);

    if (!transactionType) {
        console.warn(`[WEBHOOK WARNING] Transaksi ${ref_id} tidak ditemukan.`);
        return;
    }

    const currentTrx = foundTransaction || foundTopup;
    const foundUser = await getUserById(currentTrx.userId);
    if (!foundUser) return;

    // Process only if not already in final status
    if (status !== 'Pending' && currentTrx.status !== 'Sukses' && currentTrx.status !== 'Gagal' && !currentTrx.status.includes('Refund')) {
        
        if (status === 'Gagal') {
            if ((currentTrx.method === 'Saldo Bot' || currentTrx.method === 'QRIS' || currentTrx.method === 'Jadwal Otomatis') && transactionType === 'trx') {
                await processRefund(ref_id, foundUser.chatId, currentTrx.price, currentTrx.productName, currentTrx.method, message);
            } else {
                await updateTransaction(ref_id, { status: status, apiMessage: message, sn: sn || 'N/A' });
            }
        } 
        else if (status === 'Sukses' && transactionType === 'topup') {
            const connection = await pool.getConnection();
            try {
                await connection.beginTransaction();
                const [rows] = await connection.query('SELECT status FROM topups WHERE trxId = ? FOR UPDATE', [ref_id]);
                if (rows.length > 0 && rows[0].status === 'Pending') {
                    await updateBalanceAtomic(foundUser.chatId, currentTrx.amount, 'add', connection);
                    await connection.query('UPDATE topups SET status = "Sukses" WHERE trxId = ?', [ref_id]);
                    await connection.commit();
                    
                    const updatedTopup = await getTopupByTrxId(ref_id);
                    await sendTrxNotificationToGroup(updatedTopup, 'topup', foundUser);
                } else {
                    await connection.rollback();
                }
            } catch (e) {
                await connection.rollback();
                console.error("[WEBHOOK ERROR] Topup:", e.message);
            } finally {
                connection.release();
            }
        } 
        else if (status === 'Sukses' && transactionType === 'trx') {
            await updateTransaction(ref_id, { status: status, apiMessage: message, sn: sn || currentTrx.sn });
            const updatedTrx = await getTransactionByTrxId(ref_id);
            await sendTrxNotificationToGroup(updatedTrx, 'trx', foundUser);
        } 
        else {
            if (transactionType === 'trx') {
                await updateTransaction(ref_id, { status: status, apiMessage: message, sn: sn || currentTrx.sn });
            } else {
                await updateTopup(ref_id, { status: status });
            }
        }

        // Final notification for user
        try { await bot.deleteMessage(foundUser.chatId, foundUser.lastMessageId); } catch (e) { }
        const icon = (status === 'Sukses') ? '✅' : '⛔️';
        const updateMessage = `
${separator}
${icon} *Update Cek Status Pesanan*
${separator}
\`Code   :\` \`${ref_id}\`
\`Produk :\` \`${currentTrx.productName || 'N/A'}\`
\`Nomor  :\` \`${currentTrx.phoneNumber || 'N/A'}\`
\`Status :\` \`${status.toUpperCase()}\`
\`Pesan  :\` \`${message}\`
\`Detail :\` \`${sn || 'N/A'}\`
${separator}`;

        await bot.sendMessage(foundUser.chatId, updateMessage, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));

        if (currentTrx.method !== 'Jadwal Otomatis') {
            const updatedUser = await getUserById(foundUser.chatId);
            await sendMainMenuFinal(foundUser.chatId, updatedUser);
        }
    }
});



app.listen(WEBHOOK_PORT, () => {
    logAction(`WEBHOOK: Express server listening on port ${WEBHOOK_PORT}`);
});

// ============================
// SCHEDULED JOB HANDLER
// ============================
function startJadwalWorker() {
    schedule.scheduleJob('* * * * *', async function () {
        const nowWIB = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", { timeZone: "Asia/Jakarta" }));
        const curD = nowWIB.getFullYear() + '-' +
            String(nowWIB.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
            String(nowWIB.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        const curT = String(nowWIB.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' +
            String(nowWIB.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');

        // Check for due schedules
        const dueSchedules = await getDueSchedules(curD, curT);

        for (const j of dueSchedules) {
            const user = await getUserById(j.userId);
            if (!user) continue;

            const productResult = findProductByName(j.productName);
            const latestProduct = productResult ? productResult.data : null;

            if (!latestProduct) {
                const failCode = `FAIL${Date.now()}`;

                await createTransaction({
                    userId: j.userId,
                    trxId: failCode,
                    time: Date.now(),
                    productName: j.productName,
                    phoneNumber: j.phoneNumber,
                    price: j.price,
                    method: 'Jadwal Otomatis',
                    status: 'Gagal (Produk Tidak Tersedia)',
                    sn: 'Produk sudah tidak tersedia'
                });

                await bot.sendMessage(
                    j.userId,
                    `
${separator}
⛔️ *Status Jadwal Otomatis*
${separator}
\`Code   :\` \`${failCode}\`
\`Produk :\` \`${j.productName}\`
\`Nomor  :\` \`${j.phoneNumber}\`
\`Waktu  :\` \`${formatTglJadwal(j.executeDate, j.executeTime)}\`
\`Status :\` \`GAGAL\`
\`Harga  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(j.price)}\`
\`Saldo  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(user.saldo)}\`
\`Detail :\` \`Produk sudah tidak tersedia\`
${separator}`,
                    { parse_mode: 'Markdown' }
                );

                await deleteSchedule(j.id);
                continue;
            }

            const currentPrice = latestProduct.sellingPrice;

            if (parseFloat(user.saldo) >= currentPrice) {
                try {
                    const refId = `SCH${Date.now()}`;
                    
                    // Deduct balance first
                    await updateBalanceAtomic(j.userId, currentPrice, 'subtract');

                    const res = await callDigiflazzAPI(refId, latestProduct.code, j.phoneNumber);

                    if (res.status === 'Gagal') {
                        // Refund immediately if API returns Gagal
                        await processRefund(refId, j.userId, currentPrice, j.productName, 'Jadwal Otomatis', res.message);
                    } else {
                        await createTransaction({
                            userId: j.userId,
                            trxId: refId,
                            time: Date.now(),
                            productName: j.productName,
                            productCode: j.productCode,
                            phoneNumber: j.phoneNumber,
                            price: currentPrice,
                            method: 'Jadwal Otomatis',
                            status: res.status,
                            sn: res.sn || res.message
                        });

                        const updatedUser = await getUserById(j.userId);
                        const successMsg = `
${separator}
✅ *Status Jadwal Otomatis*
${separator}
\`Code   :\` \`${refId}\`
\`Produk :\` \`${j.productName}\`
\`Nomor  :\` \`${j.phoneNumber}\`
\`Waktu  :\` \`${formatTglJadwal(j.executeDate, j.executeTime)}\`
\`Status :\` \`${res.status.toUpperCase()}\`
\`Harga  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(currentPrice)}\`
\`Saldo  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(updatedUser.saldo)}\`
${separator}`;

                        await bot.sendMessage(j.userId, successMsg, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' }).catch(() => {});
                    }

                } catch (err) {
                    const failCode = `FAIL${Date.now()}`;
                    await createTransaction({
                        userId: j.userId,
                        trxId: failCode,
                        time: Date.now(),
                        productName: j.productName,
                        productCode: j.productCode,
                        phoneNumber: j.phoneNumber,
                        price: currentPrice,
                        method: 'Jadwal Otomatis',
                        status: 'Gagal (Error API)',
                        sn: err.message
                    });

                    const failApiMsg = `
${separator}
⛔️ *Status Jadwal Otomatis*
${separator}
\`Code   :\` \`${failCode}\`
\`Produk :\` \`${j.productName}\`
\`Nomor  :\` \`${j.phoneNumber}\`
\`Waktu  :\` \`${formatTglJadwal(j.executeDate, j.executeTime)}\`
\`Status :\` \`GAGAL\`
\`Harga  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(currentPrice)}\`
\`Saldo  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(user.saldo)}\`
\`Detail :\` \`Error API (${err.message})\`
${separator}`;

                    await bot.sendMessage(j.userId, failApiMsg, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
                }
            } else {
                const failCode = `FAIL${Date.now()}`;
                await createTransaction({
                    userId: j.userId,
                    trxId: failCode,
                    time: Date.now(),
                    productName: j.productName,
                    phoneNumber: j.phoneNumber,
                    price: currentPrice,
                    method: 'Jadwal Otomatis',
                    status: 'Gagal (Saldo Kurang)',
                    sn: 'Saldo tidak mencukupi'
                });

                const failSaldoMsg = `
${separator}
⛔️ *Status Jadwal Otomatis*
${separator}
\`Code   :\` \`${failCode}\`
\`Produk :\` \`${j.productName}\`
\`Nomor  :\` \`${j.phoneNumber}\`
\`Waktu  :\` \`${formatTglJadwal(j.executeDate, j.executeTime)}\`
\`Status :\` \`GAGAL\`
\`Harga  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(currentPrice)}\`
\`Saldo  :\` \`Rp${formatRupiah(user.saldo)}\`
\`Detail :\` \`Saldo tidak mencukupi\`
${separator}`;

                await bot.sendMessage(j.userId, failSaldoMsg, { parse_mode: 'Markdown' });
            }
            await deleteSchedule(j.id);
        }

        // Cleanup old schedules
        const currentDateTime = nowWIB.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
        const oldSchedules = await getOldSchedules(currentDateTime);

        for (const oldSched of oldSchedules) {
            logAction(`[CLEANUP] Menghapus jadwal basi user ${oldSched.userId} : ${oldSched.productName} (${oldSched.executeDate} ${oldSched.executeTime})`);
            await deleteSchedule(oldSched.id);
        }
    });
}

// ============================
// INITIALIZATION
// ============================
async function initialize() {
    await initDatabase();
    const isProductLoaded = loadAndGroupProducts();

    if (!isProductLoaded) {
        await updatePriceList(true);
    }

    bot.setMyCommands(
        [{ command: 'start', description: 'Start Bot' }],
        { scope: { type: 'all_private_chats' } }
    );

    bot.setMyCommands([], { scope: { type: 'all_group_chats' } });

    logAction(`${BOT_NAME} sedang berjalan...`);

    startJadwalWorker();
    scheduleMaintenance();
}
initialize();

#!/usr/bin/env node

const path = require('path');
const express = require('express');
const session = require('express-session');

const cfg = require('../config');
const db = require('./lib/database');

const app = express();

app.set('view engine', 'ejs');
app.set('views', path.join(__dirname, 'views'));

app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));

const Store = buildSqliteStore(session);

app.use(session({
  store: new Store(),
  secret: cfg.app.sessionSecret,
  resave: false,
  saveUninitialized: false,
  cookie: { maxAge: 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, httpOnly: true },
}));

function buildSqliteStore(session) {
  const Store = session.Store;
  class SqliteStore extends Store {
    constructor() {
      super();
      db.exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
        sid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        sess TEXT NOT NULL,
        expired INTEGER NOT NULL
      )`);
      setInterval(() => {
        db.prepare('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expired < ?').run(Date.now());
      }, 60000);
    }
    get(sid, cb) {
      const row = db.prepare('SELECT sess FROM sessions WHERE sid=? AND expired > ?').get(sid, Date.now());
      if (!row) return cb(null, null);
      try { cb(null, JSON.parse(row.sess)); } catch (e) { cb(e); }
    }
    set(sid, sess, cb) {
      const ttl = sess.cookie && sess.cookie.maxAge ? sess.cookie.maxAge : 86400000;
      const expired = Date.now() + ttl;
      db.prepare('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sessions (sid, sess, expired) VALUES (?,?,?)').run(sid, JSON.stringify(sess), expired);
      cb && cb(null);
    }
    destroy(sid, cb) {
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE sid=?').run(sid);
      cb && cb(null);
    }
    touch(sid, sess, cb) {
      const ttl = sess.cookie && sess.cookie.maxAge ? sess.cookie.maxAge : 86400000;
      db.prepare('UPDATE sessions SET expired=? WHERE sid=?').run(Date.now() + ttl, sid);
      cb && cb(null);
    }
  }
  return SqliteStore;
}

const { uptimeCache, fetchAllServerStats, getUptimeMap } = require('./lib/serverStats');

app.get('/', async (req, res, next) => {
  if (!req.session.userId) {
    const resellerMinTopup = parseInt(getSetting('reseller_min_topup') || 25000);
    
    const now = new Date();
    now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const todayStr = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    
    const packages = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM vpn_packages WHERE is_active=1').all();
    const discount = parseInt(getSetting('reseller_discount') || 50);

    if (!uptimeCache.isValid()) {
      const fetchRes = await fetchAllServerStats();
      uptimeCache.set(fetchRes);
    }
    const stats = uptimeCache.get() || [];
    const uptimeMap = getUptimeMap(stats);

    const packagesWithPrice = packages.map(p => {
      const activeCount = db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM orders 
        WHERE server_host=? AND status='Aktif' AND vpn_exp > ?
      `).get(p.server_host, todayStr).c;
      
      const uMap = uptimeMap[p.server_host] || { isOnline: false, loadHigh: false, ping: 9999 };
      const isFull = p.max_server > 0 && activeCount >= p.max_server;
      const isRecommended = uMap.isOnline && !isFull && !uMap.loadHigh && uMap.ping < 150 && uMap.ping > 0;

      return {
        ...p,
        active_count: activeCount,
        is_full: isFull,
        is_recommended: isRecommended,
        ping: uMap.ping,
        member_price: p.price,
        member_price_per_day: Math.ceil(p.price / 30),
        reseller_price: Math.ceil(p.price * (1 - discount / 100)),
        reseller_price_per_day: Math.ceil(Math.ceil(p.price * (1 - discount / 100)) / 30)
      };
    });

    packagesWithPrice.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.is_recommended && !b.is_recommended) return -1;
      if (!a.is_recommended && b.is_recommended) return 1;
      if (!a.is_full && b.is_full) return -1;
      if (a.is_full && !b.is_full) return 1;
      if (a.member_price_per_day !== b.member_price_per_day) return a.member_price_per_day - b.member_price_per_day;
      return a.ping - b.ping;
    });

    const grouped = {};
    for (const p of packagesWithPrice) {
      const t = p.vpn_type;
      if (!grouped[t]) grouped[t] = [];
      grouped[t].push(p);
    }
    
    return res.render('landing', { cfg, resellerMinTopup, grouped, rupiah });
  }
  next();
});

// Mengembalikan 10 aktivitas terbaru (topup sukses + order aktif)
// Username disamarkan di sisi klien; di sini cukup kirim data mentah
app.get('/api/public-feed', (req, res) => {
  try {
    // 5 topup sukses terbaru
    const topups = db.prepare(`
      SELECT
        t.trx_id  AS id,
        'topup'   AS type,
        t.amount,
        t.created_at AS time,
        u.username,
        NULL      AS vpn_type
      FROM topups t
      JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.id
      WHERE t.status = 'Sukses'
      ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
      LIMIT 5
    `).all();
 
    // 5 order terbaru
    const orders = db.prepare(`
      SELECT
        o.order_id  AS id,
        'order'     AS type,
        o.price     AS amount,
        o.time,
        u.username,
        o.vpn_type
      FROM orders o
      JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
      ORDER BY o.time DESC
      LIMIT 5
    `).all();
 
    // Gabung, urutkan descending by time, ambil 10 teratas
    const combined = [...topups, ...orders]
      .sort((a, b) => b.time - a.time)
      .slice(0, 10);
 
    res.json(combined);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[public-feed]', e.message);
    res.status(500).json([]);
  }
});
