function checkExpiredOrders() {
  const today = new Date();
  const yyyy = today.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const dd = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const todayStr = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;

  const expired = db.prepare(`
    SELECT id FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'Aktif'
    AND vpn_exp != '-'
    AND vpn_exp < ?
  `).all(todayStr);

  if (expired.length > 0) {
    const ids = expired.map(o => o.id);
    const placeholders = ids.map(() => '?').join(',');
    db.prepare(`UPDATE orders SET status = 'Expired' WHERE id IN (${placeholders})`).run(...ids);
    console.log(`[SCHEDULER] ${expired.length} order diupdate ke status Expired.`);
  }
}

checkExpiredOrders();

});

#!/usr/bin/env node

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const Database = require('better-sqlite3');
const { app } = require('../../config');

const dataDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../data');
if (!fs.existsSync(dataDir)) fs.mkdirSync(dataDir, { recursive: true });

const db = new Database(path.join(dataDir, 'tokovpn.db'));
db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL');
db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON');

db.exec(`
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password TEXT,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  saldo REAL DEFAULT 0,
  is_verified INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  is_admin INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  is_reseller INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  reseller_since INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
  google_id TEXT UNIQUE,
  otp_code TEXT,
  otp_expires INTEGER,
  reset_token TEXT,
  reset_expires INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now') * 1000),
  updated_at INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now') * 1000)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS topups (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  trx_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  time INTEGER NOT NULL,
  amount REAL,
  unique_amount REAL,
  method TEXT DEFAULT 'QRIS',
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'Pending',
  qris_string TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now') * 1000),
  FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  order_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  time INTEGER NOT NULL,
  server_host TEXT,
  server_name TEXT,
  package_name TEXT,
  vpn_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ssh',
  duration INTEGER DEFAULT 30,
  price REAL,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'Aktif',
  vpn_user TEXT,
  vpn_pass TEXT,
  vpn_exp TEXT,
  vpn_auth TEXT,
  vpn_tls TEXT,
  vpn_ntls TEXT,
  vpn_grpc TEXT,
  vpn_isp TEXT,
  vpn_city TEXT,
  vpn_domain TEXT,
  raw_result TEXT,
  package_id INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now') * 1000),
  FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vpn_packages (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  vpn_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  server_host TEXT NOT NULL,
  server_label TEXT,
  duration INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
  price REAL NOT NULL,
  limit_ip INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,
  limit_kuota INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  max_server INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  description TEXT,
  is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now') * 1000)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mutations (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount REAL NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  ref_id TEXT,
  balance_before REAL DEFAULT 0,
  balance_after REAL DEFAULT 0,
  time INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trials (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  vpn_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  server_host TEXT,
  server_name TEXT,
  server_label TEXT,
  vpn_user TEXT,
  vpn_pass TEXT,
  vpn_exp TEXT,
  vpn_auth TEXT,
  vpn_tls TEXT,
  vpn_ntls TEXT,
  vpn_grpc TEXT,
  vpn_isp TEXT,
  vpn_city TEXT,
  vpn_domain TEXT,
  raw_result TEXT,
  time INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now') * 1000),
  FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_topups_trx ON topups(trx_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_user ON orders(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mutations_user ON mutations(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_packages_type ON vpn_packages(vpn_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trials_user ON trials(user_id);
`);

const migrateTrialsColumns = [

# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/lib/helpers.js
#!/usr/bin/env node

const crypto = require('crypto');
const db = require('./database');

function rupiah(n) {
  const v = parseFloat(n);
  if (isNaN(v)) return 'Rp 0';
  return 'Rp ' + Math.floor(v).toLocaleString('id-ID');
}

function otp() {
  return Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000).toString();
}

function token(len = 32) {
  return crypto.randomBytes(len).toString('hex');
}

function orderId() {
  return 'ORD' + Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100);
}

function topupId() {
  return 'DEP' + Date.now() + Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100);
}

function getSetting(key) {
  const r = db.prepare('SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key=?').get(key);
  return r ? r.value : null;
}

function setSetting(key, value) {
  db.prepare('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key,value) VALUES (?,?)').run(key, String(value));
}

function mutation(userId, type, amount, desc, refId, before, after) {
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO mutations (user_id,type,amount,description,ref_id,balance_before,balance_after,time) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(userId, type, amount, desc, refId, before, after, Date.now());
}

function genVpnUser(prefix = 'usr') {
  return prefix + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
}

function genVpnPass(len = 10) {
  return crypto.randomBytes(len).toString('base64').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g,'').slice(0, len);
}

function isReseller(user) {
  return user && user.is_reseller === 1;
}

function resellerPrice(user, originalPrice) {
  if (!isReseller(user)) return parseFloat(originalPrice);
  const discount = parseInt(getSetting('reseller_discount') || 50);
  return Math.ceil(parseFloat(originalPrice) * (1 - discount / 100));
}

function getMaxTrial(user) {
  if (isReseller(user)) {
    return parseInt(getSetting('max_trial_reseller') || 0);
  }
  return parseInt(getSetting('max_trial') || 0);
}

function canTrial(user) {
  // PHP: cek balance == 0 → tidak boleh trial
  if (parseFloat(user.saldo) <= 0) return { ok: false, reason: 'Saldo tidak mencukupi untuk trial.' };
  return { ok: true };
}

function checkResellerUpgrade(user, topupAmount) {
  if (isReseller(user)) return false;
  const minTopup = parseInt(getSetting('reseller_min_topup') || 25000);
  if (parseFloat(topupAmount) >= minTopup) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET is_reseller=1, reseller_since=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(Date.now(), Date.now(), user.id);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function checkResellerDowngrade(userId) {
  const user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(userId);
  if (!user || !isReseller(user)) return false;

  const thirtyDaysLater = (user.reseller_since || user.created_at) + (30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  const now = Date.now();

  if (now < thirtyDaysLater) return { downgraded: false, omzet: 0, reason: 'belum_30_hari' };

  // Hitung total akun aktif milik user (semua tipe)
  const totalAkun = db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM orders WHERE user_id=? AND status='Aktif'`).get(userId).c;

  // Grace period: Reseller dengan akun aktif < 3 → reset timer saja, tidak downgrade
  if (totalAkun < 3) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET reseller_since=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(now, now, userId);
    return { downgraded: false, omzet: 0, reason: 'grace_period' };
  }

  // Cek omzet bulan berjalan (sesuai PHP: MONTH(CURDATE()))
  const minOmzet = parseInt(getSetting('reseller_downgrade_omzet') || 10000);
  const now2 = new Date();
  const firstOfMonth = new Date(now2.getFullYear(), now2.getMonth(), 1).getTime();
  const row = db.prepare(`SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) AS omzet FROM orders WHERE user_id = ? AND status != 'Refund' AND time > ?`).get(userId, firstOfMonth);
  const omzet = parseFloat(row.omzet || 0);

  if (omzet < minOmzet) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET is_reseller=0, reseller_since=NULL, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(now, userId);
    return { downgraded: true, omzet };
  }

  // Lolos: reset timer 30 hari
  db.prepare('UPDATE users SET reseller_since=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(now, now, userId);
  return { downgraded: false, omzet };
}

function getUserOmzet(userId, sinceMs = 0) {
 const row = db.prepare(`
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price), 0) AS omzet 
    FROM orders 
    WHERE user_id = ? 
    AND status NOT IN ('Refund', 'Deleted') 
    AND time > ?
  `).get(userId, sinceMs);
  return parseFloat(row.omzet || 0);
}

module.exports = {
  rupiah, otp, token, orderId, topupId,
  getSetting, setSetting,
  mutation,
  genVpnUser, genVpnPass,
  isReseller, resellerPrice, getMaxTrial, canTrial,
  checkResellerUpgrade, checkResellerDowngrade, getUserOmzet,
};

# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/lib/mailer.js
#!/usr/bin/env node

const nodemailer = require('nodemailer');
const cfg = require('../../config');

function transport() {
  return nodemailer.createTransport({
    host: cfg.smtp.host,
    port: cfg.smtp.port,
    secure: cfg.smtp.secure,
    auth: { user: cfg.smtp.user, pass: cfg.smtp.pass.replace(/\s/g, '') },
    tls: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
  });
}

function wrap(title, sub, body) {
  const year = new Date().getFullYear();
  const site = cfg.app.siteName;
  const siteUrl = cfg.app.siteUrl;
  return `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"></head>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#f0faf9;font-family:'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;">
<div style="max-width:480px;margin:40px auto;background:#ffffff;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(13,148,136,.10),0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.06);">
<div style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d9488,#06b6d4);padding:36px 28px;text-align:center;">
<div style="width:52px;height:52px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:14px;margin:0 auto 14px;text-align:center;line-height:52px;">
<span style="font-size:24px;">🛡️</span>
</div>
<h1 style="color:#ffffff;margin:0 0 6px;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.3px;">${title}</h1>
<p style="color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);margin:0;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;">${sub}</p>
</div>
<div style="padding:32px 28px;">${body}</div>
<div style="background:#f0fdf9;padding:18px 28px;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid #ccfbf1;">
<a href="${siteUrl}" style="color:#0d9488;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;">${site}</a>
<p style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:11px;margin:6px 0 0;">&copy; ${year} ${site}. All rights reserved.</p>
</div>
</div></body></html>`;
}

async function sendOTP(toEmail, name, otp) {
  const body = `
<p style="color:#0f172a;font-size:15px;margin:0 0 6px;font-weight:700;">Halo, ${name}!</p>

# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/lib/qris.js
#!/usr/bin/env node

const qs = require('qs');
const axios = require('axios');
const path = require('path');
const { QRISGenerator } = require('autoft-qris');
const cfg = require('../../config');

function crc16(str) {
  let c = 0xFFFF;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    c ^= str.charCodeAt(i) << 8;
    for (let j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
      c = (c & 0x8000)
        ? ((c << 1) ^ 0x1021) & 0xFFFF
        : (c << 1) & 0xFFFF;
    }
  }
  return c.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(4, '0');
}

function buildQrisString(amount) {
  const base = cfg.qris.baseString;
  if (!base) return null;

  try {
    const a = Math.floor(amount).toString();
    const field = '54' + String(a.length).padStart(2, '0') + a;
    const stripped = base.replace(/6304.{4}$/, '');
    const raw = stripped + field + '6304';
    return raw + crc16(raw);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function uniqueAmount(base) {
  const n = Math.floor(Math.random() * 101) + 100;
  return {
    uniqueAmount: Math.floor(base) + n,
    uniqueNumber: n
  };
}

async function qrisImageUrl(str) {
  try {
    const QRIS_CONFIG = {
      storeName: cfg.qris.storeName,
      auth_username: cfg.qris.authUsername,
      auth_token: cfg.qris.authToken,
      baseQrString: str,
      logoPath: path.join(__dirname, '../../', cfg.qris.qrisLogo)
    };

    const qrisGen = new QRISGenerator(QRIS_CONFIG, 'theme1');
    const buffer = await qrisGen.generateQRWithLogo(str);
    return `data:image/png;base64,${buffer.toString('base64')}`;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('QRIS Gen Error:', err);
    return `https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=400x400&data=${encodeURIComponent(str)}`;
  }
}

let mutationCache = {
  data: null,
  timestamp: 0,
  TTL: 30 * 1000 // Cache berlaku selama 30 detik
};

async function fetchMutations() {
  // Gunakan cache jika masih fresh
  if (mutationCache.data && (Date.now() - mutationCache.timestamp < mutationCache.TTL)) {
    return mutationCache.data;
  }

  try {
    const payload = qs.stringify({
      username: cfg.qris.authUsername,
      token: cfg.qris.authToken,
    });

    const res = await axios.post(
      cfg.qris.apiEndpoint + '?t=' + Date.now(),
      payload,
      {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
          'Origin': 'https://pg-tokovpn.pages.dev',
          'Referer': 'https://pg-tokovpn.pages.dev/',
          'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'
        },
        timeout: 10000
      }
    );

    if (res.data && res.data.results) {
      // Update cache
      mutationCache.data = res.data.results;
      mutationCache.timestamp = Date.now();
      return res.data.results;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[QRIS] Gagal ambil mutasi:', err.message);
  }
  return null;
}

async function checkPayment(uAmount, startTime, trxId = '-', username = '-', preFetchedMutations = null) {
  const trunc = new Date(startTime);
  trunc.setSeconds(0, 0);
  const tStart = trunc.getTime();
  const expected = Math.floor(uAmount).toString();

  console.log(`[QRIS] Check Trx: ${trxId} | User: ${username}`);
  console.log(`[QRIS] Mengecek pembayaran: Rp ${uAmount} (Mulai: ${new Date(startTime).toLocaleString('id-ID')})`);

  try {
    let mutations = preFetchedMutations;

    // Jika tidak ada data pre-fetched, ambil sendiri (untuk UI/Browser)
    if (!mutations) {
      mutations = await fetchMutations();
    }

    if (!mutations) {
      console.error('[QRIS] Gagal: Data mutasi tidak tersedia.');
      return { status: 'ERROR', message: 'API invalid / results kosong!' };
    }

    const totalTrx = mutations.length;
    
    // Hanya print sampel jika baru ambil (bukan pre-fetched) agar tidak spam log background
    if (!preFetchedMutations && totalTrx > 0) {
      console.log(`[QRIS] Diterima ${totalTrx} data mutasi dari API.`);
      console.log('─── SAMPLING 3 DATA MUTASI TERAKHIR ───');
      mutations.slice(0, 3).forEach((t, i) => {
        console.log(`  [${i + 1}] ${t.tanggal} | Rp ${t.kredit.padEnd(8)} | ${t.status} | ${t.keterangan}`);
      });
      console.log('───────────────────────────────────────');
    }

    let poolCount = 0;
    let poolOldest = Date.now();

    const matches = mutations.filter(t => {
      if (!t) return false;

      const kreditClean = (t.kredit || '').toString().replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
      const isAmountMatch = kreditClean === expected;
      const isIN = t.status === 'IN';

      if (!t.tanggal) return false;
      const [dp, tp = '0:0:0'] = t.tanggal.split(' ');
      const [d, m, y] = dp.split('/');
      const trxTime = new Date(y, m - 1, d, ...tp.split(':')).getTime();
      
      if (trxTime < poolOldest) poolOldest = trxTime;
      if (isIN && isAmountMatch) poolCount++;

      const isTimeValid = trxTime >= tStart;

      if (isAmountMatch && !preFetchedMutations) {
         console.log(`[QRIS] Cek Mutasi: Nominal cocok (${kreditClean}), Status IN: ${isIN}, Waktu Valid: ${isTimeValid} (Trx: ${t.tanggal})`);
      }

      return isIN && isAmountMatch && isTimeValid;
    });

    if (matches.length > 0) {
      console.log(`[QRIS] BERHASIL: Ditemukan pembayaran cocok untuk nominal Rp ${uAmount}`);
      return {
        status: 'PAID',
        message: `Ditemukan: ${matches[0].keterangan}`,
        matchCount: matches.length,
        poolCount: poolCount,
        poolOldest: poolOldest
      };
    }

    if (!preFetchedMutations) {
      console.log(`[QRIS] BELUM BAYAR: Tidak ada mutasi masuk yang cocok untuk Rp ${uAmount}`);
    }
    
    return {
      status: 'UNPAID',
      message: 'Belum ditemukan!',
      matchCount: 0,
      poolCount: poolCount,
      poolOldest: poolOldest
    };

  } catch (e) {
    const msg = e.response ? JSON.stringify(e.response.data) : e.message;
    console.error(`[QRIS] ERROR saat cek pembayaran: ${msg}`);
    return {
      status: 'ERROR',
      message: msg.substring(0, 100)
    };
  }
}

module.exports = {
  buildQrisString,
  uniqueAmount,
  qrisImageUrl,
  fetchMutations,
  checkPayment
};

# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/lib/scheduler.js
#!/usr/bin/env node

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const axios = require('axios');
const FormData = require('form-data');
const { execSync } = require('child_process');

const db = require('./database');
const cfg = require('../../config');
const { checkResellerDowngrade } = require('./helpers');
const { processAllPendingTopups } = require('./topup_processor');

function runResellerDowngradeCheck() {
  console.log('[SCHEDULER] Menjalankan cek downgrade reseller...');
  const resellers = db.prepare('SELECT id, username FROM users WHERE is_reseller=1').all();
  let downgraded = 0;
  for (const user of resellers) {
    const result = checkResellerDowngrade(user.id);
    if (result && result.downgraded) {
      downgraded++;
      console.log(`[SCHEDULER] Reseller ${user.username} diturunkan ke Member (omzet 30d: ${result.omzet})`);
    }
  }
  console.log(`[SCHEDULER] Selesai. ${downgraded} diturunkan dari ${resellers.length} reseller.`);
}

function runTopupCleanup() {
  console.log('[SCHEDULER] Menjalankan pembersihan topup...');
  try {
    const fifteenMinsAgo = Date.now() - 15 * 60 * 1000;
    const expired = db.prepare("UPDATE topups SET status='Gagal (Expired)' WHERE status IN ('Pending', 'Checking') AND time < ?").run(fifteenMinsAgo);
    const fiveMinsAgo = Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 1000;
    const reset = db.prepare("UPDATE topups SET status='Pending' WHERE status='Checking' AND time < ? AND time >= ?").run(fiveMinsAgo, fifteenMinsAgo);

    if (expired.changes > 0 || reset.changes > 0) {
      console.log(`[SCHEDULER] Topup Cleanup: ${expired.changes} expired, ${reset.changes} stuck reset.`);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[SCHEDULER] Gagal membersihkan topup:', e.message);
  }
}

function scheduleNextMidnight(fn) {
  const now = new Date();
  const next = new Date(now);
  next.setDate(next.getDate() + 1);
  next.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const ms = next.getTime() - now.getTime();
  setTimeout(() => {
    fn();
    setInterval(fn, 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  }, ms);
  console.log(`[SCHEDULER] Cek downgrade berikutnya dalam ${Math.round(ms / 60000)} menit.`);
}

async function sendTelegramBackupNotif(text) {
  const token = cfg.backup.botToken;
  const chatId = cfg.backup.chatId;
  if (!token || !chatId) return;
  try {
    await axios.post(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/sendMessage`, {
      chat_id: chatId,
      text,
      parse_mode: 'HTML',
      disable_web_page_preview: true,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[BACKUP] Gagal kirim notif Telegram:', e.message);
  }
}

async function uploadBackup(zipPath) {
  const form = new FormData();
  form.append('file', fs.createReadStream(zipPath));
  const res = await axios.post(cfg.backup.uploadEndpoint, form, {
    headers: form.getHeaders(),
    timeout: 60000,
  });
  return res.data;
}

async function runDatabaseBackup() {
  if (!cfg.backup || !cfg.backup.enabled) return;

  const backupDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../data/backup_tmp');
  const dataDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../data');
  const zipName = 'tokovpnweb.zip';
  const zipPath = path.join(dataDir, zipName);

  const files = [
    path.join(dataDir, 'tokovpn.db'),
    path.join(dataDir, 'tokovpn.db-shm'),
    path.join(dataDir, 'tokovpn.db-wal'),
  ];

  try {
    console.log('[BACKUP] Memulai backup database...');

    if (!fs.existsSync(backupDir)) fs.mkdirSync(backupDir, { recursive: true });

    for (const f of files) {
      if (fs.existsSync(f)) {
        fs.copyFileSync(f, path.join(backupDir, path.basename(f)));
      }
    }

    const copiedFiles = files
      .map(f => path.join(backupDir, path.basename(f)))
      .filter(f => fs.existsSync(f))
      .map(f => `"${f}"`)
      .join(' ');

    if (fs.existsSync(zipPath)) fs.rmSync(zipPath, { force: true });

    execSync(`zip -j "${zipPath}" ${copiedFiles}`, { stdio: 'ignore' });

    fs.rmSync(backupDir, { recursive: true, force: true });

    const raw = await uploadBackup(zipPath);
    let backupUrl = '';
    if (typeof raw === 'object') {
      backupUrl = raw.url || JSON.stringify(raw);
    } else {
      backupUrl = String(raw).trim();
    }

    fs.rmSync(zipPath, { force: true });

    const now = new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta' });
    const [datePart, timePart] = now.split(', ');

    const text =
`──────────────────────
Backup Database Success
──────────────────────
<code>✧ Host :</code> <code>${cfg.backup.host}</code>
<code>✧ Date :</code> <code>${datePart}</code>
<code>✧ Time :</code> <code>${timePart}</code>
──────────────────────
Link Backup :
${backupUrl}
──────────────────────
Notifikasi By <a href="https://tokovpn.com/">TokoVPN.com</a>
──────────────────────`;

    await sendTelegramBackupNotif(text);
    console.log(`[BACKUP] Selesai. URL: ${backupUrl}`);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[BACKUP] Gagal:', e.message);
    if (fs.existsSync(backupDir)) fs.rmSync(backupDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    if (fs.existsSync(zipPath)) fs.rmSync(zipPath, { force: true });
  }
}

function scheduleBackup() {
  if (!cfg.backup || !cfg.backup.enabled) return;

  const intervalMs = cfg.backup.intervalHours * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const now = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta' }));
  const currentHour = now.getHours();
  const currentMinute = now.getMinutes();
  const currentSecond = now.getSeconds();

  const scheduleHours = [];
  for (let h = 0; h < 24; h += cfg.backup.intervalHours) {
    scheduleHours.push(h);
  }

  let nextHour = scheduleHours.find(h => h > currentHour);
  if (nextHour === undefined) nextHour = scheduleHours[0] + 24;

  const msUntilNext =
    ((nextHour - currentHour) * 60 * 60 * 1000) -
    (currentMinute * 60 * 1000) -
    (currentSecond * 1000);

  console.log(`[BACKUP] Backup pertama dalam ${Math.round(msUntilNext / 60000)} menit (jam ${nextHour % 24}:00 WIB).`);

  setTimeout(() => {
    runDatabaseBackup();
    setInterval(runDatabaseBackup, intervalMs);
  }, msUntilNext);
}

function startScheduler() {
  runResellerDowngradeCheck();
  scheduleNextMidnight(runResellerDowngradeCheck);
  runTopupCleanup();
  setInterval(runTopupCleanup, 60 * 1000);
  processAllPendingTopups();
  setInterval(processAllPendingTopups, 60 * 1000);
  scheduleBackup();
}

module.exports = { startScheduler, runResellerDowngradeCheck, runDatabaseBackup };


# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/lib/serverStats.js
const axios = require('axios');
const db = require('./database');

const uptimeCache = {
  data: null,
  lastFetch: null,
  TTL: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  isValid() { return this.data && this.lastFetch && (Date.now() - this.lastFetch) < this.TTL; },
  set(data) { this.data = data; this.lastFetch = Date.now(); },
  get() { return this.data; }
};

async function fetchAllServerStats() {
  const servers = db.prepare(
    `SELECT DISTINCT server_host, server_label, name FROM vpn_packages WHERE is_active=1 ORDER BY sort_order`
  ).all();
  const statsPromises = servers.map(async (srv) => {
    const url = `http://${srv.server_host}:7070/stats`;
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(url, { timeout: 5000 });
      const data = response.data;
      const ping = Date.now() - startTime;
      const cpuTotal = typeof data.cpu === 'object' ? data.cpu.total : data.cpu;
      let memUsed = 0, memTotal = 0, memPercent = 0;
      if (typeof data.memory === 'string') {
        const memMatch = data.memory.match(/(\d+)\/(\d+)\s*MB\s*\((\d+)%\)/);
        if (memMatch) { memUsed = parseInt(memMatch[1]); memTotal = parseInt(memMatch[2]); memPercent = parseInt(memMatch[3]); }
      }
      let diskUsed = '-', diskTotal = '-', diskPercent = 0;
      if (typeof data.disk === 'string') {
        const diskMatch = data.disk.match(/^(\S+)\/(\S+)\s*\((\d+)%\)/);
        if (diskMatch) { diskUsed = diskMatch[1]; diskTotal = diskMatch[2]; diskPercent = parseInt(diskMatch[3]); }
      }
      const rxMB = data.network ? (data.network.rx_bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) : 0;
      const txMB = data.network ? (data.network.tx_bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) : 0;
      const rxDisplay = rxMB > 1024 ? (rxMB / 1024).toFixed(2) + ' GB' : rxMB + ' MB';
      const txDisplay = txMB > 1024 ? (txMB / 1024).toFixed(2) + ' GB' : txMB + ' MB';
      return { server_host: srv.server_host, server_label: srv.server_label || srv.server_host, server_name: srv.name, status: 'online', ping, cpu: cpuTotal || 0, cpu_per_core: (typeof data.cpu === 'object' && data.cpu.per_core) ? data.cpu.per_core : [], mem_used: memUsed, mem_total: memTotal, mem_percent: memPercent, disk_used: diskUsed, disk_total: diskTotal, disk_percent: diskPercent, uptime: data.uptime || '-', load: data.load || '-', rx: rxDisplay, tx: txDisplay, response_ms: data.response_ms || ping };
    } catch (err) {
      return { server_host: srv.server_host, server_label: srv.server_label || srv.server_host, server_name: srv.name, status: 'offline', ping: null, cpu: 0, cpu_per_core: [], mem_used: 0, mem_total: 0, mem_percent: 0, disk_used: '-', disk_total: '-', disk_percent: 0, uptime: '-', load: '-', rx: '-', tx: '-', response_ms: null, error: err.message };
    }
  });
  return await Promise.all(statsPromises);
}

function getUptimeMap(stats) {
  const uptimeMap = {};
  stats.forEach(s => {
    let loadHigh = false;
    if (s.status === 'online' && s.load && s.load !== '-') {
      const cs = s.cpu_per_core && s.cpu_per_core.length > 0 ? s.cpu_per_core.length : 1;
      const pts = s.load.replace(/\s/g,'').split(',');
      if (pts[0] && parseFloat(pts[0]) / cs >= 1.5) {
        loadHigh = true;
      }
    }
    uptimeMap[s.server_host] = {
      isOnline: s.status === 'online',
      loadHigh: loadHigh,
      ping: s.ping || 9999
    };
  });
  return uptimeMap;
}

module.exports = {
  uptimeCache,
  fetchAllServerStats,
  getUptimeMap
};

# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/lib/telenotif.js
/**
 * telenotif.js
 * Kirim notifikasi ke grup Telegram untuk semua event transaksi.
 * Letakkan file ini di: lib/telenotif.js
 * Lalu panggil dari routes/user.js setelah setiap transaksi sukses.
 */

const cfg = require('../../config');

/**
 * Kirim pesan HTML ke grup Telegram.
 * @param {string} html - Pesan dalam format HTML Telegram
 */
async function sendTelegramNotif(html) {
  const token = cfg.tokenbot.tokentelebot; 
  const chatId = cfg.tokenbot.idtelegrub;
  
  if (!token || !chatId) return;

  const url = `https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/sendMessage`;
  try {
    await fetch(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        chat_id: chatId,
        text: html,
        parse_mode: 'HTML',
        disable_web_page_preview: true,
      }),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[TeleNotif] Gagal kirim notif:', e.message);
  }
}

/**
 * Format tanggal ke YYYY-MM-DD
 */
function today() {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/**
 * Format rupiah tanpa import helper (standalone)
 */
function rp(n) {
  return 'Rp' + Number(n).toLocaleString('id-ID');
}

/**
 * Deteksi role user: cek is_reseller (dari DB) ATAU u.role (jika di-set manual)
 * FIX: Sebelumnya hanya cek u.role yang tidak pernah di-set, sehingga selalu "Member"
 */
function getRole(u) {
  return (u.is_reseller === 1 || u.role === 'reseller') ? 'Reseller' : 'Member';
}

  const payAmount = paid ?? top.amount;

<code>✧ Pay   :</code> <code>${rp(payAmount)}</code>
<code>✧ Total :</code> <code>${rp(totalAmount)}</code>

Notifikasi By <a href="https://tokovpn.com/">TokoVPN.com</a>

# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/lib/topup_processor.js
#!/usr/bin/env node

const db = require('./database');
const { mutation, checkResellerUpgrade } = require('./helpers');
const { checkPayment, fetchMutations } = require('./qris');
const { notifTopup } = require('./telenotif');

async function processTopupById(trxId, preFetchedMutations = null) {
  const top = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM topups WHERE trx_id=?").get(trxId);
  if (!top) return { status: 'not_found' };
  if (top.status === 'Sukses') return { status: 'success' };
  
  // Ambil user
  const u = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?").get(top.user_id);
  if (!u) return { status: 'user_not_found' };

  // 1. Cek Kadaluarsa (15 menit)
  const elapsed = Date.now() - top.time;
  if (elapsed >= 15 * 60 * 1000) {
    db.prepare("UPDATE topups SET status='Gagal (Expired)' WHERE trx_id=?").run(top.trx_id);
    return { status: 'expired' };
  }

  // 2. Lock status agar tidak double process (khusus background <-> foreground)
  const locked = db.prepare(
    "UPDATE topups SET status='Checking' WHERE trx_id=? AND status='Pending'"
  ).run(top.trx_id);

  // Jika gagal lock, mungkin sedang di-check oleh request lain
  if (locked.changes === 0 && top.status !== 'Checking') {
    const fStatus = db.prepare('SELECT status FROM topups WHERE trx_id=?').get(top.trx_id);
    if (fStatus.status === 'Sukses') return { status: 'success' };
    return { status: 'locked' };
  }

  try {
    const result = await checkPayment(top.unique_amount, top.time, top.trx_id, u.username, preFetchedMutations);

    if (result.status === 'PAID') {
      const processTopupTransaction = db.transaction(() => {
        // Double check status di dalam transaksi
        const current = db.prepare('SELECT status, amount, unique_amount FROM topups WHERE trx_id=?').get(top.trx_id);
        if (!current || current.status === 'Sukses') return null;

        // Anti-duplikasi mutation
        // Gunakan poolOldest dari hasil API untuk memfilter topup sukses yang relevan
        const checkFloor = result.poolOldest || (Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        const alreadySuccessCount = db.prepare(`
          SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM topups 
          WHERE unique_amount = ? AND status = 'Sukses' AND time >= ?
        `).get(top.unique_amount, checkFloor).c;

        if (alreadySuccessCount >= (result.poolCount || result.matchCount || 0)) {
          return { error: 'already_claimed' };
        }

        // Simpan sebagai SUKSES
        const updateRes = db.prepare("UPDATE topups SET status='Sukses' WHERE trx_id=? AND status != 'Sukses'").run(top.trx_id);
        if (updateRes.changes === 0) return null;

        // Update Saldo
        const addAmount = parseFloat(top.amount);
        const freshUser = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(u.id);
        const before = parseFloat(freshUser.saldo);
        const after = before + addAmount;

        db.prepare('UPDATE users SET saldo=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(after, Date.now(), u.id);
        mutation(u.id, 'TOPUP', addAmount, 'Topup QRIS', top.trx_id, before, after);

        return { fresh: freshUser, before, after, amount: addAmount, bonus: 0 };
      });

      const txResult = processTopupTransaction();

      if (!txResult) return { status: 'success' };
      if (txResult.error === 'already_claimed') {
        process.stdout.write(`[QRIS] Duplicate Claim: TRX ${top.trx_id} ditolak karena nominal Rp ${top.unique_amount} sudah digunakan topup lain.\n`);
        db.prepare("UPDATE topups SET status='Pending' WHERE trx_id=?").run(top.trx_id);
        return { status: 'pending', message: 'Sudah diklaim' };
      }

      // Upgrade reseller check
      const upgraded = checkResellerUpgrade(txResult.fresh, txResult.amount);
      const freshAfterUpgrade = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(u.id);
      
      // Kirim notifikasi
      notifTopup(freshAfterUpgrade, top, 0, top.unique_amount, top.amount).catch(() => {});
      
      return { status: 'success', reseller_upgraded: upgraded };
    } else {
      // Kembalikan ke Pending jika belum bayar
      db.prepare("UPDATE topups SET status='Pending' WHERE trx_id=? AND status='Checking'").run(top.trx_id);
      return { status: 'pending' };
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[PROCESSOR] Gagal cek TRX ${trxId}:`, err.message);
    db.prepare("UPDATE topups SET status='Pending' WHERE trx_id=? AND status='Checking'").run(top.trx_id);
    return { status: 'error', message: err.message };
  }
}

let isProcessingBackground = false;

async function processAllPendingTopups() {
  if (isProcessingBackground) return; // Skip jika siklus sebelumnya belum selesai
  isProcessingBackground = true;

  try {
    const pendingList = db.prepare("SELECT trx_id FROM topups WHERE status='Pending'").all();
    if (pendingList.length > 0) {
      // 1. Ambil mutasi SEKALI untuk semua user pending
      const mutations = await fetchMutations();
      if (!mutations) {
        console.log('[PROCESSOR] Skip background check: Gagal mengambil mutasi.');
        return;
      }

      console.log(`[PROCESSOR] Memulai cek background untuk ${pendingList.length} topup pending (1 mutasi untuk semua)...`);
      
      // Log sampel mutasi yang baru diambil
      console.log(`[PROCESSOR] Diterima ${mutations.length} data mutasi dari API.`);
      console.log('─── SAMPLING 3 DATA MUTASI TERAKHIR (BACKGROUND) ───');
      mutations.slice(0, 3).forEach((t, i) => {
        console.log(`  [${i + 1}] ${t.tanggal} | Rp ${t.kredit.padEnd(8)} | ${t.status} | ${t.keterangan}`);
      });
      console.log('────────────────────────────────────────────────────');

      for (const item of pendingList) {
        try {
          await processTopupById(item.trx_id, mutations);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(`[PROCESSOR] Gagal memproses ${item.trx_id}:`, e.message);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[PROCESSOR] Global Error:`, err.message);
  } finally {
    isProcessingBackground = false; // Reset flag saat selesai untuk siklus berikutnya
  }
}

module.exports = { processTopupById, processAllPendingTopups };

# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/lib/vpnapi.js
#!/usr/bin/env node

const axios = require('axios');
const cfg = require('../../config');

const BASE = cfg.tokovpnapi.base;
const CRED = cfg.tokovpnapi.credential;

async function execCmd(command, domain, payload = []) {
  const res = await axios.post(`${BASE}/api/exec`, {
    command,
    domain,
    credential: CRED,
    payload,
  });
  return res.data;
}

async function addSSH(domain, username, password, limitIp, exp) {
  return execCmd('addsshbot', domain, [username, password, limitIp, exp]);
}

async function addVMess(domain, username, limitIp, limitKuota, exp) {
  return execCmd('addvmessbot', domain, [username, limitIp, limitKuota, exp]);
}

async function addVLess(domain, username, limitIp, limitKuota, exp) {
  return execCmd('addvlessbot', domain, [username, limitIp, limitKuota, exp]);
}

async function addTrojan(domain, username, limitIp, limitKuota, exp) {
  return execCmd('addtrojanbot', domain, [username, limitIp, limitKuota, exp]);
}

async function createAccount(vpnType, domain, username, password, limitIp, limitKuota, exp) {
  if (vpnType === 'ssh') return addSSH(domain, username, password, limitIp, exp);
  if (vpnType === 'vmess') return addVMess(domain, username, limitIp, limitKuota, exp);
  if (vpnType === 'vless') return addVLess(domain, username, limitIp, limitKuota, exp);
  if (vpnType === 'trojan') return addTrojan(domain, username, limitIp, limitKuota, exp);
  throw new Error(`Tipe VPN tidak dikenal: ${vpnType}`);
}

async function renewSSH(domain, username, exp) {
  return execCmd('renewsshbot', domain, [username, exp]);
}

async function renewVMess(domain, username, exp) {
  return execCmd('renewvmessbot', domain, [username, exp]);
}

async function renewVLess(domain, username, exp) {
  return execCmd('renewvlessbot', domain, [username, exp]);
}

async function renewTrojan(domain, username, exp) {
  return execCmd('renewtrojanbot', domain, [username, exp]);
}

async function renewAccount(vpnType, domain, username, exp) {
  if (vpnType === 'ssh') return renewSSH(domain, username, exp);
  if (vpnType === 'vmess') return renewVMess(domain, username, exp);
  if (vpnType === 'vless') return renewVLess(domain, username, exp);
  if (vpnType === 'trojan') return renewTrojan(domain, username, exp);
  throw new Error(`Tipe VPN tidak dikenal: ${vpnType}`);
}

async function trialSSH(domain) {
  return execCmd('trialsshbot', domain, []);
}

async function trialVMess(domain) {
  return execCmd('trialvmessbot', domain, []);
}

async function trialVLess(domain) {
  return execCmd('trialvlessbot', domain, []);
}

async function trialTrojan(domain) {
  return execCmd('trialtrojanbot', domain, []);
}

async function trialAccount(vpnType, domain) {
  if (vpnType === 'ssh') return trialSSH(domain);
  if (vpnType === 'vmess') return trialVMess(domain);
  if (vpnType === 'vless') return trialVLess(domain);
  if (vpnType === 'trojan') return trialTrojan(domain);
  throw new Error(`Tipe VPN tidak dikenal: ${vpnType}`);
}

async function deleteSSH(domain, username) {
  return execCmd('deletesshbot', domain, [username]);
}

async function deleteVMess(domain, username) {
  return execCmd('deletevmessbot', domain, [username]);
}

async function deleteVLess(domain, username) {
  return execCmd('deletevlessbot', domain, [username]);
}

async function deleteTrojan(domain, username) {
  return execCmd('deletetrojanbot', domain, [username]);
}

async function deleteAccount(vpnType, domain, username) {
  if (vpnType === 'ssh') return deleteSSH(domain, username);
  if (vpnType === 'vmess') return deleteVMess(domain, username);
  if (vpnType === 'vless') return deleteVLess(domain, username);
  if (vpnType === 'trojan') return deleteTrojan(domain, username);
  throw new Error(`Tipe VPN tidak dikenal: ${vpnType}`);
}

module.exports = {
  execCmd,
  addSSH, addVMess, addVLess, addTrojan,
  createAccount,
  renewSSH, renewVMess, renewVLess, renewTrojan,
  renewAccount,
  trialSSH, trialVMess, trialVLess, trialTrojan,
  trialAccount,
  deleteSSH, deleteVMess, deleteVLess, deleteTrojan,
  deleteAccount,
};

# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/middleware/auth.js
#!/usr/bin/env node

const { getSetting } = require('../lib/helpers');

function requireLogin(req, res, next) {
  if (!req.session.userId) return res.redirect('/auth/login');
  next();
}

function requireAdmin(req, res, next) {
  if (!req.session.userId || !req.session.isAdmin) return res.status(403).redirect('/');
  next();
}

function requireVerified(req, res, next) {
  if (!req.session.userId) return res.redirect('/auth/login');
  if (!req.session.isVerified) return res.redirect('/auth/verify-otp');
  next();
}

function maintenanceGuard(req, res, next) {
  if (req.session.isAdmin) return next();
  if (req.path.startsWith('/auth') || req.path.startsWith('/admin')) return next();
  if (getSetting('maintenance_mode') === '1') {
    const msg = getSetting('maintenance_message') || 'Sedang dalam perbaikan. Mohon tunggu.';
    return res.status(503).send(`<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="id"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Maintenance</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
body{font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(-45deg,#0f172a,#1e293b,#0c4a6e,#0369a1);background-size:400% 400%;animation:grad 15s ease infinite;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;}
@keyframes grad{0%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}100%{background-position:0% 50%}}
.card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border-radius:28px;padding:48px 32px;max-width:420px;width:100%;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3);}
.icon{width:80px;height:80px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#6366f1);border-radius:24px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:36px;margin-bottom:24px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(59,130,246,.4);}
h1{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#0f172a;margin-bottom:12px;}
p{font-size:14px;color:#64748b;font-weight:500;line-height:1.6;background:#f1f5f9;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="card">
  <div class="icon">🛠️</div>
  <h1>Sedang Maintenance</h1>
  <p>${msg}</p>
</div>
</body></html>`);
  }

  next();
}

module.exports = { requireLogin, requireAdmin, requireVerified, maintenanceGuard };

# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/public/js/main.js
function showLoading(txt) {
  const el = document.getElementById('loadingOverlay');
  if (el) { el.classList.add('show'); if (txt) document.getElementById('loadingText').textContent = txt; }
}

function hideLoading() {
  const el = document.getElementById('loadingOverlay');
  if (el) el.classList.remove('show');
}

async function copyText(text, btn) {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    if (btn) {
      const orig = btn.innerHTML;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check"></i> Disalin!';
      btn.classList.add('copied');
      setTimeout(() => { btn.innerHTML = orig; btn.classList.remove('copied'); }, 2000);
    }
  } catch {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
}

document.querySelectorAll('form[data-loading]').forEach(f => {
  f.addEventListener('submit', () => showLoading(f.dataset.loading || 'Memproses...'));
});

# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/routes/admin.js
#!/usr/bin/env node

const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const express = require('express');

const db = require('../lib/database');
const { requireAdmin } = require('../middleware/auth');
const { rupiah, getSetting, setSetting, mutation, isReseller, checkResellerDowngrade, getUserOmzet } = require('../lib/helpers');
const { deleteAccount } = require('../lib/vpnapi');
const { sendAnnouncement } = require('../lib/mailer');
const cfg = require('../../config');

const r = express.Router();
r.use(requireAdmin);

function adminLocals(req, extra = {}) {
  return { session: req.session, siteName: cfg.app.siteName, cfg, rupiah, ...extra };
}

r.get('/', (req, res) => {
  const totalUsers = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM users WHERE is_admin=0').get().c;
  const totalResellers = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM users WHERE is_reseller=1').get().c;
  const totalOrders = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM orders').get().c;
  const totalTopup = db.prepare("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) as s FROM topups WHERE status='Sukses'").get().s;
  const recentOrders = db.prepare('SELECT o.*,u.username,u.name FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id=u.id ORDER BY o.time DESC LIMIT 10').all();
  const recentTopups = db.prepare("SELECT t.*,u.username FROM topups t JOIN users u ON t.user_id=u.id WHERE t.status='Sukses' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 10").all();
  const recentOrdersx = db.prepare('SELECT o.*,u.username,u.name FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id=u.id ORDER BY o.time DESC').all();
  res.render('admin/dashboard', adminLocals(req, { title: 'Admin Dashboard', totalUsers, totalResellers, totalOrders, totalTopup, recentOrders, recentTopups,recentOrdersx }));
});

r.get('/users', (req, res) => {
  const q = req.query.q || '';
  const filterReseller = req.query.reseller === '1';
  const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(req.query.page) || 1);
  const limit = 20;
  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
 
  // Build WHERE clause
  let whereClause = '1=1';
  let params = [];
 
  if (q) {
    whereClause += ' AND (username LIKE ? OR email LIKE ? OR name LIKE ?)';
    params.push(`%${q}%`, `%${q}%`, `%${q}%`);
  }
 
  if (filterReseller) {
    whereClause += ' AND is_reseller=1';
  }
 
  // Get total count
  const countQuery = `SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM users WHERE ${whereClause}`;
  const { total } = db.prepare(countQuery).get(...params);
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);
 
  // Get paginated data
  const dataQuery = `
    SELECT * FROM users 
    WHERE ${whereClause}
    ORDER BY is_reseller DESC, created_at DESC 
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
  `;
  const users = db.prepare(dataQuery).all(...params, limit, offset);
 
  res.render('admin/users', adminLocals(req, {
    title: 'Manajemen User',
    users,
    q,
    filterReseller,
    page,
    limit,
    total,
    totalPages
  }));
});

r.get('/users/:id', (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.params.id);
  if (!u) return res.redirect('/admin/users');
  const orders = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20').all(u.id);
  const topups = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM topups WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20').all(u.id);
  const muts = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM mutations WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20').all(u.id);
  const trials = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM trials WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20').all(u.id);
  const omzet30 = getUserOmzet(u.id, Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  res.render('admin/user-detail', adminLocals(req, { title: 'Detail User', u, orders, topups, muts, trials, query: req.query, omzet30 }));
});

r.post('/users/:id/saldo', (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.params.id);
  if (!u) return res.redirect('/admin/users');
  const amount = parseFloat(req.body.amount);
  const type = req.body.type;
  if (isNaN(amount) || amount <= 0) return res.redirect('/admin/users/' + u.id + '?saldo_err=nominal');
  const before = parseFloat(u.saldo);
  if (type === 'kurang' && amount > before) {
    return res.redirect('/admin/users/' + u.id + '?saldo_err=kurang&saldo=' + before + '&req=' + amount);
  }
  const after = type === 'tambah' ? before + amount : before - amount;
  db.prepare('UPDATE users SET saldo=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(after, Date.now(), u.id);
  mutation(u.id, type === 'tambah' ? 'ADMIN_CREDIT' : 'ADMIN_DEBIT', type === 'tambah' ? amount : -amount, 'Penyesuaian saldo oleh admin', 'ADMIN', before, after);
  res.redirect('/admin/users/' + u.id + '?saldo_ok=' + type + '&amount=' + amount);
});

r.post('/users/:id/toggle-reseller', (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.params.id);
  if (!u) return res.redirect('/admin/users');
  if (u.is_reseller) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET is_reseller=0, reseller_since=NULL, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(Date.now(), u.id);
  } else {
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET is_reseller=1, reseller_since=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(Date.now(), Date.now(), u.id);
  }
  res.redirect('/admin/users/' + u.id + '?reseller_toggled=1');
});

r.post('/users/:id/check-downgrade', (req, res) => {
  const result = checkResellerDowngrade(parseInt(req.params.id));
  res.redirect('/admin/users/' + req.params.id + '?downgrade_result=' + (result.downgraded ? 'yes' : 'no') + '&omzet=' + (result.omzet || 0));
});

r.post('/users/:id/toggle-admin', (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.params.id);
  if (!u) return res.redirect('/admin/users');
  db.prepare('UPDATE users SET is_admin=? WHERE id=?').run(u.is_admin ? 0 : 1, u.id);
  res.redirect('/admin/users/' + u.id);
});

r.post('/users/:id/reset-verify', (req, res) => {
  db.prepare('UPDATE users SET is_verified=0 WHERE id=?').run(req.params.id);
  res.redirect('/admin/users/' + req.params.id);
});

r.get('/packages', (req, res) => {
  const now = new Date();
  now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const todayStr = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const packages = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM vpn_packages ORDER BY sort_order,price').all();
  const resellerDiscount = parseInt(getSetting('reseller_discount') || 50);
  const packagesWithReseller = packages.map(p => {
    const activeCount = db.prepare(`
      SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM orders 
      WHERE server_host=? 
      AND status='Aktif'
      AND vpn_exp > ?
    `).get(p.server_host, todayStr).c;

    return {
      ...p,
      reseller_price: Math.ceil(p.price * (1 - resellerDiscount / 100)),
      price_per_day: Math.ceil(p.price / 30),
      active_count: activeCount,
    };
  });
  res.render('admin/packages', adminLocals(req, { title: 'Paket VPN', packages: packagesWithReseller, resellerDiscount }));
});

r.post('/packages/add', (req, res) => {
  const { name, vpn_type, server_host, server_label, duration, price, limit_ip, limit_kuota, max_server, description, sort_order } = req.body;
  if (!name || !vpn_type || !server_host || !duration || !price) return res.redirect('/admin/packages?err=1');
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO vpn_packages (name,vpn_type,server_host,server_label,duration,price,limit_ip,limit_kuota,max_server,description,sort_order) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(
    name, vpn_type, server_host, server_label || server_host,
    parseInt(duration), parseFloat(price),
    parseInt(limit_ip || 2), parseInt(limit_kuota || 0),
    parseInt(max_server || 0),
    description || '', parseInt(sort_order || 0)
  );
  res.redirect('/admin/packages');
});

r.post('/packages/:id/edit', (req, res) => {
  const { name, vpn_type, server_host, server_label, duration, price, limit_ip, limit_kuota, max_server, description, sort_order, is_active } = req.body;
  db.prepare('UPDATE vpn_packages SET name=?,vpn_type=?,server_host=?,server_label=?,duration=?,price=?,limit_ip=?,limit_kuota=?,max_server=?,description=?,sort_order=?,is_active=? WHERE id=?').run(
    name, vpn_type, server_host, server_label || server_host,
    parseInt(duration), parseFloat(price),
    parseInt(limit_ip || 2), parseInt(limit_kuota || 0),
    parseInt(max_server || 0),
    description || '', parseInt(sort_order || 0), is_active ? 1 : 0, req.params.id
  );
  res.redirect('/admin/packages');
});

r.post('/packages/:id/delete', (req, res) => {

  res.redirect('/admin/packages');
});

r.post('/orders/:id/delete', async (req, res) => {
  const order = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id=?').get(req.params.id);
  if (!order) return res.redirect('/admin/orders');
  if (order.vpn_user && order.vpn_user !== '-') {
    try { await deleteAccount(order.vpn_type, order.server_host, order.vpn_user); } catch (e) { console.error(`[DELETE ORDER] Gagal hapus akun VPN ${order.vpn_user}:`, e.message); }
  }
  if (order.vpn_exp && order.vpn_exp !== '-' && order.price && order.duration) {
    const [y, m, d] = order.vpn_exp.split('-').map(Number);
    const exp = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
    const now = new Date();
    now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const sisaHari = Math.floor((exp - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    if (sisaHari > 0) {
      const hargaPerHari = parseFloat(order.price) / parseInt(order.duration);
      const refund = Math.floor(hargaPerHari * sisaHari);
      if (refund > 0) {
        const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(order.user_id);
        if (u) {
          const before = parseFloat(u.saldo);
          const after = before + refund;
          db.prepare('UPDATE users SET saldo=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(after, Date.now(), u.id);
          mutation(u.id, 'REFUND', refund, `Refund order ${order.order_id} (${sisaHari} hari sisa)`, order.order_id, before, after);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  db.prepare('DELETE FROM orders WHERE id=?').run(req.params.id);
  res.redirect('/admin/orders');
});

const LIMIT_ORDERS = 20;

r.get('/orders', (req, res) => {
  const page   = Math.max(1, parseInt(req.query.page) || 1);
  const limit  = LIMIT_ORDERS;
  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
 
  const q      = (req.query.q      || '').trim();
  const status = (req.query.status || '').trim();
  const type   = (req.query.type   || '').trim();
 
  const where  = [];
  const params = [];
 
  if (q) {
    where.push(`(o.order_id LIKE ? OR u.username LIKE ? OR o.package_name LIKE ? OR u.name LIKE ?)`);
    const like = `%${q}%`;
    params.push(like, like, like, like);
  }
  if (status) {
    where.push(`o.status = ?`);
    params.push(status);
  }
  if (type) {
    where.push(`o.vpn_type = ?`);
    params.push(type);
  }
 
  const whereClause = where.length ? `WHERE ${where.join(' AND ')}` : '';
 
  const total = db.prepare(
    `SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
     FROM orders o
     JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
     ${whereClause}`
  ).get(...params).cnt;
 
  const orders = db.prepare(
    `SELECT o.*, u.username, u.name, u.email, u.is_reseller
     FROM orders o
     JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
     ${whereClause}
     ORDER BY o.time DESC
     LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`
  ).all(...params, limit, offset);
 
  res.render('admin/orders', adminLocals(req, {
    title     : 'Semua Order',
    orders,
    total,
    page,
    limit,
    totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
    q,
    status,
    type,
  }));
});

const LIMIT = 20; // jumlah baris per halaman
 
r.get('/topups', (req, res) => {
  const page  = Math.max(1, parseInt(req.query.page) || 1);
  const limit = LIMIT;
  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
 
  // Filter opsional: status & pencarian username/trxid
  const search = (req.query.search || '').trim();
  const status = (req.query.status || '').trim();
 
  let where   = [];
  let params  = [];
 
  if (search) {
  // Tambahkan t.status ke dalam pencarian
  where.push(`(t.trx_id LIKE ? OR u.username LIKE ? OR u.name LIKE ? OR t.status LIKE ?)`);
  const like = `%${search}%`;
  
  // Jika user mengetik "expired", kita juga ingin mencari kata "gagal" di database
  if (search.toLowerCase() === 'expired') {
    params.push(like, like, like, '%Gagal%');
  } else {
    params.push(like, like, like, like);
  }
}
  if (status === 'Expired') {
  where.push(`(t.status = 'Expired' OR t.status = 'Gagal' OR t.status LIKE '%Gagal%')`);
} else if (status) {
  where.push(`t.status = ?`);
  params.push(status);
}
 
  const whereClause = where.length ? `WHERE ${where.join(' AND ')}` : '';
 
  // Total rows (untuk hitung total halaman)
  const total = db.prepare(
    `SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt
     FROM topups t
     JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.id
     ${whereClause}`
  ).get(...params).cnt;
 
  // Data halaman ini
  const topups = db.prepare(
    `SELECT t.*, u.username, u.name
     FROM topups t
     JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.id
     ${whereClause}
     ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
     LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`
  ).all(...params, limit, offset);
 
  res.render('admin/topups', adminLocals(req, {
    title   : 'Riwayat Topup',
    topups,
    total,
    page,
    limit,
    totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
    search,
    status,
  }));
});

  const settings = {};
  keys.forEach(k => { settings[k] = getSetting(k) || ''; });
  res.render('admin/settings', adminLocals(req, { title: 'Pengaturan Situs', settings, success: req.query.saved }));

r.post('/settings', (req, res) => {
  const { site_name, maintenance_mode, maintenance_message, announcement, min_topup, max_trial, max_trial_reseller, reseller_min_topup, reseller_discount, reseller_downgrade_omzet } = req.body;
  if (site_name) setSetting('site_name', site_name);
  setSetting('maintenance_mode', maintenance_mode ? '1' : '0');
  if (maintenance_message) setSetting('maintenance_message', maintenance_message);
  setSetting('announcement', announcement || '');
  setSetting('min_topup', parseInt(min_topup) > 0 ? String(parseInt(min_topup)) : '1000');
  setSetting('max_trial', parseInt(max_trial) >= 0 ? String(parseInt(max_trial)) : '1');
  if (reseller_min_topup) setSetting('reseller_min_topup', String(parseInt(reseller_min_topup) || 25000));
  if (reseller_discount) setSetting('reseller_discount', String(Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parseInt(reseller_discount) || 50))));
  setSetting('max_trial_reseller', parseInt(max_trial_reseller) >= 0 ? String(parseInt(max_trial_reseller)) : '5');
  if (reseller_downgrade_omzet) setSetting('reseller_downgrade_omzet', String(parseInt(reseller_downgrade_omzet) || 10000));
  res.redirect('/admin/settings?saved=1');
});

r.get('/broadcast', (req, res) => {

});

r.post('/broadcast', async (req, res) => {
  const { subject, message } = req.body;
  if (!subject || !message) return res.redirect('/admin/broadcast?err=1');
  const users = db.prepare('SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE is_verified=1 AND is_admin=0').all();
  let success = 0, failed = 0;
  for (const u of users) {
    try { await sendAnnouncement(u.email, u.name, subject, message); success++; } catch (e) { failed++; }
  }
  res.redirect(`/admin/broadcast?sent=1&success=${success}&failed=${failed}`);
});

r.get('/resellers', (req, res) => {
  const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(req.query.page) || 1);
  const limit = 20;
  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

  // Hitung 30 hari lalu
  const thirtyDaysAgo = Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

  // Get total count
  const { total } = db.prepare(`
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM users WHERE is_reseller = 1
  `).get();
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);

  // Get paginated data dengan omzet 30 hari
  const resellers = db.prepare(`
    SELECT u.*,
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price),0) FROM orders 
       WHERE user_id=u.id 
       AND status NOT IN ('Refund', 'Deleted')
       AND time > ?) AS omzet_30d
    FROM users u 
    WHERE u.is_reseller = 1 
    ORDER BY omzet_30d DESC 
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
  `).all(thirtyDaysAgo, limit, offset);

  const resellerDiscount = getSetting('reseller_discount') || '50';
  const resellerMinTopup = getSetting('reseller_min_topup') || '25000';
  const resellerDowngradeOmzet = getSetting('reseller_downgrade_omzet') || '10000';

  res.render('admin/resellers', adminLocals(req, {
    title: 'Manajemen Reseller',
    resellers,
    rupiah,
    resellerDiscount,
    resellerMinTopup,
    resellerDowngradeOmzet,
    page,
    limit,
    total,
    totalPages
  }));
});

module.exports = r;


# tokovpn/tokovpnweb/src/routes/auth.js
#!/usr/bin/env node

const axios = require('axios');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const express = require('express');
const passport = require('passport');
const GoogleStrategy = require('passport-google-oauth20').Strategy;

const db = require('../lib/database');
const { sendOTP, sendReset, sendWelcome } = require('../lib/mailer');
const { otp, token } = require('../lib/helpers');
const cfg = require('../../config');

const r = express.Router();

passport.use(new GoogleStrategy({
  clientID: cfg.google.clientId,
  clientSecret: cfg.google.clientSecret,
  callbackURL: cfg.google.callbackUrl,
}, (accessToken, refreshToken, profile, done) => {
  const email = profile.emails[0].value;
  const name = profile.displayName;
  const googleId = profile.id;

  let user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE google_id=?').get(googleId);
  if (user) return done(null, user);

  user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email=?').get(email);
  if (user) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET google_id=?, is_verified=1, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(googleId, Date.now(), user.id);
    user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(user.id);
    return done(null, user);
  }

  let username = email.split('@')[0].replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9.]/g, '').slice(0, 20);
  const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE username=?').get(username);
  if (existing) username = username + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9000 + 1000);

  db.prepare('INSERT INTO users (username,email,password,name,google_id,is_verified) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,1)').run(
    username, email, null, name, googleId
  );
  user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE google_id=?').get(googleId);
  try { sendWelcome(email, username); } catch {}
  return done(null, user);
}));

passport.serializeUser((user, done) => done(null, user.id));
passport.deserializeUser((id, done) => {
  const user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(id);
  done(null, user);
});

async function verifyTurnstile(token) {
  if (!token) return false;
  try {
    const res = await axios.post('https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify', {
      secret: cfg.turnstile.secretKey,
      response: token,
    });
    return res.data && res.data.success === true;
  } catch { return false; }
}

r.get('/google', passport.authenticate('google', { scope: ['profile', 'email'] }));

r.get('/google/callback',
  passport.authenticate('google', { failureRedirect: '/auth/login?err=google' }),
  (req, res) => {
    const u = req.user;
    req.session.userId = u.id;
    req.session.username = u.username;
    req.session.name = u.name;
    req.session.isAdmin = u.is_admin === 1;
    req.session.isVerified = true;
    req.session.save(() => {
      if (u.is_admin === 1) return res.redirect('/admin');
      res.redirect('/');
    });
  }
);

r.get('/login', (req, res) => {
  if (req.session.userId) return res.redirect('/');
  const reset = req.session.loginReset || null;
  delete req.session.loginReset;
  const googleErr = req.query.err === 'google' ? 'Login dengan Google gagal. Coba lagi.' : null;
  const errMsg = googleErr || null;
  res.render('auth/login', { title: 'Login', error: errMsg, reset, siteKey: cfg.turnstile.siteKey });
});

r.post('/login', async (req, res) => {
  const { username, password } = req.body;
  const showErr = (msg) => res.render('auth/login', { title: 'Login', error: msg, reset: null, siteKey: cfg.turnstile.siteKey });
  const ok = await verifyTurnstile(req.body['cf-turnstile-response']);
  if (!ok) return showErr('Verifikasi captcha gagal. Coba lagi.');
  if (!username || !password) return showErr('Username dan password wajib diisi.');
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username=? COLLATE NOCASE OR email=? COLLATE NOCASE').get(username, username);
  if (!u) return showErr('Akun tidak ditemukan.');
  if (!u.password) return showErr('Akun ini terdaftar via Google. Silakan login dengan Google.');
  if (!bcrypt.compareSync(password, u.password)) return showErr('Password salah.');
  req.session.userId = u.id;
  req.session.username = u.username;
  req.session.name = u.name;
  req.session.isAdmin = u.is_admin === 1;
  req.session.isVerified = u.is_verified === 1;
  if (!u.is_verified) return res.redirect('/auth/verify-otp');
  if (u.is_admin === 1) return res.redirect('/admin');
  res.redirect('/');
});

r.get('/register', (req, res) => {
  if (req.session.userId && req.session.isVerified) return res.redirect('/');
  if (req.session.userId && !req.session.isVerified) {
    req.session.destroy(() => {});
  }
  res.render('auth/register', { title: 'Daftar', error: null, siteKey: cfg.turnstile.siteKey });
});

r.post('/register', async (req, res) => {
  const { username, email, password, confirm_password } = req.body;
  const showErr = (msg) => res.render('auth/register', { title: 'Daftar', error: msg, siteKey: cfg.turnstile.siteKey });
  const ok = await verifyTurnstile(req.body['cf-turnstile-response']);
  if (!ok) return showErr('Verifikasi captcha gagal. Coba lagi.');
  if (!username || !email || !password) return showErr('Semua kolom wajib diisi.');
  if (password !== confirm_password) return showErr('Password tidak cocok.');
  if (password.length < 6) return showErr('Password minimal 6 karakter.');
  const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE username=? OR email=?').get(username, email);
  if (existing) return showErr('Username atau email sudah digunakan.');
  const hash = bcrypt.hashSync(password, 10);
  const code = otp();
  const expires = Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000;
  try {
    req.session.pendingRegister = { username, email, password: hash, name: username, otp_code: code, otp_expires: expires };
    try { await sendOTP(email, username, code); } catch {}
    return res.redirect('/auth/verify-otp');
  } catch (e) {
    return showErr('Terjadi kesalahan: ' + e.message);
  }
});

r.get('/verify-otp', (req, res) => {
  if (req.session.userId && req.session.isVerified) return res.redirect('/');
  if (!req.session.userId && !req.session.pendingRegister) return res.redirect('/auth/register');
  res.render('auth/verify-otp', { title: 'Verifikasi OTP', error: null });
});

r.post('/verify-otp', async (req, res) => {
  const { otp_code } = req.body;

  if (req.session.pendingRegister) {
    const p = req.session.pendingRegister;
    if (!p.otp_code || p.otp_code !== otp_code) return res.render('auth/verify-otp', { title: 'Verifikasi OTP', error: 'Kode OTP salah.' });
    if (Date.now() > p.otp_expires) return res.render('auth/verify-otp', { title: 'Verifikasi OTP', error: 'Kode OTP sudah kadaluarsa. Kirim ulang.' });
    const isAdmin = cfg.app.adminUsername && p.username === cfg.app.adminUsername ? 1 : 0;
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO users (username,email,password,name,is_verified,is_admin) VALUES (?,?,?,?,1,?)').run(p.username, p.email, p.password, p.name, isAdmin);
    const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username=?').get(p.username);
    delete req.session.pendingRegister;
    req.session.userId = u.id;
    req.session.username = u.username;
    req.session.name = u.name;
    req.session.isAdmin = u.is_admin === 1;
    req.session.isVerified = true;
    try { await sendWelcome(u.email, u.username); } catch {}
    return req.session.save(() => {
      if (u.is_admin === 1) return res.redirect('/admin');
      res.redirect('/');
    });
  }

  if (req.session.userId) {
    const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
    if (!u) return res.redirect('/auth/login');
    if (!u.otp_code || u.otp_code !== otp_code) return res.render('auth/verify-otp', { title: 'Verifikasi OTP', error: 'Kode OTP salah.' });
    if (Date.now() > u.otp_expires) return res.render('auth/verify-otp', { title: 'Verifikasi OTP', error: 'Kode OTP sudah kadaluarsa. Kirim ulang.' });
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET is_verified=1, otp_code=NULL, otp_expires=NULL, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(Date.now(), u.id);
    req.session.isVerified = true;
    return res.redirect('/');
  }

  return res.redirect('/auth/login');
});

r.post('/resend-otp', async (req, res) => {
  if (req.session.pendingRegister) {
    const p = req.session.pendingRegister;
    const code = otp();
    const expires = Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000;
    req.session.pendingRegister = { ...p, otp_code: code, otp_expires: expires };
    req.session.save(async (err) => {
      if (err) return res.json({ ok: false, message: 'Gagal simpan session.' });
      try {
        await sendOTP(p.email, p.name, code);
        return res.json({ ok: true, message: 'OTP berhasil dikirim ulang ke ' + p.email });
      } catch (e) {
        return res.json({ ok: false, message: 'Gagal kirim email: ' + e.message });
      }
    });
    return;
  }

  if (!req.session.userId) return res.json({ ok: false, message: 'Tidak terautentikasi' });
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  if (!u) return res.json({ ok: false, message: 'User tidak ditemukan' });
  const code = otp();
  const expires = Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000;
  db.prepare('UPDATE users SET otp_code=?, otp_expires=? WHERE id=?').run(code, expires, u.id);
  try {
    await sendOTP(u.email, u.name, code);
    res.json({ ok: true, message: 'OTP berhasil dikirim ulang ke ' + u.email });
  } catch (e) {
    res.json({ ok: false, message: 'Gagal kirim email: ' + e.message });
  }
});

r.post('/forgot-password', async (req, res) => {
  const { email, resend } = req.body;
  const showErr = (msg) => res.render('auth/forgot-password', { title: 'Lupa Password', error: msg, success: null, email: email || '', isResend: false, siteKey: cfg.turnstile.siteKey });
  const ok = await verifyTurnstile(req.body['cf-turnstile-response']);
  if (!ok) return res.redirect('/auth/forgot-password');
  if (!email) return showErr('Email wajib diisi.');
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email=?').get(email);
  if (!u) return showErr('Email tidak terdaftar.');
  const tok = token();
  const exp = Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000;
  db.prepare('UPDATE users SET reset_token=?, reset_expires=? WHERE id=?').run(tok, exp, u.id);
  const link = `${cfg.app.siteUrl}/auth/reset-password/${tok}`;
  try {
    await sendReset(u.email, u.name, link);
    req.session.forgotSuccess = true;
    req.session.forgotEmail = email;
    req.session.forgotResend = !!resend;
    return res.redirect('/auth/forgot-password');
  } catch (e) {
    return showErr('Gagal kirim email: ' + e.message);
  }
});

r.post('/reset-password/:tok', (req, res) => {
  const { password, confirm_password } = req.body;
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE reset_token=?').get(req.params.tok);
  if (!u || Date.now() > u.reset_expires) return res.render('auth/reset-password', { title: 'Reset Password', error: 'Link tidak valid atau sudah kadaluarsa.', tok: null });
  if (!password || password.length < 6) return res.render('auth/reset-password', { title: 'Reset Password', error: 'Password minimal 6 karakter.', tok: req.params.tok });
  if (password !== confirm_password) return res.render('auth/reset-password', { title: 'Reset Password', error: 'Password tidak cocok.', tok: req.params.tok });
  const hash = bcrypt.hashSync(password, 10);
  db.prepare('UPDATE users SET password=?, reset_token=NULL, reset_expires=NULL, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(hash, Date.now(), u.id);
  req.session.destroy(() => res.redirect('/auth/login'));
});
