#!/usr/bin/env node

const axios = require('axios');
const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
const express = require('express');
const dns = require('dns').promises;

const db = require('../lib/database');
const { requireVerified } = require('../middleware/auth');
const { rupiah, topupId, orderId, getSetting, mutation, isReseller, resellerPrice, getMaxTrial, canTrial, checkResellerUpgrade } = require('../lib/helpers');
const { buildQrisString, uniqueAmount, qrisImageUrl, checkPayment } = require('../lib/qris');
const { createAccount, renewAccount, trialAccount, deleteAccount } = require('../lib/vpnapi');
const { notifTopup, notifOrder, notifRenew, notifTrial, notifDelete } = require('../lib/telenotif');
const { processTopupById } = require('../lib/topup_processor');
const cfg = require('../../config');

const r = express.Router();
r.use(requireVerified);

// ============================================================================
// PERBAIKAN: getServerActiveCount
// Hanya menghitung akun yang STATUS='Aktif' DAN vpn_exp > hari ini
// ============================================================================
function getServerActiveCount(serverHost) {
  const now = new Date();
  now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const todayStr = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  
  return db.prepare(`
    SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM orders 
    WHERE server_host=? 
    AND status='Aktif'
    AND vpn_exp > ?
  `).get(serverHost, todayStr).c;
}

const uptimeCache = {
  data: null,
  lastFetch: null,
  TTL: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  isValid() { return this.data && this.lastFetch && (Date.now() - this.lastFetch) < this.TTL; },
  set(data) { this.data = data; this.lastFetch = Date.now(); },
  get() { return this.data; }
};

async function fetchAllServerStats() {
  const servers = db.prepare(
    `SELECT DISTINCT server_host, server_label, name FROM vpn_packages WHERE is_active=1 ORDER BY sort_order`
  ).all();
  const statsPromises = servers.map(async (srv) => {
    const url = `http://${srv.server_host}:7070/stats`;
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(url, { timeout: 5000 });
      const data = response.data;
      const ping = Date.now() - startTime;
      const cpuTotal = typeof data.cpu === 'object' ? data.cpu.total : data.cpu;
      let memUsed = 0, memTotal = 0, memPercent = 0;
      if (typeof data.memory === 'string') {
        const memMatch = data.memory.match(/(\d+)\/(\d+)\s*MB\s*\((\d+)%\)/);
        if (memMatch) { memUsed = parseInt(memMatch[1]); memTotal = parseInt(memMatch[2]); memPercent = parseInt(memMatch[3]); }
      }
      let diskUsed = '-', diskTotal = '-', diskPercent = 0;
      if (typeof data.disk === 'string') {
        const diskMatch = data.disk.match(/^(\S+)\/(\S+)\s*\((\d+)%\)/);
        if (diskMatch) { diskUsed = diskMatch[1]; diskTotal = diskMatch[2]; diskPercent = parseInt(diskMatch[3]); }
      }
      const rxMB = data.network ? (data.network.rx_bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) : 0;
      const txMB = data.network ? (data.network.tx_bytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) : 0;
      const rxDisplay = rxMB > 1024 ? (rxMB / 1024).toFixed(2) + ' GB' : rxMB + ' MB';
      const txDisplay = txMB > 1024 ? (txMB / 1024).toFixed(2) + ' GB' : txMB + ' MB';
      return { server_host: srv.server_host, server_label: srv.server_label || srv.server_host, server_name: srv.name, status: 'online', ping, cpu: cpuTotal || 0, cpu_per_core: (typeof data.cpu === 'object' && data.cpu.per_core) ? data.cpu.per_core : [], mem_used: memUsed, mem_total: memTotal, mem_percent: memPercent, disk_used: diskUsed, disk_total: diskTotal, disk_percent: diskPercent, uptime: data.uptime || '-', load: data.load || '-', rx: rxDisplay, tx: txDisplay, response_ms: data.response_ms || ping };
    } catch (err) {
      return { server_host: srv.server_host, server_label: srv.server_label || srv.server_host, server_name: srv.name, status: 'offline', ping: null, cpu: 0, cpu_per_core: [], mem_used: 0, mem_total: 0, mem_percent: 0, disk_used: '-', disk_total: '-', disk_percent: 0, uptime: '-', load: '-', rx: '-', tx: '-', response_ms: null, error: err.message };
    }
  });
  return await Promise.all(statsPromises);
}

r.get('/', async (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  const packages = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM vpn_packages WHERE is_active=1 ORDER BY sort_order,price').all();
  const announcement = getSetting('announcement') || '';
  const maxTrial = getMaxTrial(u);

  if (!uptimeCache.isValid()) {
    const fetchRes = await fetchAllServerStats();
    uptimeCache.set(fetchRes);
  }
  const stats = uptimeCache.get() || [];
  const uptimeMap = {};
  stats.forEach(s => {
    let loadHigh = false;
    if (s.status === 'online' && s.load && s.load !== '-') {
      const cs = s.cpu_per_core && s.cpu_per_core.length > 0 ? s.cpu_per_core.length : 1;
      const pts = s.load.replace(/\s/g,'').split(',');
      if (pts[0] && parseFloat(pts[0]) / cs >= 1.5) {
        loadHigh = true;
      }
    }
    uptimeMap[s.server_host] = {
      isOnline: s.status === 'online',
      loadHigh: loadHigh,
      ping: s.ping || 9999
    };
  });

  const packagesWithPrice = packages.map(p => {
    const activeCount = getServerActiveCount(p.server_host);
    const uMap = uptimeMap[p.server_host] || { isOnline: false, loadHigh: false, ping: 9999 };
    
    const isFull = (p.max_server > 0 && activeCount >= p.max_server);
    const isRecommended = uMap.isOnline && !isFull && !uMap.loadHigh && uMap.ping < 150 && uMap.ping > 0;

    return {
      ...p,
      original_price: p.price,
      price: resellerPrice(u, p.price),
      display_price: resellerPrice(u, p.price),
      price_per_day: Math.ceil(resellerPrice(u, p.price) / 30),
      active_count: activeCount,
      is_full: isFull,
      is_recommended: isRecommended,
      ping: uMap.ping
    };
  });

  packagesWithPrice.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.is_recommended && !b.is_recommended) return -1;
    if (!a.is_recommended && b.is_recommended) return 1;
    if (!a.is_full && b.is_full) return -1;
    if (a.is_full && !b.is_full) return 1;
    if (a.price_per_day !== b.price_per_day) return a.price_per_day - b.price_per_day;
    return a.ping - b.ping;
  });

  const grouped = {};
  for (const p of packagesWithPrice) {
    const k = p.vpn_type;
    if (!grouped[k]) grouped[k] = [];
    grouped[k].push(p);
  }
  const trialTypes = {};
  const trialNextAvailable = {};
  const trialCounts = {};
  const oneDayAgo = Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const totalTrialToday = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM trials WHERE user_id=? AND time > ?').get(u.id, oneDayAgo).c;
  ['ssh', 'vmess', 'vless', 'trojan'].forEach(t => {
    trialCounts[t] = totalTrialToday;
    trialTypes[t] = totalTrialToday < maxTrial;
    if (totalTrialToday >= maxTrial) {
      const last = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM trials WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1').get(u.id);
      if (last) {
        const na = new Date(last.time + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        trialNextAvailable[t] = `${na.getFullYear()}-${String(na.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(na.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}, ${String(na.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(na.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      }
    }
  });
  res.render('user/dashboard', {
    title: 'Dashboard', u, grouped, rupiah, announcement, cfg,
    trialTypes, maxTrial, trialNextAvailable, trialCounts,
    trialErr: req.query.trial_err || null,
    isReseller: isReseller(u),
  });
});

r.get('/deposit', async (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  const pending = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM topups WHERE user_id=? AND status='Pending' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1").get(u.id);
  const minTopup = parseInt(getSetting('min_topup') || 1000);
  const resellerMinTopup = parseInt(getSetting('reseller_min_topup') || 25000);
  const errMsg = req.query.err || null;

  // Cek jam tutup (23:30 - 00:30 WIB)
  const now = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta' }));
  const hour = now.getHours();
  const minute = now.getMinutes();
  const totalMinutes = hour * 60 + minute;
  const isClosed = totalMinutes >= 23 * 60 + 30 || totalMinutes < 0 * 60 + 30;

  // Info omzet reseller
  let omzet30d = 0;
  let resellerDowngradeOmzet = 10000;
  if (isReseller(u)) {
    const thirtyDaysAgo = Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    omzet30d = db.prepare(`
      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price),0) as s FROM orders 
      WHERE user_id=? AND status NOT IN ('Refund', 'Deleted') AND time > ?
    `).get(u.id, thirtyDaysAgo).s || 0;
    resellerDowngradeOmzet = parseInt(getSetting('reseller_downgrade_omzet') || 10000);
  }

  if (pending) {
    const elapsed = Date.now() - pending.time;
    if (elapsed >= 15 * 60 * 1000) {
      db.prepare("UPDATE topups SET status='Gagal (Expired)' WHERE trx_id=?").run(pending.trx_id);
      return res.render('user/deposit', { 
        title: 'Topup Saldo', u, pending: null, rupiah, qrisImage: null, cfg, 
        errMsg, minTopup, expiredTrx: pending, isReseller: isReseller(u), 
        resellerMinTopup, isClosed, omzet30d, resellerDowngradeOmzet 
      });
    }
  }

  const qrisImage = pending ? await qrisImageUrl(pending.qris_string) : null;
  res.render('user/deposit', { 
    title: 'Topup Saldo', u, pending: pending || null, rupiah, qrisImage, 
    cfg, errMsg, minTopup, expiredTrx: null, isReseller: isReseller(u), 
    resellerMinTopup, isClosed, omzet30d, resellerDowngradeOmzet 
  });
});

r.post('/deposit', (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  const minTopup = parseInt(getSetting('min_topup') || 1000);
  const amount = parseInt(req.body.amount);
  if (!amount || amount < minTopup) return res.redirect('/deposit?err=1');
  let ua;
  let attempts = 0;
  while (attempts < 100) {
    const { uniqueAmount: trialUa } = uniqueAmount(amount);
    const existing = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM topups WHERE unique_amount=? AND status IN ('Pending', 'Checking')").get(trialUa).c;
    if (existing === 0) {
      ua = trialUa;
      break;
    }
    attempts++;
  }

  if (!ua) return res.redirect('/deposit?err=2'); // Gagal generate kode unik setelah 100 percobaan

  const qStr = buildQrisString(ua);
  if (!qStr) return res.redirect('/deposit?err=2');
  const tid = topupId();
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO topups (user_id,trx_id,time,amount,unique_amount,qris_string) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)').run(u.id, tid, Date.now(), amount, ua, qStr);
  res.redirect('/deposit#qrisContainer');
});

r.post('/deposit/cancel', (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  db.prepare("UPDATE topups SET status='Batal' WHERE user_id=? AND status='Pending'").run(u.id);
  res.redirect('/deposit');
});

r.get('/api/check-deposit/:tid', async (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  const result = await processTopupById(req.params.tid);

  if (result.status === 'success') {
    return res.json({ status: 'success', reseller_upgraded: result.reseller_upgraded });
  } else if (result.status === 'expired') {
    return res.json({ status: 'expired' });
  } else if (result.status === 'pending') {
    const top = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM topups WHERE trx_id=?').get(req.params.tid);
    const elapsed = Date.now() - top.time;
    const remaining = Math.max(0, 15 * 60 * 1000 - elapsed);
    return res.json({ status: 'pending', remaining: Math.floor(remaining / 1000) });
  } else if (result.status === 'failed' || result.status === 'error') {
    return res.json({ status: 'failed' });
  }

  res.json({ status: 'pending' });
});

r.get('/trial/:type', async (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  const vpnType = req.params.type;
  const validTypes = ['ssh', 'vmess', 'vless', 'trojan'];
  if (!validTypes.includes(vpnType)) return res.redirect('/');
  
  const maxTrial = getMaxTrial(u);
  if (maxTrial === 0) return res.redirect('/');
  
  const oneDayAgo = Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const trialCount = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM trials WHERE user_id=? AND time > ?').get(u.id, oneDayAgo).c;
  if (trialCount >= maxTrial) return res.redirect('/');
  
  const trialCheck = canTrial(u);
  if (!trialCheck.ok) return res.redirect('/?trial_err=' + encodeURIComponent(trialCheck.reason));

  // Pagination
  const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(req.query.page) || 1);
  const limit = 5;
  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

  // Uptime Stats
  if (!uptimeCache.isValid()) {
    const fetchRes = await fetchAllServerStats();
    uptimeCache.set(fetchRes);
  }
  const stats = uptimeCache.get() || [];
  const uptimeMap = {};
  stats.forEach(s => {
    let loadHigh = false;
    if (s.status === 'online' && s.load && s.load !== '-') {
      const cs = s.cpu_per_core && s.cpu_per_core.length > 0 ? s.cpu_per_core.length : 1;
      const pts = s.load.replace(/\s/g,'').split(',');
      if (pts[0] && parseFloat(pts[0]) / cs >= 1.5) loadHigh = true;
    }
    uptimeMap[s.server_host] = { isOnline: s.status === 'online', loadHigh: loadHigh, ping: s.ping || 9999 };
  });

  const allPackages = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM vpn_packages WHERE vpn_type=? AND is_active=1').all(vpnType);
  
  // Group by Name (Avoid duplicates for Trial)
  const uniqueNames = new Set();
  const allServers = allPackages.filter(pkg => {
    if (uniqueNames.has(pkg.name)) return false;
    uniqueNames.add(pkg.name);
    return true;
  });
  
  // Sort and Map
  const processedServers = allServers.map(s => {
    const activeCount = getServerActiveCount(s.server_host);
    const uMap = uptimeMap[s.server_host] || { isOnline: false, loadHigh: false, ping: 9999 };
    const isFull = (s.max_server > 0 && activeCount >= s.max_server);
    const isRecommended = uMap.isOnline && !isFull && !uMap.loadHigh && uMap.ping < 150 && uMap.ping > 0;
    
    return {
      ...s,
      is_online: uMap.isOnline,
      ping: uMap.ping,
      is_full: isFull,
      is_recommended: isRecommended,
      active_count: activeCount
    };
  });

  processedServers.sort((a,b) => {
    if (a.is_recommended && !b.is_recommended) return -1;
    if (!a.is_recommended && b.is_recommended) return 1;
    if (!a.is_full && b.is_full) return -1;
    if (a.is_full && !b.is_full) return 1;
    return a.ping - b.ping;
  });

  const totalServers = processedServers.length;
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalServers / limit);
  const paginatedServers = processedServers.slice(offset, offset + limit);

  const errMsg = req.query.err ? decodeURIComponent(req.query.err) : null;
  res.render('user/trial-confirm', { 
    title: 'Konfirmasi Trial', 
    u, vpnType, 
    servers: paginatedServers, 
    rupiah, cfg, error: errMsg, 
    maxTrial, trialCount, 
    isReseller: isReseller(u),
    page, totalPages, totalServers
  });
});

r.post('/trial/:type', async (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  const vpnType = req.params.type;
  const validTypes = ['ssh', 'vmess', 'vless', 'trojan'];
  if (!validTypes.includes(vpnType)) return res.redirect('/');
  const maxTrial = getMaxTrial(u);
  if (maxTrial === 0) return res.redirect('/');
  const oneDayAgo = Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const trialCount = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM trials WHERE user_id=? AND time > ?').get(u.id, oneDayAgo).c;
  if (trialCount >= maxTrial) return res.redirect('/');
  const trialCheck = canTrial(u);
  if (!trialCheck.ok) return res.redirect('/trial/' + vpnType + '?err=' + encodeURIComponent(trialCheck.reason));
  const selectedPkgId = req.body.pkg_id ? parseInt(req.body.pkg_id) : null;
  let pkg;
  if (selectedPkgId) pkg = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM vpn_packages WHERE id=? AND vpn_type=? AND is_active=1').get(selectedPkgId, vpnType);
  if (!pkg) pkg = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM vpn_packages WHERE vpn_type=? AND is_active=1 ORDER BY sort_order,price LIMIT 1').get(vpnType);
  if (!pkg) return res.redirect('/');
  try {
    const apiRes = await trialAccount(vpnType, pkg.server_host);
    if (!apiRes || apiRes.status === 'failed' || apiRes.status === 'error') {
      return res.redirect('/trial/' + vpnType + '?err=' + encodeURIComponent('Gagal membuat akun trial. Coba lagi nanti.'));
    }
    const d = apiRes.data || {};
    const expTime = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000);
    const vpnExpTrial = d.exp && d.exp !== '-' ? d.exp : `${expTime.getFullYear()}-${String(expTime.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(expTime.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}, ${String(expTime.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(expTime.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    const result = db.prepare(`INSERT INTO trials
      (user_id, vpn_type, server_host, server_name, server_label, vpn_user, vpn_pass, vpn_exp, vpn_auth, vpn_tls, vpn_ntls, vpn_grpc, vpn_isp, vpn_city, vpn_domain, raw_result, time)
      VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
    `).run(
      u.id, vpnType, pkg.server_host,
      pkg.name,
      pkg.server_label || pkg.server_host,
      d.user || '-',
      d.pass || '-',
      vpnExpTrial,
      d.auth || '-',
      d.tls || '-',
      d.ntls || '-',
      d.grpc || '-',
      d.isp || '-',
      d.city || '-',
      d.domain || pkg.server_host,
      JSON.stringify(d),
      Date.now()
    );
    const serverLabel = pkg.name || pkg.server_label;
    // FIX: Reload user agar is_reseller terbaca dengan benar
    const freshUser = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(u.id);
    notifTrial(freshUser, vpnType, serverLabel, vpnExpTrial).catch(() => {});
    res.redirect('/trial/' + vpnType + '/detail/' + result.lastInsertRowid);
  } catch (e) {
    return res.redirect('/trial/' + vpnType + '?err=' + encodeURIComponent('Error: ' + e.message));
  }
});

r.post('/order/:packageId', async (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  const pkg = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM vpn_packages WHERE id=? AND is_active=1').get(req.params.packageId);
  if (!pkg) return res.redirect('/');
  const fresh = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(u.id);
  const showErr = (msg) => res.redirect('/order/' + req.params.packageId + '?err=' + encodeURIComponent(msg));

  const activeCount = getServerActiveCount(pkg.server_host);
  const isFull = pkg.max_server > 0 && activeCount >= pkg.max_server;
  if (isFull) return showErr('Server sudah penuh. Silakan pilih server lain.');

  const durasiHari = parseInt(req.body.durasi_hari) || pkg.duration;
  if (durasiHari < 1 || durasiHari > 365) return showErr('Durasi tidak valid. Minimal 1 hari, maksimal 365 hari.');

  const basePrice = resellerPrice(fresh, pkg.price);
  const pricePerDay = Math.ceil(basePrice / 30);
  const finalPrice = pricePerDay * durasiHari;

  if (parseFloat(fresh.saldo) < finalPrice) return showErr('Saldo tidak mencukupi. Silakan topup terlebih dahulu.');

  const vpnUser = (req.body.vpn_user || '').trim();
  if (!vpnUser || vpnUser.length < 4 || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9.]+$/.test(vpnUser)) return showErr('Username tidak valid. Minimal 4 karakter, hanya huruf, angka, dan titik.');

  let vpnPass = '';
  if (pkg.vpn_type === 'ssh') {
    vpnPass = (req.body.vpn_pass || '').trim();
    if (!vpnPass || vpnPass.length < 6) return showErr('Password tidak valid. Minimal 6 karakter.');
  }

  const oid = orderId();
  const limitIp = String(pkg.limit_ip || 2);
  const limitKuota = String(pkg.limit_kuota || 0);
  const exp = String(durasiHari);
  const before = parseFloat(fresh.saldo);
  const after = before - finalPrice;
  db.prepare('UPDATE users SET saldo=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(after, Date.now(), fresh.id);

  try {
    const apiRes = await createAccount(pkg.vpn_type, pkg.server_host, vpnUser, vpnPass, limitIp, limitKuota, exp);
    if (!apiRes || apiRes.status === 'failed' || apiRes.status === 'error') {
      db.prepare('UPDATE users SET saldo=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(before, Date.now(), fresh.id);
      return showErr('Gagal membuat akun VPN: ' + (apiRes?.message || 'Error server'));
    }
    const d = apiRes.data || {};
    const expDate = new Date();
    expDate.setDate(expDate.getDate() + durasiHari);
    const vpnExp = `${expDate.getFullYear()}-${String(expDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(expDate.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    db.prepare(`INSERT INTO orders (user_id,order_id,time,server_host,server_name,package_name,vpn_type,duration,price,status,vpn_user,vpn_pass,vpn_exp,vpn_auth,vpn_tls,vpn_ntls,vpn_grpc,vpn_isp,vpn_city,vpn_domain,raw_result,package_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`).run(
      fresh.id, oid, Date.now(), pkg.server_host, pkg.server_label || pkg.server_host, pkg.name,
      pkg.vpn_type, durasiHari, finalPrice, 'Aktif',
      d.user || vpnUser, pkg.vpn_type === 'ssh' ? vpnPass : '-',
      vpnExp, d.auth || '-', d.tls || '-', d.ntls || '-', d.grpc || '-',
      d.isp || '-', d.city || '-', d.domain || pkg.server_host, JSON.stringify(d),
      pkg.id
    );
    mutation(fresh.id, 'ORDER', -finalPrice, `Order ${pkg.vpn_type.toUpperCase()} - ${pkg.name} (${durasiHari} hari)`, oid, before, after);
    const countAfter = getServerActiveCount(pkg.server_host);
    const orderObj = {
      order_id: oid,
      server_name: pkg.name,
      server_host: pkg.server_host,
      vpn_type: pkg.vpn_type,
      vpn_user: d.user || vpnUser,
      duration: durasiHari,
      price: finalPrice,
    };
    // FIX: Reload user agar is_reseller terbaca dengan benar di notif
    const freshForNotif = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(fresh.id);
    notifOrder(freshForNotif, orderObj, countAfter).catch(() => {});
    res.redirect('/history?order=' + oid);
  } catch (e) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET saldo=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(before, Date.now(), fresh.id);
    return showErr('Error: ' + e.message);
  }
});

r.post('/renew/:oid', async (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  const order = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_id=? AND user_id=?').get(req.params.oid, u.id);
  if (!order) return res.redirect('/history');
  const pkg = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM vpn_packages WHERE name=? AND server_host=? AND vpn_type=? AND is_active=1').get(order.package_name, order.server_host, order.vpn_type);
  const fresh = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(u.id);
  const showErr = (msg) => res.redirect('/renew/' + order.order_id + '?err=' + encodeURIComponent(msg));
  if (!pkg) return showErr('Paket VPN sudah tidak tersedia.');

  const durasiHari = parseInt(req.body.durasi_hari) || pkg.duration;
  if (durasiHari < 1 || durasiHari > 365) return showErr('Durasi tidak valid. Minimal 1 hari, maksimal 365 hari.');

  const basePrice = resellerPrice(fresh, pkg.price);
  const pricePerDay = Math.ceil(basePrice / 30);
  const finalPrice = pricePerDay * durasiHari;

  if (parseFloat(fresh.saldo) < finalPrice) return showErr('Saldo tidak mencukupi. Silakan topup terlebih dahulu.');

  const before = parseFloat(fresh.saldo);
  const after = before - finalPrice;
  db.prepare('UPDATE users SET saldo=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(after, Date.now(), fresh.id);

  try {
    const apiRes = await renewAccount(order.vpn_type, order.server_host, order.vpn_user, String(durasiHari));
    if (!apiRes || apiRes.status === 'failed' || apiRes.status === 'error') {
      db.prepare('UPDATE users SET saldo=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(before, Date.now(), fresh.id);
      return showErr('Gagal perpanjang akun VPN: ' + (apiRes?.message || 'Error server'));
    }
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    let baseDate;
    if (order.vpn_exp && order.vpn_exp !== '-') {
      const [y, m, d] = order.vpn_exp.split('-').map(Number);
      const expDate = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
      baseDate = expDate > today ? expDate : today;
    } else {
      baseDate = today;
    }
    baseDate.setDate(baseDate.getDate() + durasiHari);
    const newVpnExp = `${baseDate.getFullYear()}-${String(baseDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(baseDate.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    db.prepare('UPDATE orders SET vpn_exp=?, status=?, duration=?, price=? WHERE order_id=?').run(
      newVpnExp, 'Aktif',
      order.duration + durasiHari,
      order.price + finalPrice,
      order.order_id
    );
    mutation(fresh.id, 'RENEW', -finalPrice, `Perpanjang ${order.vpn_type.toUpperCase()} - ${order.package_name} (${durasiHari} hari)`, order.order_id, before, after);
    const countAfter = getServerActiveCount(order.server_host);
    // FIX: Reload user agar is_reseller terbaca dengan benar di notif
    const freshForNotif = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(fresh.id);
    notifRenew(freshForNotif, order, durasiHari, finalPrice, countAfter).catch(() => {});
    res.redirect('/history/' + order.order_id + '?renewed=1');
  } catch (e) {
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET saldo=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(before, Date.now(), fresh.id);
    return showErr('Error: ' + e.message);
  }
});

r.get('/delete/:oid', (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  if (!isReseller(u) && !req.session.isAdmin) return res.redirect('/history');
  
  const order = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_id=? AND user_id=?').get(req.params.oid, u.id);
  if (!order) return res.redirect('/history');
  if (order.status === 'Deleted') return res.redirect('/history/' + order.order_id);

  let sisaHariAsli = 0;
  let sisaHariRefund = 0;
  let refundAmount = 0;
  let pricePerDay = 0;

  if (order.vpn_exp && order.vpn_exp !== '-') {
    const [y, m, d] = order.vpn_exp.split('-').map(Number);
    const exp = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
    const now = new Date();
    now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    
    sisaHariAsli = Math.floor((exp - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

    // Proteksi: Jika sisa hari 1 atau kurang, tidak boleh ke halaman delete
    if (sisaHariAsli <= 1) {
      return res.redirect('/history/' + order.order_id + '?err=' + encodeURIComponent('Minimal sisa 2 hari untuk melakukan refund hapus akun.'));
    }

    // Logika Pinalti 1 Hari
    sisaHariRefund = sisaHariAsli - 1;

    const pkg = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM vpn_packages WHERE name=? AND server_host=? AND vpn_type=?').get(order.package_name, order.server_host, order.vpn_type);
    if (pkg) {
      pricePerDay = Math.ceil(resellerPrice(u, pkg.price) / 30);
      refundAmount = pricePerDay * sisaHariRefund;
    }
  }

  const errMsg = req.query.err ? decodeURIComponent(req.query.err) : null;
  
  // Kirim sisaHariRefund ke view agar user tahu berapa hari yang dibayar
  res.render('user/delete-confirm', { 
    title: 'Hapus Akun VPN', u, order, rupiah, cfg, 
    sisaHari: sisaHariRefund, 
    sisaHariAsli: sisaHariAsli,
    refundAmount, pricePerDay, error: errMsg 
  });
});

r.post('/delete/:oid', async (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  if (!isReseller(u) && !req.session.isAdmin) return res.redirect('/history');
  const order = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_id=? AND user_id=?').get(req.params.oid, u.id);
  if (!order) return res.redirect('/history');
  if (order.status === 'Deleted') return res.redirect('/history/' + order.order_id);
  const showErr = (msg) => res.redirect('/delete/' + order.order_id + '?err=' + encodeURIComponent(msg));

  let sisaHariAsli = 0;
  let refundAmount = 0;
  let sisaHariRefund = 0;

  if (order.vpn_exp && order.vpn_exp !== '-') {
    const [y, m, d] = order.vpn_exp.split('-').map(Number);
    const exp = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
    const now = new Date();
    now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    
    sisaHariAsli = Math.floor((exp - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    
    if (sisaHariAsli > 1) {
      sisaHariRefund = sisaHariAsli - 1;
    } else {
      sisaHariRefund = 0;
    }

    if (sisaHariRefund > 0) {
      const pkg = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM vpn_packages WHERE name=? AND server_host=? AND vpn_type=?').get(order.package_name, order.server_host, order.vpn_type);
      if (pkg) {
        const pricePerDay = Math.ceil(resellerPrice(u, pkg.price) / 30);
        refundAmount = pricePerDay * sisaHariRefund;
      }
    }
  }

  try {
    await deleteAccount(order.vpn_type, order.server_host, order.vpn_user);
  } catch (e) {
    return showErr('Gagal menghapus akun di server: ' + e.message);
  }

  db.prepare("UPDATE orders SET status='Deleted' WHERE order_id=?").run(order.order_id);

  if (refundAmount > 0) {
    const fresh = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(u.id);
    const before = parseFloat(fresh.saldo);
    const after = before + refundAmount;
    db.prepare('UPDATE users SET saldo=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(after, Date.now(), u.id);
    mutation(u.id, 'REFUND', refundAmount, `Refund hapus ${order.vpn_type.toUpperCase()} - ${order.package_name} (Sisa ${sisaHariAsli} hari, Refund ${sisaHariRefund} hari)`, order.order_id, before, after);
  }

  const countAfter = getServerActiveCount(order.server_host);
  const freshForNotif = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(u.id);
  notifDelete(freshForNotif, order, sisaHariRefund, refundAmount, countAfter).catch(() => {});

  res.redirect('/history/' + order.order_id + '?deleted=1');
});

r.get('/history', (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  const tab = req.query.tab === 'trial' ? 'trial' : 'order';
  const q = (req.query.q || '').trim();

  const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(req.query.page || 1));
  const limit = 10;
  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

  let orders = [];
  let trials = [];
  let total = 0;

  if (tab === 'trial') {
    const like = `%${q}%`;
    if (q) {
      total = db.prepare(
        `SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM trials WHERE user_id=?
         AND (server_name LIKE ? OR server_label LIKE ? OR vpn_user LIKE ? OR vpn_type LIKE ?)`
      ).get(u.id, like, like, like, like).c;
      trials = db.prepare(
        `SELECT * FROM trials WHERE user_id=?
         AND (server_name LIKE ? OR server_label LIKE ? OR vpn_user LIKE ? OR vpn_type LIKE ?)
         ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`
      ).all(u.id, like, like, like, like, limit, offset);
    } else {
      total = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM trials WHERE user_id=?').get(u.id).c;
      trials = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM trials WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?').all(u.id, limit, offset);
    }
  } else {
    const like = `%${q}%`;
    if (q) {
      total = db.prepare(
        `SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM orders WHERE user_id=?
         AND (order_id LIKE ? OR package_name LIKE ? OR server_name LIKE ? OR server_host LIKE ? OR vpn_user LIKE ?)`
      ).get(u.id, like, like, like, like, like).c;
      orders = db.prepare(
        `SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id=?
         AND (order_id LIKE ? OR package_name LIKE ? OR server_name LIKE ? OR server_host LIKE ? OR vpn_user LIKE ?)
         ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`
      ).all(u.id, like, like, like, like, like, limit, offset);
    } else {
      total = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM orders WHERE user_id=?').get(u.id).c;
      orders = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?').all(u.id, limit, offset);
    }
  }

  const newOrder = req.query.order
    ? db.prepare('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_id=? AND user_id=?').get(req.query.order, u.id)
    : null;

  res.render('user/history', {
    title: 'Riwayat Order', u, orders, trials, newOrder,
    rupiah, page, total, limit, cfg, tab, q
  });
});

r.post('/settings', (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);
  const showErr = (msg) => res.redirect('/settings?err=' + encodeURIComponent(msg));
  if (!u.password) return showErr('Akun ini tidak bisa ganti password.');
  const { old_password, new_password, confirm_password } = req.body;
  const hasOld = old_password && old_password.trim();
  const hasNew = new_password && new_password.trim();
  const hasCfm = confirm_password && confirm_password.trim();
  if (!hasOld && !hasNew && !hasCfm) return showErr('Silakan isi semua kolom password.');
  if (!hasOld || !hasNew || !hasCfm) return showErr('Semua kolom password harus diisi.');
  if (!bcrypt.compareSync(old_password, u.password)) return showErr('Password lama salah.');
  if (old_password === new_password) return showErr('Password baru tidak boleh sama dengan password lama.');
  if (new_password.length < 6) return showErr('Password baru minimal 6 karakter.');
  if (new_password !== confirm_password) return showErr('Konfirmasi password tidak cocok.');
  db.prepare('UPDATE users SET password=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?').run(bcrypt.hashSync(new_password, 10), Date.now(), u.id);
  res.redirect('/settings?success=' + encodeURIComponent('Password berhasil diperbarui.'));
});

function formatKuotaResult(rawText) {
  return rawText
    .replace(/(Paket\s+\d+:\s+)Paket\s+/gm, "$1")
    .replace(/^Nomor:/gm, "📱 Nomor:")
    .replace(/^Tipe Kartu:/gm, "💳 Tipe Kartu:")
    .replace(/^Status 4G:/gm, "📶 Status 4G:")
    .replace(/^Status Dukcapil:/gm, "🧾 Status Dukcapil:")
    .replace(/^Umur Kartu:/gm, "⏳ Umur Kartu:")
    .replace(/^Masa Aktif:/gm, "📆 Masa Aktif:")
    .replace(/^Masa Berakhir Tenggang:/gm, "⛔ Akhir Tenggang:")
    .replace(/^Detail Kuota:/gm, "💎 Detail Kuota:")
    .replace(/^Paket\s+(\d+):/gm, "🗂️ Paket $1:")
    .replace(/^\s*Benefit\s*:/gm, "🎁 Benefit:")
    .replace(/^Aktif Hingga:/gm, "⏳ Aktif Hingga:")
    .replace(/^- /gm, "🔹 ");
}

async function cekKuotaXL(nomor) {
  try {
    const url = `https://bendith.my.id/end.php?check=package&number=${nomor}&version=2`;
    const res = await axios.get(url, {
      timeout: 15000,
      headers: { accept: 'application/json', 'user-agent': 'Mozilla/5.0' }
    });
    if (!res.data || !res.data.success) {
      return { success: false, data: 'Status Pengecekan Gagal.' };
    }
    const subs = res.data.data?.subs_info;
    const packages = res.data.data?.package_info?.packages || [];
    if (!subs) return { success: false, data: 'Data pelanggan tidak ditemukan.' };

    let rawText =
`Nomor: ${subs.msisdn}
Tipe Kartu: ${subs.operator}
Status 4G: ${subs.net_type}
Status Dukcapil: ${subs.id_verified}
Umur Kartu: ${subs.tenure}
Masa Aktif: ${subs.exp_date}
Masa Berakhir Tenggang: ${subs.grace_until}
Detail Kuota:
`;
    if (packages.length > 0) {
      packages.forEach((pkg, index) => {
        rawText += `\nPaket ${index + 1}: ${pkg.name}\nAktif Hingga: ${pkg.expiry}\nBenefit:\n`;
        if (pkg.quotas && pkg.quotas.length > 0) {
          pkg.quotas.forEach(q => {
            rawText += `- ${q.name}\n  Sisa: ${q.remaining} / ${q.total} (${q.percent}%)\n`;
          });
        } else {
          rawText += `- Tidak ada detail kuota\n`;
        }
      });
    } else {
      rawText += `Tidak ada paket aktif.\n`;
    }
    return { success: true, data: rawText.trim() + '\n' };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, data: 'Status Pengecekan Gagal (Error API).' };
  }
}

async function whoisDomain(domain) {
  try {
    const initialResponse = await axios.get('https://dnsimple.com/whois', {
      headers: {
        'user-agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/96.0.4664.110 Safari/537.36'
      }
    });
    const tokenMatch = initialResponse.data.match(/<meta name="csrf-token" content="([^"]+)"/);
    const token = tokenMatch ? tokenMatch[1] : null;
    if (!token) throw new Error('Token not found!');
    const cookies = initialResponse.headers['set-cookie'];
    const cookieString = cookies ? cookies.join('; ') : '';
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      '_method': 'put',
      'authenticity_token': token,
      'id': domain,
      'commit': 'Check domain'
    });
    const response = await axios.post('https://dnsimple.com/whois/query', params, {
      headers: {
        'authority': 'dnsimple.com',
        'accept': 'text/javascript, application/javascript, application/ecmascript, application/x-ecmascript, */*; q=0.01',
        'accept-language': 'id-ID,id;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7',
        'content-type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
        'cookie': cookieString,
        'origin': 'https://dnsimple.com',
        'referer': 'https://dnsimple.com/whois',
        'user-agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
        'x-requested-with': 'XMLHttpRequest'
      }
    });
    const match = response.data.match(/<pre[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/pre>/s);
    const result = match ? match[1].trim() : response.data;
    const isFailure = /invalid request|no match for|unable to connect|domain not found/i.test(result);
    if (isFailure) throw new Error(result);
    return { success: true, message: result };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, message: error.message };
  }
}

async function findSubdomains(domain) {
  try {
    const subdomains = new Set();
    const response = await axios.get(`https://api.hackertarget.com/hostsearch/?q=${domain}`, {
      headers: {
        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
        'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',
        'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.5'
      }
    });
    if (typeof response.data === 'string') {
      response.data.split('\n').forEach(line => {
        const parts = line.split(',');
        if (parts[0] && parts[0].endsWith(domain)) {
          subdomains.add(parts[0].trim().toLowerCase());
        }
      });
    }
    const uniqueSubdomains = Array.from(subdomains).sort();
    if (uniqueSubdomains.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, message: 'No subdomains found for this domain.' };
    }
    const isIPInRange = (ip, cidr) => {
      const [range, bits] = cidr.split('/');
      const mask = ~(2 ** (32 - bits) - 1);
      const ipToNumber = (i) => i.split('.').reduce((acc, octet) => (acc << 8) + parseInt(octet), 0) >>> 0;
      return (ipToNumber(ip) & mask) === (ipToNumber(range) & mask);
    };
    const checkCloudflare = async (subdomain) => {
      try {
        const ipResponse = await dns.resolve4(subdomain);
        const ip = ipResponse[0];
        const cfResponse = await axios.get('https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/ips');
        for (const range of cfResponse.data.result.ipv4_cidrs) {
          if (isIPInRange(ip, range)) return true;
        }
        return false;
      } catch { return false; }
    };
    const cfChecks = await Promise.allSettled(uniqueSubdomains.map(sub => checkCloudflare(sub)));
    let formattedMessage = `Found ${uniqueSubdomains.length} subdomain(s):\n\n`;
    uniqueSubdomains.forEach((sub, index) => {
      const isCloudflare = cfChecks[index].status === 'fulfilled' && cfChecks[index].value;
      formattedMessage += `${index + 1}. ${sub} [${isCloudflare ? 'Cloudflare' : 'Non-CF'}]\n`;
    });
    return { success: true, message: formattedMessage };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, message: error.message };
  }
}

async function hostToIP(host) {
  try {
    const results = { ipv4: [], ipv6: [] };
    try { results.ipv4 = await dns.resolve4(host); } catch { results.ipv4 = []; }
    try { results.ipv6 = await dns.resolve6(host); } catch { results.ipv6 = []; }
    if (results.ipv4.length === 0 && results.ipv6.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, message: `No IP addresses found for host: ${host}` };
    }
    let message = '';
    if (results.ipv4.length > 0) message += 'IPv4 Addresses:\n' + results.ipv4.join('\n');
    if (results.ipv6.length > 0) {
      if (message) message += '\n\n';
      message += 'IPv6 Addresses:\n' + results.ipv6.join('\n');
    }
    return { success: true, message };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, message: err.message };
  }
}

function validateIPv4(ip) {
  return /^(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)$/.test(ip);
}

function validateIPv6(ip) {
  return /^(([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){7}[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,7}:|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,6}:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,5}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,2}|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,4}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,3}|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,3}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,4}|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,2}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,5}|[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:((:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,6})|:((:[0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}){1,7}|:)|fe80:(:[0-9a-fA-F]{0,4}){0,4}%[0-9a-zA-Z]{1,}|::(ffff(:0{1,4}){0,1}:){0,1}((25[0-5]|(2[0-4]|1{0,1}[0-9]){0,1}[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|(2[0-4]|1{0,1}[0-9]){0,1}[0-9])|([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){1,4}:((25[0-5]|(2[0-4]|1{0,1}[0-9]){0,1}[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|(2[0-4]|1{0,1}[0-9]){0,1}[0-9]))$/.test(ip);
}

async function IPLookup(ip) {
  try {
    if (!validateIPv4(ip) && !validateIPv6(ip)) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Invalid IP address format! Please enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.' };
    }
    const response = await axios.get(`https://ipsearch.io/ip-lookup/?ip=${ip}`, {
      headers: {
        'Referer': `https://ipsearch.io/ip-lookup/?ip=${ip}`,
        'Upgrade-Insecure-Requests': '1',
        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
        'sec-ch-ua': '"Chromium";v="107", "Not=A?Brand";v="24"',
        'sec-ch-ua-mobile': '?1',
        'sec-ch-ua-platform': '"Windows"'
      }
    });
    const html = response.data;
    const extractData = (label) => {
      const regex = new RegExp(`<span class="ipCat">\\s*${label}:\\s*</span>\\s*<span class="ipData">\\s*([^<]+)`, 'i');
      const match = html.match(regex);
      return match ? match[1].trim() : '';
    };
    const ipAddress = extractData('IP Address');
    if (!ipAddress || html.includes('Invalid IP') || html.includes('not found')) {
      return { success: false, message: `No information found for IP address: ${ip}` };
    }
    const data = {
      'IP Address': ipAddress,
      'ASN': extractData('ASN'),
      'ISP': extractData('ISP'),
      'Organization': extractData('Organization'),
      'Connection type': extractData('Connection type'),
      'Continent': extractData('Continent'),
      'Country': extractData('Country'),
      'Region': extractData('Region'),
      'City': extractData('City'),
      'Postal code': extractData('Postal code'),
      'Latitude': extractData('Latitude'),
      'Longitude': extractData('Longitude'),
      'Time zone': extractData('Time zone')
    };
    let formattedMessage = `IP Details For: ${ipAddress}\n\n`;
    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      if (key !== 'IP Address' && value && value.trim() !== '' && value !== 'N/A' && value !== '()') {
        formattedMessage += `${key}: ${value}\n`;
      }
    });
    return { success: true, message: formattedMessage.trim() };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, message: `Failed to lookup IP address: ${error.message}` };
  }
}

  });
});

r.post('/tools/convert-bug', (req, res) => {
  const { link, bug } = req.body;
  if (!link || !bug) return res.json({ success: false, message: 'Link dan bug harus diisi.' });

  const bugHost = bugSettings[bug];
  if (!bugHost) return res.json({ success: false, message: 'Bug tidak dikenali.' });

  const isWC  = bug.toLowerCase().includes('wc');
  const isSNI = bug.toLowerCase().includes('sni');

  const getFinalHost = (isSNI, isWC, bugHost, originalHost) => {
    if (isSNI) return originalHost;
    if (isWC) {
      if (originalHost.startsWith(`${bugHost}.`)) return originalHost;
      return `${bugHost}.${originalHost}`;
    }
    return originalHost;
  };

  try {
    if (link.startsWith('vmess://')) {
      const decoded = Buffer.from(link.replace('vmess://', ''), 'base64').toString('utf8');
      const obj = JSON.parse(decoded);
      const originalHost = obj.host || '';
      const finalHost = getFinalHost(isSNI, isWC, bugHost, originalHost);
      obj.add  = isSNI ? originalHost : bugHost;
      obj.host = isSNI ? '' : finalHost;
      obj.sni  = isSNI ? bugHost : finalHost;
      const encoded = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(obj)).toString('base64');
      return res.json({ success: true, type: 'VMESS', result: `vmess://${encoded}`, originalHost, bug: bugHost });
    }

    if (link.startsWith('vless://')) {
      const hostMatch = link.match(/host=([^&#]*)/);
      const originalHost = hostMatch ? hostMatch[1] : '';
      const finalHost = getFinalHost(isSNI, isWC, bugHost, originalHost);
      const finalSni  = isSNI ? bugHost : finalHost;
      const result = link
        .replace(/@(.*?):/, `@${isSNI ? originalHost : bugHost}:`)
        .replace(/host=([^&#]*)/, `host=${isSNI ? '' : finalHost}`)
        .replace(/sni=([^&#]*)/, `sni=${finalSni}`);
      return res.json({ success: true, type: 'VLESS', result, originalHost, bug: bugHost });
    }

    if (link.startsWith('trojan://')) {
      const hostMatch = link.match(/host=([^&#]*)/);
      const originalHost = hostMatch ? hostMatch[1] : '';
      const finalHost = getFinalHost(isSNI, isWC, bugHost, originalHost);
      const finalSni  = isSNI ? bugHost : finalHost;
      const result = link
        .replace(/@(.*?):/, `@${isSNI ? originalHost : bugHost}:`)
        .replace(/host=([^&#]*)/, `host=${isSNI ? '' : finalHost}`)
        .replace(/sni=([^&#]*)/, `sni=${finalSni}`);
      return res.json({ success: true, type: 'TROJAN', result, originalHost, bug: bugHost });
    }

    return res.json({ success: false, message: 'Format link tidak dikenali. Gunakan vmess://, vless://, atau trojan://.' });
  } catch (e) {
    return res.json({ success: false, message: 'Gagal memproses link: ' + e.message });
  }
});

r.post('/tools/convert-yml', async (req, res) => {
  const { link, config_type, yml_type } = req.body;
  if (!link || !config_type || !yml_type) {
    return res.json({ success: false, message: 'Parameter tidak lengkap.' });
  }
  if (!/^(vmess|vless|trojan):\/\//.test(link)) {
    return res.json({ success: false, message: 'Format link tidak valid.' });
  }

  const configMap = {
    'urltest_redir':              'base/database/config/custom/groups/urltest_redir.ini',
    'urltest_fake':               'base/database/config/custom/groups/urltest_fake.ini',
    'adblock_urltest_redir':      'base/database/config/custom/adblocks/adblock_urltest_redir.ini',
    'adblock_urltest_fake':       'base/database/config/custom/adblocks/adblock_urltest_fake.ini',
    'allgroup_redir':             'base/database/config/custom/groups/allgroup_redir.ini',
    'allgroup_fake':              'base/database/config/custom/groups/allgroup_fake.ini',
    'adblock_allgroup_redir':     'base/database/config/custom/adblocks/adblock_allgroup_redir.ini',
    'adblock_allgroup_fake':      'base/database/config/custom/adblocks/adblock_allgroup_fake.ini',
    'cfm_urltest_redir':          'base/database/config/custom/groups/cfm_urltest_redir.ini',
    'cfm_urltest_fake':           'base/database/config/custom/groups/cfm_urltest_fake.ini',
    'cfm_adblock_urltest_redir':  'base/database/config/custom/adblocks/cfm_adblock_urltest_redir.ini',
    'cfm_adblock_urltest_fake':   'base/database/config/custom/adblocks/cfm_adblock_urltest_fake.ini',
    'cfm_allgroup_redir':         'base/database/config/custom/groups/cfm_allgroup_redir.ini',
    'cfm_allgroup_fake':          'base/database/config/custom/groups/cfm_allgroup_fake.ini',
    'cfm_adblock_allgroup_redir': 'base/database/config/custom/adblocks/cfm_adblock_allgroup_redir.ini',
    'cfm_adblock_allgroup_fake':  'base/database/config/custom/adblocks/cfm_adblock_allgroup_fake.ini',
  };

  const config = configMap[config_type];
  if (!config) return res.json({ success: false, message: 'Tipe config tidak dikenali.' });

  try {
    const response = await axios.get('https://sub.bonds.id/sub2', {
      timeout: 20000,
      params: {
        target: 'clash', url: link, insert: 'false',
        config, emoji: 'false', list: 'false', udp: 'true',
        tfo: 'false', expand: 'false', scv: 'true',
        fdn: 'false', sort: 'false', new_name: 'true'
      },
      headers: { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0', 'Accept': 'text/html,*/*' }
    });

    let ymlContent = response.data;
    ymlContent = ymlContent.replace(/FASTSSH-SSHKIT-HOWDY/g, 'TOKOVPN-2026');
    ymlContent = ymlContent.replace(/^(\s*)path:\s*.*(trojan[^\s]*)/gmi, '$1path: /$2');

    return res.json({ success: true, content: ymlContent, filename: `TokoVPN_${Date.now()}.yml` });
  } catch (e) {
    return res.json({ success: false, message: 'Gagal mengambil konfigurasi YML: ' + e.message });
  }
});

r.get('/uptime', async (req, res) => {
  const u = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?').get(req.session.userId);

  if (!uptimeCache.isValid()) {
    const freshStats = await fetchAllServerStats();
    uptimeCache.set(freshStats);
  }

  const stats = uptimeCache.get().slice();
  stats.sort((a, b) => {
    let loadA = false;
    if (a.status === 'online' && a.load && a.load !== '-') {
       const csA = a.cpu_per_core ? a.cpu_per_core.length : 1;
       const ptsA = a.load.replace(/\s/g,'').split(',');
       if (ptsA[0] && parseFloat(ptsA[0]) / Math.max(1, csA) >= 1.5) loadA = true;
    }
    let loadB = false;
    if (b.status === 'online' && b.load && b.load !== '-') {
       const csB = b.cpu_per_core ? b.cpu_per_core.length : 1;
       const ptsB = b.load.replace(/\s/g,'').split(',');
       if (ptsB[0] && parseFloat(ptsB[0]) / Math.max(1, csB) >= 1.5) loadB = true;
    }
    if (loadA && !loadB) return 1;
    if (!loadA && loadB) return -1;
    return 0;
  });
  const onlineCount  = stats.filter(s => s.status === 'online').length;
  const offlineCount = stats.filter(s => s.status === 'offline').length;
  const pings        = stats.filter(s => s.ping !== null).map(s => s.ping);
  const avgPing      = pings.length ? Math.round(pings.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / pings.length) : 0;

  // ✅ Pakai waktu cache dibuat, bukan new Date()
  const checkedAt = new Date(uptimeCache.lastFetch).toLocaleString('id-ID', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta' });

  res.render('user/uptime', {
    title: 'Server Uptime',
    u, cfg, rupiah,
    stats,
    onlineCount,
    offlineCount,
    avgPing,
    isReseller: isReseller(u),
    checkedAt, // ← semua user dapat waktu yang sama
  });
});

r.get('/api/uptime-stats', async (req, res) => {
  if (!uptimeCache.isValid()) {
    const freshStats = await fetchAllServerStats();
    uptimeCache.set(freshStats);
  }

  const stats = uptimeCache.get().map(s => ({
    server_host:  s.server_host,
    status:       s.status,
    ping:         s.ping,
    cpu:          s.cpu,
    cpu_per_core: s.cpu_per_core,   // ← tambah
    mem_percent:  s.mem_percent,
    mem_used:     s.mem_used,       // ← tambah
    mem_total:    s.mem_total,      // ← tambah
    disk_percent: s.disk_percent,
    disk_used:    s.disk_used,      // ← tambah
    disk_total:   s.disk_total,     // ← tambah
    uptime:       s.uptime,
    load:         s.load,
    rx:           s.rx,             // ← tambah
    tx:           s.tx,             // ← tambah
    error:        s.error,
  }));

  const checkedAt = new Date(uptimeCache.lastFetch).toLocaleString('id-ID', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta' });
  res.json({ stats, checkedAt });
});

module.exports = r;

<script>
/* ══ SIDEBAR ══ */
function toggleSidebar() {
  var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  var ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var mn = document.getElementById('main');
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    var open = sb.classList.toggle('show');
    ov.classList.toggle('show', open);
  } else {
    var hidden = sb.classList.toggle('hidden');
    mn.style.marginLeft = hidden ? '0' : '248px';
    mn.style.width      = hidden ? '100%' : 'calc(100% - 248px)';
  }
}
function closeSidebar() {
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
  if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
    var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    sb.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
    if (!sb.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      document.getElementById('main').style.marginLeft = '248px';
      document.getElementById('main').style.width = 'calc(100% - 248px)';
    }
  }
});

/* ══ MODAL ══ */
function openModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop').forEach(function(bd) {
  bd.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === bd) closeModal(bd.id); });
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop.show').forEach(function(bd) { closeModal(bd.id); });
  }
});

/* ══ BROADCAST CONFIRM ══ */
function triggerBroadcast() {
  var subject = document.getElementById('inputSubject').value.trim();
  var message = document.getElementById('inputMessage').value.trim();

  if (!subject) { showToast('Subject email wajib diisi!', 'warn'); document.getElementById('inputSubject').focus(); return; }
  if (!message) { showToast('Isi pesan wajib diisi!', 'warn'); document.getElementById('inputMessage').focus(); return; }

  /* Populate preview */
  document.getElementById('previewSubject').textContent = subject;
  document.getElementById('previewMessage').textContent = message;

  /* Wire confirm button */
  document.getElementById('modalBroadcastConfirm').onclick = function() {
    closeModal('modalBroadcast');
    /* Disable send button & show spinner */
    var btn = document.getElementById('btnSend');
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner-sm"></div> Mengirim email ke seluruh member...';
    document.getElementById('broadcastForm').submit();
  };

  openModal('modalBroadcast');
}

/* ══ TOAST ══ */
function showToast(msg, type) {
  type = type || 'info';
  var icons = { success:'fa-circle-check', warn:'fa-triangle-exclamation', error:'fa-circle-xmark', info:'fa-circle-info' };
  var tc = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
  var el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'toast-item t-' + type;
  el.innerHTML = '<i class="fas ' + (icons[type] || icons.info) + '"></i><span>' + msg + '</span>';
  tc.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(function() {
    el.style.animation = 'toast-out .25s ease forwards';
    setTimeout(function() { el.remove(); }, 260);
  }, 3200);
}

/* Auto toast jika ada hasil kirim */
<% if (locals.sent) { %>
  showToast('Email berhasil dikirim ke <%= locals.success %> member!', 'success');
<% } else if (locals.err) { %>
  showToast('Subject dan pesan wajib diisi!', 'error');
<% } %>
</script>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
function toggleSidebar() {
  var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  var ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var mn = document.getElementById('main');
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    var open = sb.classList.toggle('show');
    ov.classList.toggle('show', open);
  } else {
    var hidden = sb.classList.toggle('hidden');
    mn.style.marginLeft = hidden ? '0' : '248px';
    mn.style.width = hidden ? '100%' : 'calc(100% - 248px)';
  }
}
function closeSidebar() {
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
}
function openModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
  if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
    closeSidebar();
    var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    if (!sb.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      document.getElementById('main').style.marginLeft = '248px';
      document.getElementById('main').style.width = 'calc(100% - 248px)';
    }
  }
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

          function pageRange(current, last) {
            const delta = 2, range = [], out = [];
            let l;
            for (let i = 1; i <= last; i++) {
              if (i === 1 || i === last || (i >= current - delta && i <= current + delta)) range.push(i);
            }
            for (const i of range) {
              if (l) {
                if (i - l === 2)     out.push(l + 1);
                else if (i - l > 2) out.push('...');
              }
              out.push(i); l = i;
            }
            return out;
          }
          const pages = pageRange(page, totalPages);
          const qBase = (q      ? `q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&`           : '') +

<script>
/* ══ SIDEBAR ══ */
function toggleSidebar() {
  var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  var ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var mn = document.getElementById('main');
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    var open = sb.classList.toggle('show');
    ov.classList.toggle('show', open);
  } else {
    var hidden = sb.classList.toggle('hidden');
    mn.style.marginLeft = hidden ? '0' : '248px';
    mn.style.width      = hidden ? '100%' : 'calc(100% - 248px)';
  }
}
function closeSidebar() {
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
  if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
    var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    sb.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
    if (!sb.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      document.getElementById('main').style.marginLeft = '248px';
      document.getElementById('main').style.width = 'calc(100% - 248px)';
    }
  }
});

/* ══ MODAL ══ */
function openModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop').forEach(function(bd) {
  bd.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === bd) closeModal(bd.id); });
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop.show').forEach(function(bd) { closeModal(bd.id); });
  }
});

/* ══ MODAL: DELETE ORDER ══ */
function openModalDeleteOrder(id, orderId, vpnExp, price, duration) {
  var infoEl = document.getElementById('modalDeleteOrderInfo');
  var descEl = document.getElementById('modalDeleteOrderDesc');

  descEl.textContent = 'Order ' + orderId + ' akan dihapus dan akun VPN di server akan dihapus otomatis.';
  infoEl.innerHTML = '';

  if (vpnExp && vpnExp !== '-' && vpnExp !== 'undefined' && vpnExp !== 'null' && price && duration) {
    var exp      = new Date(vpnExp);
    var now      = new Date(); now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    var sisaHari = Math.floor((exp - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

    if (sisaHari > 0) {
      var hargaPerHari = Math.floor(parseFloat(price) / parseInt(duration));
      var refund       = hargaPerHari * sisaHari;
      infoEl.innerHTML =
        '<div class="refund-box">' +
          '<div class="refund-box-title"><i class="fas fa-rotate-left"></i> Estimasi Refund Saldo</div>' +
          '<div class="refund-row"><span>Sisa masa aktif</span><span>' + sisaHari + ' hari</span></div>' +
          '<div class="refund-row"><span>Harga per hari</span><span>Rp ' + hargaPerHari.toLocaleString('id-ID') + '</span></div>' +
          '<div class="refund-row total"><span>Total refund ke user</span><span>Rp ' + refund.toLocaleString('id-ID') + '</span></div>' +
        '</div>';
    } else {
      infoEl.innerHTML = '<div class="no-refund-box"><i class="fas fa-circle-info" style="margin-right:5px;"></i>Akun sudah expired, tidak ada refund saldo.</div>';
    }
  } else {
    infoEl.innerHTML = '<div class="no-refund-box"><i class="fas fa-circle-info" style="margin-right:5px;"></i>Tidak ada data expired, tidak ada refund saldo.</div>';
  }

  document.getElementById('modalDeleteOrderConfirm').onclick = function () {
    var form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '/admin/orders/' + id + '/delete';
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
  };
  openModal('modalDeleteOrder');
}

/* ══ TOAST ══ */
function showToast(msg, type) {
  type = type || 'info';
  var icons = { success:'fa-circle-check', warn:'fa-triangle-exclamation', error:'fa-circle-xmark', info:'fa-circle-info' };
  var tc = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
  var el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'toast-item t-' + type;
  el.innerHTML = '<i class="fas ' + (icons[type] || icons.info) + '"></i><span>' + msg + '</span>';
  tc.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(function() {
    el.style.animation = 'toast-out .25s ease forwards';
    setTimeout(function() { el.remove(); }, 260);
  }, 3200);
}

<script>
/* ══ SIDEBAR ══ */
function toggleSidebar() {
  var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  var ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var mn = document.getElementById('main');
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    var open = sb.classList.toggle('show');
    ov.classList.toggle('show', open);
  } else {
    var hidden = sb.classList.toggle('hidden');
    mn.style.marginLeft = hidden ? '0' : '248px';
    mn.style.width      = hidden ? '100%' : 'calc(100% - 248px)';
  }
}
function closeSidebar() {
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
  if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
    var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    sb.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
    if (!sb.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      document.getElementById('main').style.marginLeft = '248px';
      document.getElementById('main').style.width = 'calc(100% - 248px)';
    }
  }
});

/* ══ MODAL ══ */
function openModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop').forEach(function(bd) {
  bd.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === bd) closeModal(bd.id); });
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop.show').forEach(function(bd) { closeModal(bd.id); });
  }
});

/* ══ MODAL: DELETE PAKET ══ */
function openModalDeletePkg(id, name) {
  document.getElementById('modalDeletePkgDesc').textContent =
    'Paket "' + name + '" akan dihapus secara permanen. Pengguna yang sudah order tidak terpengaruh.';
  document.getElementById('modalDeletePkgConfirm').onclick = function () {
    var form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '/admin/packages/' + id + '/delete';
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
  };
  openModal('modalDeletePkg');
}

/* ══ TOGGLE KUOTA ══ */
function toggleKuota(wrapId, type) {
  var el = document.getElementById(wrapId);
  if (!el) return;
  el.style.display = (type === 'ssh') ? 'none' : 'grid';
}

/* ══ TOAST ══ */
function showToast(msg, type) {
  type = type || 'info';
  var icons = { success:'fa-circle-check', warn:'fa-triangle-exclamation', error:'fa-circle-xmark', info:'fa-circle-info' };
  var tc = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
  var el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'toast-item t-' + type;
  el.innerHTML = '<i class="fas ' + (icons[type] || icons.info) + '"></i><span>' + msg + '</span>';
  tc.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(function() {
    el.style.animation = 'toast-out .25s ease forwards';
    setTimeout(function() { el.remove(); }, 260);
  }, 3200);
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

          function pageRange(current, last) {
            const delta = 2;
            const range = [];
            const rangeWithDots = [];
            let l;
            for (let i = 1; i <= last; i++) {
              if (i === 1 || i === last || (i >= current - delta && i <= current + delta)) {
                range.push(i);
              }
            }
            for (const i of range) {
              if (l) {
                if (i - l === 2)      rangeWithDots.push(l + 1);
                else if (i - l > 2)  rangeWithDots.push('...');
              }
              rangeWithDots.push(i);
              l = i;
            }
            return rangeWithDots;
          }
          const pages = pageRange(page, totalPages);
        %>

              <i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i>
            </a>
          <% } else { %>
            <span class="page-btn-nav disabled"><i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i></span>
          <% } %>

          <%# Page numbers %>

              <% if (p === '...') { %>
                <span class="page-dots">···</span>
              <% } else { %>
                <a href="/admin/resellers?page=<%= p %>"
                   class="page-num <%= p === page ? 'active' : '' %>">

                </a>
              <% } %>
            <% }) %>
          </div>

          </div>

        </div>
        <% } %>

      </div>

<script>
function toggleSidebar() {
  var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  var ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var mn = document.getElementById('main');
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    var open = sb.classList.toggle('show');
    ov.classList.toggle('show', open);
  } else {
    var hidden = sb.classList.toggle('hidden');
    mn.style.marginLeft = hidden ? '0' : '248px';
    mn.style.width      = hidden ? '100%' : 'calc(100% - 248px)';
  }
}
function closeSidebar() {
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
  if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
    var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    sb.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
    if (!sb.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      document.getElementById('main').style.marginLeft = '248px';
      document.getElementById('main').style.width = 'calc(100% - 248px)';
    }
  }
});
function openModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop').forEach(function(bd) {
  bd.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === bd) closeModal(bd.id); });
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop.show').forEach(function(bd) { closeModal(bd.id); });
  }
});
</script>
</body>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
const CMD_PARAMS = {
  addsshbot:['username','password','limitip','exp'],
  addvmessbot:['username','password','limitip','exp'],
  addvlessbot:['username','password','limitip','exp'],
  addtrojanbot:['username','password','limitip','exp'],
  renewsshbot:['username','exp'],renewvmessbot:['username','exp'],
  renewvlessbot:['username','exp'],renewtrojanbot:['username','exp'],
  deletesshbot:['username'],deletevmessbot:['username'],
  deletevlessbot:['username'],deletetrojanbot:['username'],
  locksshbot:['username'],unlocksshbot:['username'],
  trialsshbot:[],trialvmessbot:[],trialvlessbot:[],trialtrojanbot:[],
  listsshbot:[],totalmemberbot:[]
};

function openExec(host) {
  document.getElementById('execDomain').value = host;
  updatePayloadFields();
  document.getElementById('execResult').style.display = 'none';
  openModal('modalExec');
}

function updatePayloadFields() {
  var cmd = document.getElementById('execCmd').value;
  var params = CMD_PARAMS[cmd] || [];
  var area = document.getElementById('payloadFields');
  if (!params.length) {
    area.innerHTML = '<div class="col-12"><small style="color:var(--ink-3);font-size:12px;">Tidak ada parameter tambahan.</small></div>';
    return;
  }
  area.innerHTML = params.map(function(p) {
    return '<div class="col-6 col-sm-4">' +
      '<label class="form-lbl">' + p + '</label>' +
      '<input type="' + (p === 'password' ? 'password' : 'text') + '" id="pay_' + p + '" class="form-ctrl" placeholder="' + p + '" autocomplete="off">' +
      '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

async function runExec() {
  var cmd = document.getElementById('execCmd').value;
  var domain = document.getElementById('execDomain').value;
  var params = CMD_PARAMS[cmd] || [];
  var payload = params.map(function(p) {
    var el = document.getElementById('pay_' + p);
    return el ? el.value : '';
  });
  var btn = document.getElementById('btnExec');
  var res = document.getElementById('execResult');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm" style="width:12px;height:12px;border-width:2px;"></span> Eksekusi...';
  res.style.display = 'block';
  res.textContent = 'Mengirim perintah...';
  res.style.color = '#a5f3fc';
  try {
    var r = await fetch('/admin/servers/exec', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ command: cmd, domain: domain, payload: payload })
    });
    var d = await r.json();
    res.textContent = JSON.stringify(d, null, 2);
    res.style.color = d.status === 'success' ? '#34d399' : '#f87171';
  } catch(e) {
    res.textContent = 'Error: ' + e.message;
    res.style.color = '#f87171';
  }
  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-play"></i> Eksekusi';
}

function toggleSidebar() {
  var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  var ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var mn = document.getElementById('main');
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    var open = sb.classList.toggle('show');
    ov.classList.toggle('show', open);
  } else {
    var hidden = sb.classList.toggle('hidden');
    mn.style.marginLeft = hidden ? '0' : '248px';
    mn.style.width      = hidden ? '100%' : 'calc(100% - 248px)';
  }
}
function closeSidebar() {
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
}
function openModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop, .logout-modal-backdrop').forEach(function(bd) {
  bd.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === bd) closeModal(bd.id); });
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop.show, .logout-modal-backdrop.show').forEach(function(bd) { closeModal(bd.id); });
  }
});
window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
  if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
    var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    sb.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
    if (!sb.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      document.getElementById('main').style.marginLeft = '248px';
      document.getElementById('main').style.width = 'calc(100% - 248px)';
    }
  }
});
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updatePayloadFields);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
/* ══ SIDEBAR ══ */
function toggleSidebar() {
  var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  var ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var mn = document.getElementById('main');
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    var open = sb.classList.toggle('show');
    ov.classList.toggle('show', open);
  } else {
    var hidden = sb.classList.toggle('hidden');
    mn.style.marginLeft = hidden ? '0' : '248px';
    mn.style.width      = hidden ? '100%' : 'calc(100% - 248px)';
  }
}
function closeSidebar() {
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
  if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
    var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    sb.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
    if (!sb.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      document.getElementById('main').style.marginLeft = '248px';
      document.getElementById('main').style.width = 'calc(100% - 248px)';
    }
  }
});

/* ══ MODAL ══ */
function openModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop').forEach(function(bd) {
  bd.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === bd) closeModal(bd.id); });
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop.show').forEach(function(bd) { closeModal(bd.id); });
  }
});

/* ══ SUBMIT SETTINGS ══ */
function submitSettings() {
  closeModal('modalSave');
  document.getElementById('settingsForm').submit();
}

/* ══ TOAST ══ */
function showToast(msg, type) {
  type = type || 'info';
  var icons = { success:'fa-circle-check', warn:'fa-triangle-exclamation', error:'fa-circle-xmark', info:'fa-circle-info' };
  var tc = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
  var el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'toast-item t-' + type;
  el.innerHTML = '<i class="fas ' + (icons[type] || icons.info) + '"></i><span>' + msg + '</span>';
  tc.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(function() {
    el.style.animation = 'toast-out .25s ease forwards';
    setTimeout(function() { el.remove(); }, 260);
  }, 3200);
}

/* Auto toast jika pengaturan berhasil disimpan */
<% if (locals.success) { %>
  showToast('Pengaturan berhasil disimpan!', 'success');
<% } %>
</script>
</body>
</html>

          /* ─── Pagination logic ─── */
          function pageRange(current, last) {
            const delta = 2;
            const range = [];
            const rangeWithDots = [];
            let l;
            for (let i = 1; i <= last; i++) {
              if (i === 1 || i === last || (i >= current - delta && i <= current + delta)) {
                range.push(i);
              }
            }
            for (const i of range) {
              if (l) {
                if (i - l === 2)      rangeWithDots.push(l + 1);
                else if (i - l > 2)  rangeWithDots.push('...');
              }
              rangeWithDots.push(i);
              l = i;
            }
            return rangeWithDots;
          }

              <i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
            </a>
          <% } else { %>

          <% } %>

        </div>
        <% } %>

<script>
/* ══ SIDEBAR ══ */
function toggleSidebar() {
  var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  var ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var mn = document.getElementById('main');
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    var open = sb.classList.toggle('show');
    ov.classList.toggle('show', open);
  } else {
    var hidden = sb.classList.toggle('hidden');
    mn.style.marginLeft = hidden ? '0' : '248px';
    mn.style.width      = hidden ? '100%' : 'calc(100% - 248px)';
  }
}
function closeSidebar() {
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
  if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
    var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    sb.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
    if (!sb.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      document.getElementById('main').style.marginLeft = '248px';
      document.getElementById('main').style.width = 'calc(100% - 248px)';
    }
  }
});

/* ══ MODAL ══ */
function openModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop').forEach(function(bd) {
  bd.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === bd) closeModal(bd.id); });
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop.show').forEach(function(bd) { closeModal(bd.id); });
  }
});

/* ══ MODAL: DELETE TOPUP ══ */
function openModalDeleteTopup(id, trxId, username) {
  document.getElementById('modalDeleteTopupDesc').textContent =
    'Riwayat topup ' + trxId + ' milik ' + username + ' akan dihapus secara permanen dan tidak dapat dikembalikan.';
  document.getElementById('modalDeleteTopupConfirm').onclick = function () {
    var form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '/admin/topups/' + id + '/delete';
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
  };
  openModal('modalDeleteTopup');
}

/* ══ TOAST ══ */
function showToast(msg, type) {
  type = type || 'info';
  var icons = { success:'fa-circle-check', warn:'fa-triangle-exclamation', error:'fa-circle-xmark', info:'fa-circle-info' };
  var tc = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
  var el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'toast-item t-' + type;
  el.innerHTML = '<i class="fas ' + (icons[type] || icons.info) + '"></i><span>' + msg + '</span>';
  tc.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(function() {
    el.style.animation = 'toast-out .25s ease forwards';
    setTimeout(function() { el.remove(); }, 260);
  }, 3200);
}
</script>
