<script>
function toggleSidebar() {
  var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  var ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var mn = document.getElementById('main');
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    var open = sb.classList.toggle('show');
    ov.classList.toggle('show', open);
  } else {
    var hidden = sb.classList.toggle('hidden');
    mn.style.marginLeft = hidden ? '0' : '248px';
    mn.style.width = hidden ? '100%' : 'calc(100% - 248px)';
  }
}
function closeSidebar() {
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
  if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
    var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    sb.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
    if (!sb.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      document.getElementById('main').style.marginLeft = '248px';
      document.getElementById('main').style.width = 'calc(100% - 248px)';
    }
  }
});
function openModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop').forEach(function(bd) {
  bd.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === bd) closeModal(bd.id); });
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop.show').forEach(function(bd) { closeModal(bd.id); });
  }
});
function submitForm(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).submit();
}
function triggerSaldo(type) {
  var amount = document.getElementById('saldoAmount').value;
  if (!amount || parseFloat(amount) <= 0) {
    showToast('Masukkan nominal yang valid!', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  var nominal = 'Rp ' + parseInt(amount).toLocaleString('id-ID');
  var isAdd = type === 'tambah';
  document.getElementById('saldoTypeInput').value = type;
  document.getElementById('modalSaldoIcon').className = 'cmodal-icon-wrap ' + (isAdd ? 'success' : 'warn');
  document.getElementById('modalSaldoTitle').textContent = isAdd ? 'Tambah Saldo' : 'Kurangi Saldo';
  document.getElementById('modalSaldoDesc').textContent = (isAdd ? 'Tambahkan ' : 'Kurangi ') + nominal + ' untuk pengguna ini. Lanjutkan?';
  var btn = document.getElementById('modalSaldoConfirm');
  btn.className = isAdd ? 'cmodal-btn-success' : 'cmodal-btn-warning';
  btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check"></i> ' + (isAdd ? 'Ya, Tambah' : 'Ya, Kurangi');
  btn.onclick = function() { document.getElementById('formSaldo').submit(); };
  openModal('modalSaldo');
}
function openModalToggleReseller() {
  var isReseller = <%= u.is_reseller ? 'true' : 'false' %>;
  var uname = '<%= u.username %>';
  document.getElementById('modalResellerTitle').textContent = isReseller ? 'Cabut Status Reseller' : 'Jadikan Reseller';
  document.getElementById('modalResellerDesc').textContent = isReseller
    ? 'Cabut status Reseller dari ' + uname + '? Mereka akan kembali menjadi Member biasa.'
    : 'Jadikan ' + uname + ' sebagai Reseller? Mereka akan mendapat harga diskon dan kuota trial lebih banyak.';
  openModal('modalToggleReseller');
}
function openModalToggleAdmin() {
  var isAdmin = <%= u.is_admin ? 'true' : 'false' %>;
  var uname = '<%= u.username %>';
  document.getElementById('modalAdminTitle').textContent = isAdmin ? 'Cabut Hak Admin' : 'Jadikan Admin';
  document.getElementById('modalAdminDesc').textContent = isAdmin
    ? 'Cabut hak admin dari pengguna ' + uname + '? Mereka tidak akan bisa mengakses panel admin.'
    : 'Jadikan ' + uname + ' sebagai admin? Mereka akan mendapat akses penuh ke panel admin.';
  openModal('modalToggleAdmin');
}
function openModalDeleteMut(mutId) {
  document.getElementById('modalDeleteMutConfirm').onclick = function() {
    var form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '/admin/users/<%= u.id %>/mutations/' + mutId + '/delete';
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
  };
  openModal('modalDeleteMut');
}
function openModalDeleteTrial(trialId) {
  document.getElementById('modalDeleteTrialConfirm').onclick = function() {
    var form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '/admin/users/<%= u.id %>/trials/' + trialId + '/delete';
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
  };
  openModal('modalDeleteTrial');
}
function showToast(msg, type) {
  type = type || 'info';
  var icons = { success:'fa-circle-check', warn:'fa-triangle-exclamation', error:'fa-circle-xmark', info:'fa-circle-info' };
  var tc = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
  var el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'toast-item t-' + type;
  el.innerHTML = '<i class="fas ' + (icons[type] || icons.info) + '"></i><span>' + msg + '</span>';
  tc.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(function() {
    el.style.animation = 'toast-out .25s ease forwards';
    setTimeout(function() { el.remove(); }, 260);
  }, 3200);
}

<% } else if (locals.query && locals.query.downgrade_result === 'no') { %>
  showToast('User tetap Reseller. Omzet sudah cukup.', 'success');
<% } %>
<% if (locals.query && locals.query.saldo_ok) { %>

<% } else if (locals.query && locals.query.saldo_err) { %>
  showToast('Gagal mengubah saldo pengguna', 'error');
<% } %>

          /* ─── Pagination logic ─── */
          function pageRange(current, last) {
            const delta = 2;
            const range = [];
            const rangeWithDots = [];
            let l;
            for (let i = 1; i <= last; i++) {
              if (i === 1 || i === last || (i >= current - delta && i <= current + delta)) {
                range.push(i);
              }
            }
            for (const i of range) {
              if (l) {
                if (i - l === 2)      rangeWithDots.push(l + 1);
                else if (i - l > 2)  rangeWithDots.push('...');
              }
              rangeWithDots.push(i);
              l = i;
            }
            return rangeWithDots;
          }
          const pages = pageRange(page, totalPages);

          /* Susun query string agar filter tetap aktif saat ganti halaman */
          const qBase = (q ? `q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&` : '') +
                        (filterReseller ? 'reseller=1&' : '');

          <% if (page > 1) { %>
            <a href="/admin/users?<%= qBase %>page=<%= page - 1 %>" class="page-btn-nav" title="Halaman sebelumnya">
              <i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i>
            </a>
          <% } else { %>
            <span class="page-btn-nav disabled"><i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i></span>
          <% } %>

          <%# Nomor halaman %>
          <div class="page-numbers">
            <% pages.forEach(function(p) { %>
              <% if (p === '...') { %>
                <span class="page-dots">···</span>
              <% } else { %>
                <a href="/admin/users?<%= qBase %>page=<%= p %>"
                   class="page-num <%= p === page ? 'active' : '' %>">
                  <%= p %>
                </a>
              <% } %>
            <% }) %>
          </div>

          <%# Next %>
          <% if (page < totalPages) { %>
            <a href="/admin/users?<%= qBase %>page=<%= page + 1 %>" class="page-btn-nav" title="Halaman berikutnya">
              <i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
            </a>
          <% } else { %>
            <span class="page-btn-nav disabled"><i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i></span>
          <% } %>

          <div class="page-info-text">
            Menampilkan <%= (page - 1) * limit + 1 %>–<%= Math.min(page * limit, total) %> dari <%= total %> pengguna
          </div>

        </div>
        <% } %>

<script>
/* ══ SIDEBAR ══ */
function toggleSidebar() {
  var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  var ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var mn = document.getElementById('main');
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    var open = sb.classList.toggle('show');
    ov.classList.toggle('show', open);
  } else {
    var hidden = sb.classList.toggle('hidden');
    mn.style.marginLeft = hidden ? '0' : '248px';
    mn.style.width      = hidden ? '100%' : 'calc(100% - 248px)';
  }
}
function closeSidebar() {
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
  if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
    var sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    sb.classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show');
    if (!sb.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      document.getElementById('main').style.marginLeft = '248px';
      document.getElementById('main').style.width = 'calc(100% - 248px)';
    }
  }
});

/* ══ MODAL ══ */
function openModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeModal(id) {
  document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop').forEach(function(bd) {
  bd.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === bd) closeModal(bd.id); });
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    document.querySelectorAll('.cmodal-backdrop.show').forEach(function(bd) { closeModal(bd.id); });
  }
});

/* ══ TOAST ══ */
function showToast(msg, type) {
  type = type || 'info';
  var icons = { success:'fa-circle-check', warn:'fa-triangle-exclamation', error:'fa-circle-xmark', info:'fa-circle-info' };
  var tc = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
  var el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'toast-item t-' + type;
  el.innerHTML = '<i class="fas ' + (icons[type] || icons.info) + '"></i><span>' + msg + '</span>';
  tc.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(function() {
    el.style.animation = 'toast-out .25s ease forwards';
    setTimeout(function() { el.remove(); }, 260);
  }, 3200);
}
</script>

        const pwInput = document.getElementById('loginPassword');
        const pwIcon = document.getElementById('pwToggleIcon');
        pwToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const isPassword = pwInput.type === 'password';
            pwInput.type = isPassword ? 'text' : 'password';
            pwIcon.className = isPassword ? 'fas fa-eye-slash' : 'fas fa-eye';
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        document.getElementById('regPassword').addEventListener('input', function () {
            const val = this.value;
            const fill = document.getElementById('pwStrengthFill');
            const text = document.getElementById('pwStrengthText');
            if (!val) { fill.style.width = '0'; text.textContent = ''; return; }
            let score = 0;
            if (val.length >= 6) score++;
            if (val.length >= 10) score++;
            if (/[A-Z]/.test(val) && /[a-z]/.test(val)) score++;
            if (/\d/.test(val)) score++;
            if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(val)) score++;
            const levels = [
                { pct: '20%', color: '#ef4444', label: 'Sangat lemah' },
                { pct: '40%', color: '#f59e0b', label: 'Lemah' },
                { pct: '60%', color: '#f59e0b', label: 'Cukup' },
                { pct: '80%', color: '#0ea5e9', label: 'Kuat' },
                { pct: '100%', color: '#10b981', label: 'Sangat kuat' },
            ];
            const lvl = levels[Math.min(score - 1, 4)] || levels[0];
            fill.style.width = lvl.pct;
            fill.style.background = lvl.color;
            text.textContent = lvl.label;
            text.style.color = lvl.color;
        });

        document.getElementById('regForm').addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            const user = document.getElementById('regUsername').value;
            const pass = document.getElementById('regPassword').value;
            const conf = document.getElementById('regConfirm').value;
            const errBox = document.getElementById('regErr');
            const errText = document.getElementById('regErrText');
            const btn = document.getElementById('regBtn');
            errBox.style.display = 'none';
            if (/\s/.test(user)) {
                e.preventDefault();
                errText.textContent = 'Username tidak boleh mengandung spasi.';
                errBox.style.display = 'flex';
                return;
            }
            if (pass !== conf) {
                e.preventDefault();
                errText.textContent = 'Konfirmasi password tidak cocok.';
                errBox.style.display = 'flex';
                return;
            }
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin" style="margin-right: 8px;"></i> Memproses...';
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        /* Visibility Toggle Function */
        function setupToggle(btnId, iconId, inputId) {
            const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            const icon = document.getElementById(iconId);
            if (!btn) return;

            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const isPw = input.type === 'password';
                input.type = isPw ? 'text' : 'password';
                icon.className = isPw ? 'fas fa-eye-slash' : 'fas fa-eye';
            });
        }

        setupToggle('toggle1', 'icon1', 'resetPassword');
        setupToggle('toggle2', 'icon2', 'resetConfirm');

        /* Password Strength */
        const pwInput = document.getElementById('resetPassword');
        if (pwInput) {
            pwInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                const val = this.value;
                const fill = document.getElementById('pwFill');
                const text = document.getElementById('pwText');
                
                if (!val) { 
                    fill.style.width = '0'; 
                    text.textContent = ''; 
                    return; 
                }

                let score = 0;
                if (val.length >= 6) score++;
                if (val.length >= 10) score++;
                if (/[A-Z]/.test(val) && /[a-z]/.test(val)) score++;
                if (/\d/.test(val)) score++;
                if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(val)) score++;

                const levels = [
                    { pct: '20%', color: '#ef4444', label: 'Sangat lemah' },
                    { pct: '40%', color: '#f59e0b', label: 'Lemah' },
                    { pct: '60%', color: '#f59e0b', label: 'Cukup' },
                    { pct: '80%', color: '#0ea5e9', label: 'Kuat' },
                    { pct: '100%', color: '#10b981', label: 'Sangat kuat' },
                ];
                
                const lvl = levels[Math.min(score - 1, 4)] || levels;
                fill.style.width = lvl.pct;
                fill.style.background = lvl.color;
                text.textContent = lvl.label;
                text.style.color = lvl.color;
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

                    Kirim ulang tersedia dalam <span id="countdownNum">60</span>s

    <script>
        const otpInput = document.getElementById('otpInput');
        const otpForm = document.getElementById('otpForm');
        const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');

        otpInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
            this.value = this.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6);
            const val = this.value;
            for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                const box = document.getElementById('b' + i);
                if (i < val.length) {
                    box.textContent = val[i];
                    box.classList.add('active');
                } else {
                    box.textContent = '';
                    box.classList.remove('active');
                }
            }
        });

        otpForm.addEventListener('submit', function () {
            submitBtn.disabled = true;
            submitBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Memverifikasi...';
        });

        let resendCooldown = false;
        async function resendOTP() {
            if (resendCooldown) return;

            const btn = document.getElementById('resendBtn');
            const msg = document.getElementById('resendMsg');
            const cdText = document.getElementById('countdownText');
            const cdNum = document.getElementById('countdownNum');

            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i>';

            try {
                const r = await fetch('/auth/resend-otp', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
                });
                const d = await r.json();

                msg.style.display = 'flex';
                msg.className = 'auth-alert ' + (d.ok ? 'alert-success' : 'alert-error');
                msg.innerHTML = `<i class="fas fa-${d.ok ? 'check-circle' : 'circle-exclamation'}"></i><span>${d.message}</span>`;

                if (d.ok) {
                    resendCooldown = true;
                    btn.style.display = 'none';
                    cdText.style.display = 'block';
                    let secs = 60;
                    const timer = setInterval(() => {
                        secs--;
                        cdNum.textContent = secs;
                        if (secs <= 0) {
                            clearInterval(timer);
                            resendCooldown = false;
                            btn.disabled = false;
                            btn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
                            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-redo-alt"></i> Kirim Ulang Kode';
                            cdText.style.display = 'none';
                        }
                    }, 1000);
                } else {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-redo-alt"></i> Kirim Ulang Kode';
                }
            } catch (err) {
                msg.style.display = 'flex';
                msg.className = 'auth-alert alert-error';
                msg.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-circle-exclamation"></i><span>Gagal mengirim. Coba lagi.</span>';
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-redo-alt"></i> Kirim Ulang Kode';
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

  <!-- ══════ THEME ══════ -->
  <script>
    const themeBtn = document.getElementById('themeBtn');
    const themeIcon = document.getElementById('themeIcon');
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const applyTheme = t => {
      html.setAttribute('data-theme', t);
      localStorage.setItem('theme', t);
      themeIcon.className = t === 'dark' ? 'fa-solid fa-sun' : 'fa-solid fa-moon';
    };
    applyTheme(localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light');
    themeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      applyTheme(html.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
    });

    /* ── FORMAT HELPERS ── */
    const fmtNumber = n => {
      if (n >= 1_000_000) return (n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Jt';
      if (n >= 1_000) return (n / 1_000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Rb';
      return n.toLocaleString('id-ID');
    };
    const fmtRupiah = n => 'Rp' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString('id-ID');
    const timeAgo = ts => {
      const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - ts) / 1000);
      if (s < 60) return s + 's lalu';
      if (s < 3600) return Math.floor(s / 60) + 'm lalu';
      if (s < 86400) return Math.floor(s / 3600) + 'j lalu';
      return Math.floor(s / 86400) + 'h lalu';
    };

    /* ── VPN META ── */
    const vpnMeta = {
      topup: { cls: 'type-topup', fa: 'fas fa-wallet', label: 'Topup Saldo' },
      ssh: { cls: 'type-ssh', fa: 'fas fa-terminal', label: 'SSH WS' },
      vmess: { cls: 'type-vmess', fa: 'fas fa-network-wired', label: 'VMESS' },
      vless: { cls: 'type-vless', fa: 'fas fa-globe', label: 'VLESS' },
      trojan: { cls: 'type-trojan', fa: 'fas fa-shield-alt', label: 'TROJAN WS' },
    };
    function getMeta(item) {
      if (item.type === 'topup') return vpnMeta.topup;
      const t = (item.vpn_type || '').toLowerCase();
      return vpnMeta[t] || { cls: 'type-other', fa: 'fa-solid fa-network-wired', label: (item.vpn_type || 'VPN').toUpperCase() };
    }

    /* ── ANIMATE STAT ── */
    function animateStat(el, v) {
      el.classList.add('fade');
      setTimeout(() => { el.textContent = v; el.classList.remove('fade'); }, 200);
    }

    /* ── STATS ── */
    async function loadStats() {
      try {
        const r = await fetch('/api/public-stats');
        if (!r.ok) return;
        const d = await r.json();
        const map = [
          ['stat-users', fmtNumber(d.total_users)],
          ['stat-reseller', fmtNumber(d.total_reseller)],
          ['stat-orders', fmtNumber(d.total_orders)],
          ['stat-transactions', fmtRupiah(d.total_transactions)],
          ['stat-active', fmtNumber(d.vpn_active)],
          ['tv-users', fmtNumber(d.total_users)],
          ['tv-orders', fmtNumber(d.total_orders)],
          ['tv-active', fmtNumber(d.vpn_active)],
        ];
        map.forEach(([id, val]) => {
          const el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el) animateStat(el, val);
        });
      } catch (e) { console.warn('Stats error', e); }
    }

    /* ── FEED ── */
    let lastHash = '';
    async function loadFeed() {
      try {
        const r = await fetch('/api/public-feed');
        if (!r.ok) return;
        const items = await r.json();
        const hash = JSON.stringify(items.map(i => i.id + i.type));
        if (hash === lastHash) return;
        lastHash = hash;

        const list = document.getElementById('feedList');
        list.innerHTML = '';

        if (!items.length) {
          list.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center;padding:48px 24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-family:var(--mono)">
        <i class="fa-regular fa-clock" style="font-size:24px;display:block;margin-bottom:10px;opacity:.3"></i>
        Belum ada aktivitas.
      </div>`;
          return;
        }

        items.forEach((item, idx) => {
          const meta = getMeta(item);
          const isTopup = item.type === 'topup';
          const label = isTopup ? 'Topup Saldo' : ('Order ' + meta.label);
          const pill = isTopup ? 'TOPUP' : (item.vpn_type || 'VPN').toUpperCase();

          const div = document.createElement('div');
          div.className = 'feed-item ' + meta.cls;
          div.style.animationDelay = (idx * 0.055) + 's';

          div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="feed-icon"><i class="${meta.fa}"></i></div>
        <div class="feed-body">
          <div class="feed-lbl">${label}</div>
          <div class="feed-meta">
            <span class="feed-pill">${pill}</span>
            <span class="feed-time"><i class="fa-regular fa-clock"></i>${timeAgo(item.time)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="feed-right">
          <span class="feed-amount">${fmtRupiah(item.amount)}</span>
          <div class="feed-user"><i class="fa-regular fa-user" style="font-size:9px"></i><span>${item.username || 'Pengguna'}</span></div>
        </div>`;
          list.appendChild(div);
        });
      } catch (e) { console.warn('Feed error', e); }
    }

    loadStats();
    loadFeed();
    setInterval(loadStats, 30_000);
    setInterval(loadFeed, 15_000);

    /* ── TAB & PAGINATION ── */
    function togglePriceMode(mode, btn) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.price-toggle .toggle-btn').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active'); b.style.background = 'transparent'; b.style.color = 'var(--txt-2)';
      });
      btn.classList.add('active'); btn.style.background = 'var(--teal)'; btn.style.color = '#fff';
      document.querySelectorAll('.pkg-card').forEach(card => {
        const pm = card.querySelector('.pkg-price'), ps = card.querySelector('.pkg-price-sub');
        if (pm && ps) {
          pm.innerHTML = (mode === 'member' ? pm.getAttribute('data-member-day') : pm.getAttribute('data-reseller-day')) + '<span>/Hari</span>';
          ps.innerHTML = '30 Hari = ' + (mode === 'member' ? ps.getAttribute('data-member-month') : ps.getAttribute('data-reseller-month'));
        }
      });
    }

    function switchTabLanding(type, el) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.pkg-tab').forEach(t => {
        t.style.display = 'none';
        t.classList.remove('pkg-reveal');
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('#typeTabsLanding button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      const activeTab = document.getElementById('tab-' + type);
      activeTab.style.display = 'block';
      activeTab.classList.add('pkg-reveal');
      el.classList.add('active');
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 5;
      document.querySelectorAll('.pkg-tab').forEach(tab => {
        const tabId = tab.id;
        const grid = tab.querySelector('.pkg-grid');
        if (!grid) return;
        const items = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.pkg-card'));
        if (items.length === 0) return;

        const totalPages = Math.ceil(items.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
        let currentPage = 1;

        // Set stable height if multiple pages exist to prevent layout shift
        if (totalPages > 1) {
          grid.style.minHeight = '740px'; 
        }

        const pagContainer = document.createElement('div');
        pagContainer.className = 'pagination-wrap';
        pagContainer.style.display = totalPages > 1 ? 'flex' : 'none';

        function renderPage(scroll = false) {
          if (scroll) {
            const gridRect = grid.getBoundingClientRect();
            const gridTop = gridRect.top + window.pageYOffset;
            const offset = 88; // Improved offset for topbar + spacing
            window.scrollTo({ top: gridTop - offset, behavior: 'smooth' });
          }
          items.forEach((item, index) => {
            item.classList.remove('pkg-reveal'); // Reset animation
            if (index >= (currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE && index < currentPage * ITEMS_PER_PAGE) {
              item.style.display = '';
              // Trigger reflow to restart animation correctly
              void item.offsetWidth; 
              item.classList.add('pkg-reveal');
              // Staggered delay
              item.style.animationDelay = ((index % ITEMS_PER_PAGE) * 0.05) + 's';
            } else {
              item.style.display = 'none';
            }
          });

          pagContainer.innerHTML = '';
          if (totalPages <= 1) return;

          const prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
          prevBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left"></i>';
          prevBtn.className = 'btn-pag';
          prevBtn.disabled = currentPage === 1;
          prevBtn.onclick = function () { if (currentPage > 1) { currentPage--; renderPage(true); } };
          pagContainer.appendChild(prevBtn);

          for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
            if (totalPages > 5 && i !== 1 && i !== totalPages && Math.abs(i - currentPage) > 1) {
              if (pagContainer.lastChild && pagContainer.lastChild.textContent !== '...') {
                const dots = document.createElement('span');
                dots.textContent = '...';
                dots.style.alignSelf = 'flex-end';
                dots.style.margin = '0 4px';
                dots.style.color = 'var(--muted)';
                dots.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                pagContainer.appendChild(dots);
              }
              continue;
            }
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.textContent = i;
            btn.className = 'btn-pag ' + (i === currentPage ? 'active' : '');
            btn.onclick = function () { currentPage = i; renderPage(true); };
            pagContainer.appendChild(btn);
          }

          const nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
          nextBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i>';
          nextBtn.className = 'btn-pag';
          nextBtn.disabled = currentPage === totalPages;
          nextBtn.onclick = function () { if (currentPage < totalPages) { currentPage++; renderPage(true); } };
          pagContainer.appendChild(nextBtn);
        }

        grid.after(pagContainer);
        renderPage();
      });
    });

    // Mobile Hamburger Menu
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
      const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
      if(!hamburger || !menu) return;
      
      hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
        const icon = this.querySelector('i');
        const tb = document.getElementById('topbar');
        if(menu.classList.contains('open')) {
          menu.classList.remove('open');
          icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-bars';
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
          if(tb) tb.classList.remove('menu-open');
        } else {
          menu.classList.add('open');
          icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-xmark';
          document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; // Stop page scrolling
          if(tb) tb.classList.add('menu-open');
        }
      });

      // Close menu when clicking a link
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', () => {
          menu.classList.remove('open');
          hamburger.querySelector('i').className = 'fa-solid fa-bars';
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
          const tb = document.getElementById('topbar');
          if(tb) tb.classList.remove('menu-open');
        });
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>

</html>

  <script>
    /* ── TOPBAR SCROLL ── */
    const topbar = document.getElementById('topbar');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      topbar.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 6);
    }, { passive: true });

    /* ── LIVE CHAT LOGIC ── */
    window.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function() {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
            const iframe = document.getElementById('riva-main-iframe');
            if (iframe) iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({ action: 'check_unreads' }, '*');
        }
    });

    let audioBlocked = false; // Mencegah audio yang bertubi-tubi / double trigger

    window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
        if (event.data.action === 'show_notif') {
            const panel = document.getElementById('riva-chat-panel');
            const dotNotif = document.getElementById('dot-notif');

            if (!panel.classList.contains('show')) {
                document.getElementById('chat-popup').style.display = 'block';
                document.getElementById('popup-text').innerText = event.data.msg;

                if (dotNotif) dotNotif.style.display = 'block';

                if (!audioBlocked) {
                    new Audio('https://assets.mixkit.co/active_storage/sfx/2358/2358-preview.mp3').play().catch(() => {});
                    audioBlocked = true;
                    setTimeout(() => audioBlocked = false, 2000); // Cooldown 2 detik agar tidak double
                }
            }
        }
    }, false);

    function handleRivaChat(open) {
        const panel = document.getElementById('riva-chat-panel');
        const overlay = document.getElementById('riva-chat-overlay');
        const dotNotif = document.getElementById('dot-notif');
        const popup = document.getElementById('chat-popup');
        const iframe = document.getElementById('riva-main-iframe');

        if (open) {
            panel.classList.add('show');
            overlay.classList.add('show');
            if (popup) popup.style.display = 'none';

            if (dotNotif) dotNotif.style.display = 'none';
            if (iframe) iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({ action: 'set_visibility', visible: true }, '*');

            if (window.innerWidth <= 640) document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        } else {
            panel.classList.remove('show');
            overlay.classList.remove('show');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            
            // Red dot tetap hilang ketika ditutup secara wajar
            if (dotNotif) dotNotif.style.display = 'none';
            if (popup) popup.style.display = 'none'; // Biar gak double popup ketika close
            if (iframe) iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({ action: 'set_visibility', visible: false }, '*');
        }
    }

    /* ── THEME ── */
    const themeBtn = document.getElementById('themeBtn');
    const themeIcon = document.getElementById('themeIcon');
    const html = document.documentElement;
    const applyTheme = t => {
      html.setAttribute('data-theme', t);
      localStorage.setItem('theme', t);
      themeIcon.className = t === 'dark' ? 'fa-solid fa-sun' : 'fa-solid fa-moon';
    };
    applyTheme(localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light');
    themeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      applyTheme(html.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
    });

    /* ── FORMAT HELPERS ── */
    const fmtNumber = n => {
      if (n >= 1_000_000) return (n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Jt';
      if (n >= 1_000) return (n / 1_000).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' Rb';
      return n.toLocaleString('id-ID');
    };
    const fmtRupiah = n => 'Rp' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString('id-ID');
    const timeAgo = ts => {
      const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - ts) / 1000);
      if (s < 60) return s + 's lalu';
      if (s < 3600) return Math.floor(s / 60) + 'm lalu';
      if (s < 86400) return Math.floor(s / 3600) + 'j lalu';
      return Math.floor(s / 86400) + 'h lalu';
    };

    /* ── VPN META ── */
    const vpnMeta = {
      topup: { cls: 'type-topup', fa: 'fas fa-wallet', label: 'Topup Saldo' },
      ssh: { cls: 'type-ssh', fa: 'fas fa-terminal', label: 'SSH WS' },
      vmess: { cls: 'type-vmess', fa: 'fas fa-network-wired', label: 'VMESS' },
      vless: { cls: 'type-vless', fa: 'fas fa-globe', label: 'VLESS' },
      trojan: { cls: 'type-trojan', fa: 'fas fa-shield-alt', label: 'TROJAN WS' },
    };
    function getMeta(item) {
      if (item.type === 'topup') return vpnMeta.topup;
      const t = (item.vpn_type || '').toLowerCase();
      return vpnMeta[t] || { cls: 'type-other', fa: 'fa-solid fa-network-wired', label: (item.vpn_type || 'VPN').toUpperCase() };
    }

    /* ── ANIMATE STAT ── */
    function animateStat(el, v) {
      el.classList.add('fade');
      setTimeout(() => { el.textContent = v; el.classList.remove('fade'); }, 200);
    }

    /* ── STATS ── */
    async function loadStats() {
      try {
        const r = await fetch('/api/public-stats');
        if (!r.ok) return;
        const d = await r.json();
        const map = [
          ['stat-users', fmtNumber(d.total_users)],
          ['stat-reseller', fmtNumber(d.total_reseller)],
          ['stat-orders', fmtNumber(d.total_orders)],
          ['stat-transactions', fmtRupiah(d.total_transactions)],
          ['stat-active', fmtNumber(d.vpn_active)],
          ['tv-users', fmtNumber(d.total_users)],
          ['tv-orders', fmtNumber(d.total_orders)],
          ['tv-active', fmtNumber(d.vpn_active)],
        ];
        map.forEach(([id, val]) => {
          const el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el) animateStat(el, val);
        });
      } catch (e) { console.warn('Stats error', e); }
    }

    /* ── FEED ── */
    let lastHash = '';
    async function loadFeed() {
      try {
        const r = await fetch('/api/public-feed');
        if (!r.ok) return;
        const items = await r.json();
        const hash = JSON.stringify(items.map(i => i.id + i.type));
        if (hash === lastHash) return;
        lastHash = hash;

        const list = document.getElementById('feedList');
        list.innerHTML = '';

        if (!items.length) {
          list.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center;padding:48px 24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-family:var(--mono)">
        <i class="fa-regular fa-clock" style="font-size:24px;display:block;margin-bottom:10px;opacity:.3"></i>
        Belum ada aktivitas.
      </div>`;
          return;
        }

        items.forEach((item, idx) => {
          const meta = getMeta(item);
          const isTopup = item.type === 'topup';
          const label = isTopup ? 'Topup Saldo' : ('Order ' + meta.label);
          const pill = isTopup ? 'TOPUP' : (item.vpn_type || 'VPN').toUpperCase();

          const div = document.createElement('div');
          div.className = 'feed-item ' + meta.cls;
          div.style.animationDelay = (idx * 0.055) + 's';

          div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="feed-icon"><i class="${meta.fa}"></i></div>
        <div class="feed-body">
          <div class="feed-lbl">${label}</div>
          <div class="feed-meta">
            <span class="feed-pill">${pill}</span>
            <span class="feed-time"><i class="fa-regular fa-clock"></i>${timeAgo(item.time)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="feed-right">
          <span class="feed-amount">${fmtRupiah(item.amount)}</span>
          <div class="feed-user"><i class="fa-regular fa-user" style="font-size:9px"></i><span>${item.username || 'Pengguna'}</span></div>
        </div>`;
          list.appendChild(div);
        });
      } catch (e) { console.warn('Feed error', e); }
    }

    loadStats();
    loadFeed();
    setInterval(loadStats, 30_000);
    setInterval(loadFeed, 15_000);

    /* ── TAB & PAGINATION ── */
    function togglePriceMode(mode, btn) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.price-toggle .toggle-btn').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active'); b.style.background = 'transparent'; b.style.color = 'var(--txt-2)';
      });
      btn.classList.add('active'); btn.style.background = 'var(--teal)'; btn.style.color = '#fff';
      document.querySelectorAll('.pkg-card').forEach(card => {
        const pm = card.querySelector('.pkg-price'), ps = card.querySelector('.pkg-price-sub');
        if (pm && ps) {
          pm.innerHTML = (mode === 'member' ? pm.getAttribute('data-member-day') : pm.getAttribute('data-reseller-day')) + '<span>/Hari</span>';
          ps.innerHTML = '30 Hari = ' + (mode === 'member' ? ps.getAttribute('data-member-month') : ps.getAttribute('data-reseller-month'));
        }
      });
    }

    function switchTabLanding(type, el) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.pkg-tab').forEach(t => {
        t.style.display = 'none';
        t.classList.remove('pkg-reveal');
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('#typeTabsLanding button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      const activeTab = document.getElementById('tab-' + type);
      activeTab.style.display = 'block';
      activeTab.classList.add('pkg-reveal');
      el.classList.add('active');
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 5;
      document.querySelectorAll('.pkg-tab').forEach(tab => {
        const tabId = tab.id;
        const grid = tab.querySelector('.pkg-grid');
        if (!grid) return;
        const items = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.pkg-card'));
        if (items.length === 0) return;

        const totalPages = Math.ceil(items.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
        let currentPage = 1;

        // Set stable height if multiple pages exist to prevent layout shift
        if (totalPages > 1) {
          grid.style.minHeight = '740px'; 
        }

        const pagContainer = document.createElement('div');
        pagContainer.className = 'pagination-wrap';
        pagContainer.style.display = totalPages > 1 ? 'flex' : 'none';

        function renderPage(scroll = false) {
          if (scroll) {
            const gridRect = grid.getBoundingClientRect();
            const gridTop = gridRect.top + window.pageYOffset;
            const offset = 88; // Improved offset for topbar + spacing
            window.scrollTo({ top: gridTop - offset, behavior: 'smooth' });
          }
          items.forEach((item, index) => {
            item.classList.remove('pkg-reveal'); // Reset animation
            if (index >= (currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE && index < currentPage * ITEMS_PER_PAGE) {
              item.style.display = '';
              // Trigger reflow to restart animation correctly
              void item.offsetWidth; 
              item.classList.add('pkg-reveal');
              // Staggered delay
              item.style.animationDelay = ((index % ITEMS_PER_PAGE) * 0.05) + 's';
            } else {
              item.style.display = 'none';
            }
          });

          pagContainer.innerHTML = '';
          if (totalPages <= 1) return;

          const prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
          prevBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left"></i>';
          prevBtn.className = 'btn-pag';
          prevBtn.disabled = currentPage === 1;
          prevBtn.onclick = function () { if (currentPage > 1) { currentPage--; renderPage(true); } };
          pagContainer.appendChild(prevBtn);

          for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
            if (totalPages > 5 && i !== 1 && i !== totalPages && Math.abs(i - currentPage) > 1) {
              if (pagContainer.lastChild && pagContainer.lastChild.textContent !== '...') {
                const dots = document.createElement('span');
                dots.textContent = '...';
                dots.style.alignSelf = 'flex-end';
                dots.style.margin = '0 4px';
                dots.style.color = 'var(--muted)';
                dots.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                pagContainer.appendChild(dots);
              }
              continue;
            }
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.textContent = i;
            btn.className = 'btn-pag ' + (i === currentPage ? 'active' : '');
            btn.onclick = function () { currentPage = i; renderPage(true); };
            pagContainer.appendChild(btn);
          }

          const nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
          nextBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i>';
          nextBtn.className = 'btn-pag';
          nextBtn.disabled = currentPage === totalPages;
          nextBtn.onclick = function () { if (currentPage < totalPages) { currentPage++; renderPage(true); } };
          pagContainer.appendChild(nextBtn);
        }

        grid.after(pagContainer);
        renderPage();
      });
    });

    // Mobile Hamburger Menu
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
      const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
      if(!hamburger || !menu) return;
      
      hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
        const icon = this.querySelector('i');
        const tb = document.getElementById('topbar');
        if(menu.classList.contains('open')) {
          menu.classList.remove('open');
          icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-bars';
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
          if(tb) tb.classList.remove('menu-open');
        } else {
          menu.classList.add('open');
          icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-xmark';
          document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; // Stop page scrolling
          if(tb) tb.classList.add('menu-open');
        }
      });

      // Close menu when clicking a link
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', () => {
          menu.classList.remove('open');
          hamburger.querySelector('i').className = 'fa-solid fa-bars';
          document.body.style.overflow = '';
          const tb = document.getElementById('topbar');
          if(tb) tb.classList.remove('menu-open');
        });
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>

</html>

<script>
function switchTab(type, el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.pkg-tab').forEach(t => t.style.display = 'none');
  document.querySelectorAll('#typeTabs button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('tab-' + type).style.display = 'block';
  el.classList.add('active');
}
function showLogout()  { document.getElementById('logoutModal').classList.add('show'); }
function closeLogout() { document.getElementById('logoutModal').classList.remove('show'); }
document.getElementById('logoutModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeLogout();
});
</script>
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 5;
  document.querySelectorAll('.pkg-tab').forEach(tab => {
    const tabId = tab.id;
    const grid = tab.querySelector('.pkg-grid');
    if (!grid) return;
    const items = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.pkg-card')).concat(
      Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.pkg-card-full'))
    );
    // filter to exact cards so no duplicates if nested
    const cardItems = Array.from(grid.children).filter(child => child.classList.contains('pkg-card') || child.classList.contains('pkg-card-full') || child.tagName === 'A' || child.tagName === 'DIV');
    if (cardItems.length === 0) return;
    
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(cardItems.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
    let savedPage = localStorage.getItem('currentPage_' + tabId);
    let currentPage = savedPage ? parseInt(savedPage) : 1;
    if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;
    if (currentPage < 1) currentPage = 1;

    const pagContainer = document.createElement('div');
    pagContainer.className = 'pagination-wrap';
    pagContainer.style.display = totalPages > 1 ? 'flex' : 'none';
    pagContainer.style.justifyContent = 'center';
    pagContainer.style.gap = '8px';
    pagContainer.style.marginTop = '16px';
    
    function renderPage() {
      localStorage.setItem('currentPage_' + tabId, currentPage);
      cardItems.forEach((item, index) => {
        if (index >= (currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE && index < currentPage * ITEMS_PER_PAGE) {
          item.style.display = ''; // default flex
        } else {
          item.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
      
      pagContainer.innerHTML = '';
      const prevBtn = document.createElement('button');
      prevBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i>';
      prevBtn.className = 'btn-pag';
      prevBtn.disabled = currentPage === 1;
      prevBtn.onclick = function() { if (currentPage > 1) { currentPage--; renderPage(); } };
      pagContainer.appendChild(prevBtn);
      
      for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
        if (totalPages > 5 && i !== 1 && i !== totalPages && Math.abs(i - currentPage) > 1) {
          if (pagContainer.lastChild.textContent !== '...') {
            const dots = document.createElement('span');
            dots.textContent = '...';
            dots.style.alignSelf = 'flex-end';
            dots.style.margin = '0 4px';
            dots.style.color = '#64748b';
            dots.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
            pagContainer.appendChild(dots);
          }
          continue;
        }
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.textContent = i;
        btn.className = 'btn-pag ' + (i === currentPage ? 'active' : '');
        btn.onclick = function() { currentPage = i; renderPage(); };
        pagContainer.appendChild(btn);
      }
      
      const nextBtn = document.createElement('button');
      nextBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>';
      nextBtn.className = 'btn-pag';
      nextBtn.disabled = currentPage === totalPages;
      nextBtn.onclick = function() { if (currentPage < totalPages) { currentPage++; renderPage(); } };
      pagContainer.appendChild(nextBtn);
    }
    
    tab.appendChild(pagContainer);
    renderPage();
  });
});
</script>

function setAmount(val) {

<% if (pending) { %>
const tid         = document.getElementById('pendingTrxId').value;
let secondsLeft   = parseInt(document.getElementById('remainingSeconds').value);
const countdownEl = document.getElementById('countdown');

function formatTime(s) {
  const m   = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const sec = s % 60;
  return m + ':' + String(sec).padStart(2, '0');
}

function showExpired(data) {
  document.getElementById('qrisContainer').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('expiredContainer').style.display = 'block';
  if (data) {
    document.getElementById('expiredTrxInfo').innerHTML =
      '<div class="pay-row"><div class="pay-lbl">ID TRX</div><div class="pay-val font-monospace" style="font-size:12px;">' + (data.trx_id || tid) + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class="pay-row"><div class="pay-lbl">Status</div><div class="pay-val"><span class="status-badge batal">GAGAL (EXPIRED)</span></div></div>' +
      '<div class="pay-row" style="border-bottom:none;"><div class="pay-lbl">Top Up</div><div class="pay-val" style="color:#dc2626;font-weight:800;">Rp ' + parseInt(data.amount || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID') + '</div></div>';
  }
}

const timer = setInterval(() => {
  secondsLeft--;
  if (secondsLeft <= 0) {
    clearInterval(timer);
    countdownEl.textContent = 'Expired';
    showExpired(null);
    return;
  }
  countdownEl.textContent = formatTime(secondsLeft);
}, 1000);

if (secondsLeft > 0) countdownEl.textContent = formatTime(secondsLeft);

const poll = setInterval(async () => {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/check-deposit/' + tid);
    const d = await r.json();
    if (d.status === 'success') {
      clearInterval(poll); clearInterval(timer);
      document.getElementById('qrisContainer').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('successContainer').style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => location.href = '/mutasi', 3000);
    } else if (d.status === 'expired') {
      clearInterval(poll); clearInterval(timer);
      showExpired(d);
    } else if (d.status === 'failed') {
      clearInterval(poll); clearInterval(timer);
      location.href = '/deposit';
    }
  } catch (_) {}
}, 5000);
<% } %>

    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);
    function pageRange(current, last) {
      const delta = 2;
      const range = [];
      const rangeWithDots = [];
      let l;
      for (let i = 1; i <= last; i++) {
        if (i === 1 || i === last || (i >= current - delta && i <= current + delta)) {
          range.push(i);
        }
      }
      for (const i of range) {
        if (l) {
          if (i - l === 2) rangeWithDots.push(l + 1);
          else if (i - l > 2) rangeWithDots.push('...');
        }
        rangeWithDots.push(i);
        l = i;
      }
      return rangeWithDots;
    }

      const detailUrl = '/mutasi/' + m.id + '?from=' + page;
    %>
    <a href="<%= detailUrl %>" class="mut-item">

      <div class="mut-icon <%= isIn ? 'in' : 'out' %>">

      </div>

</div>

  <%
    /* ─── Pagination logic ─── */
    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);   /* limit wajib = 10 di controller */

    /* Fungsi bantu hasilkan array halaman yang tampil */
    function pageRange(current, last) {
      const delta = 2;
      const range = [];
      const rangeWithDots = [];
      let l;

      for (let i = 1; i <= last; i++) {
        if (i === 1 || i === last || (i >= current - delta && i <= current + delta)) {
          range.push(i);
        }
      }

      for (const i of range) {
        if (l) {
          if (i - l === 2) {
            rangeWithDots.push(l + 1);
          } else if (i - l > 2) {
            rangeWithDots.push('...');
          }
        }
        rangeWithDots.push(i);
        l = i;
      }
      return rangeWithDots;
    }

    const pages = pageRange(page, totalPages);
    const qParam = (typeof q !== 'undefined' && q) ? '&q=' + encodeURIComponent(q) : '';
  %>

  <% if (totalPages > 1) { %>
  <div class="pagination-wrap">

      <a href="/mutasi?page=<%= page - 1 %><%= qParam %>" class="page-btn-nav" title="Halaman sebelumnya">
        <i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i>
      </a>
    <% } else { %>
      <span class="page-btn-nav disabled">
        <i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i>
      </span>
    <% } %>

    <%# Nomor halaman %>
    <div class="page-numbers">
      <% pages.forEach(function(p) { %>
        <% if (p === '...') { %>
          <span class="page-dots">···</span>
        <% } else { %>
          <a href="/mutasi?page=<%= p %><%= qParam %>"
             class="page-num <%= p === page ? 'active' : '' %>">
            <%= p %>
          </a>
        <% } %>
      <% }) %>
    </div>

    <%# Tombol Next %>

<script>
var HARGA_PER_HARI = <%= pricePerDay %>;
var SALDO_USER     = <%= u.saldo %>;

function formatRupiah(n) {
  return 'Rp ' + Math.floor(n).toLocaleString('id-ID');
}

function setDurasi(n) {
  document.getElementById('durasiHari').value = n;
  hitungHarga(n);
}

function hitungHarga(hari) {
  hari = parseInt(hari) || 1;
  if (hari < 1) hari = 1;
  if (hari > 365) { hari = 365; document.getElementById('durasiHari').value = 365; }

  var total = HARGA_PER_HARI * hari;
  var sisa  = SALDO_USER - total;
  var fmt   = formatRupiah(total);

  // Summary
  document.getElementById('summaryPerHari').textContent = formatRupiah(HARGA_PER_HARI);
  document.getElementById('summaryHari').textContent    = hari;
  document.getElementById('summaryTotal').textContent   = fmt;

  var sisaEl = document.getElementById('summarySisa');
  sisaEl.textContent = formatRupiah(Math.max(0, sisa));
  sisaEl.className   = 'summary-val' + (sisa < 0 ? ' warn' : '');

  // Tombol
  var btn     = document.getElementById('btnBeli');
  var btnHarga = document.getElementById('btnHarga');
  if (btnHarga) btnHarga.textContent = fmt;
  if (btn) {
    if (total > SALDO_USER || hari <= 0) {
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times-circle"></i> Saldo Tidak Cukup';
    } else {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-shopping-cart"></i> Beli Sekarang &mdash; <span id="btnHarga">' + fmt + '</span>';
    }
  }

  // Sync active chip
  document.querySelectorAll('.preset-chip').forEach(function(c) {
    var m = c.getAttribute('onclick').match(/\d+/);
    if (m) c.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(m[0]) === hari);
  });
}

function generatePass() {
  var chars = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';
  var pass = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++) pass += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
  document.getElementById('vpnPass').value = pass;
}

// Validasi + loading saat submit
var form = document.getElementById('orderForm');
if (form) {
  form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    var user   = document.getElementById('vpnUser').value.trim();
    var passEl = document.getElementById('vpnPass');

    if (!user || user.length < 4) {
      e.preventDefault();
      alert('Username minimal 4 karakter.');
      return;
    }
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9.]+$/.test(user)) {
      e.preventDefault();
      alert('Username hanya boleh huruf, angka, dan titik.');
      return;
    }
    if (passEl && passEl.value.trim().length < 6) {
      e.preventDefault();
      alert('Password minimal 6 karakter.');
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById('loadingOverlay').classList.add('show');
    document.getElementById('loadingText').textContent = 'Membuat akun VPN, mohon tunggu...';
  });
}

// Init hitung saat load
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { hitungHarga(30); });
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
  function copyAllDetails(btn) {
    try {
      const type = `<%= order.vpn_type %>`;
      const host = `<%= order.vpn_domain || order.server_host %>`;
      const user = `<%= order.vpn_user || '-' %>`;
      const pass = `<%= order.vpn_pass || '-' %>`;
      const uuid = `<%= order.vpn_auth || '-' %>`;

  function copyTrxDetails(btn) {
    try {
      const orderId = `<%= order.order_id %>`;
      const server = `<%= order.package_name || order.server_name %>`;
      const limitIp = `<%= pkg ? pkg.limit_ip : (order.limit_ip || 'Unlimited') %>`;
      const quota = `<%= (pkg && pkg.limit_kuota > 0) ? pkg.limit_kuota + ' GB' : 'Unlimited' %>`;
      const exp = `<%= order.vpn_exp || '-' %>`;
      const type = `<%= order.vpn_type %>`;

      let text = `Detail Informasi Transaksi Anda!\n\n`;
      text += `Kode Trx : ${orderId}\n`;
      text += `Server : ${server}\n`;
      text += `Limit IP : ${limitIp} IP\n`;
      if (type !== 'ssh') {
      text += `Limit Kuota : ${quota}\n`;
      }
      text += `Expired : ${exp}\n\n`;
      text += `"Support perpanjang akun h-1 sebelum tanggal expired"\n\n`;
      text += `Penting : simpan detail transaksi ini untuk claim garansi akun, gunakan sesui limit yang berlaku, jika melebihi batas yang ditentukan akun akan dihapus tanpa pemberitahuan tanpa refund!`;

      const el = document.createElement('textarea');
      el.value = text;
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      el.select();
      document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(el);

      const oldHtml = btn.innerHTML;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check"></i> Tersalin!';
      btn.style.background = '#059669';
      btn.disabled = true;

      setTimeout(() => {
        btn.innerHTML = oldHtml;
        btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0d9488, #06b6d4)';
        btn.disabled = false;
      }, 2000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Copy failed', err);
      alert('Gagal menyalin informasi transaksi');
    }
  }

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
const HARGA_PER_HARI = <%= pricePerDay %>;
const SALDO_USER     = <%= u.saldo %>;
const BASE_DATE      = new Date('<%= baseDate.toISOString() %>');

function formatRupiah(n) {
  return 'Rp ' + Math.floor(n).toLocaleString('id-ID');
}

function formatTanggal(d) {
  return d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day:'2-digit', month:'long', year:'numeric' });
}

function setDurasi(n) {
  document.getElementById('inputDurasi').value = n;
  updateAll();
  // update active chip
  document.querySelectorAll('.preset-chip').forEach(function(c) {
    c.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(c.getAttribute('onclick').match(/\d+/)[0]) === n);
  });
}

function updateAll() {
  var hari = parseInt(document.getElementById('inputDurasi').value) || 0;
  if (hari > 365) { hari = 365; document.getElementById('inputDurasi').value = 365; }

  var total = hari * HARGA_PER_HARI;
  var sisa  = SALDO_USER - total;

  // Summary box
  document.getElementById('summaryPerHari').textContent = formatRupiah(HARGA_PER_HARI);
  document.getElementById('summaryHari').textContent    = hari;
  document.getElementById('summaryTotal').textContent   = formatRupiah(total);

  var sisaEl = document.getElementById('summarySisa');
  sisaEl.textContent = formatRupiah(Math.max(0, sisa));
  sisaEl.className   = 'summary-val' + (sisa < 0 ? ' warn' : '');

  // Tanggal expired baru
  var newDate = new Date(BASE_DATE);
  newDate.setDate(newDate.getDate() + hari);
  var fmtDate = hari > 0 ? formatTanggal(newDate) : '-';

  document.getElementById('newExpText').textContent      = fmtDate;
  document.getElementById('newExpDateSmall').textContent = fmtDate;
  document.getElementById('barDurationText').textContent = hari;

  // Tombol submit
  var btn = document.getElementById('btnSubmit');
  if (btn) {
    var btnHarga = document.getElementById('btnHarga');
    if (btnHarga) btnHarga.textContent = formatRupiah(total);

    if (total > SALDO_USER || hari <= 0) {
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-times-circle"></i> Saldo Tidak Cukup';
    } else {
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-sync-alt"></i> Konfirmasi Perpanjang &mdash; <span id="btnHarga">' + formatRupiah(total) + '</span>';
    }
  }

  // Sync active chip
  document.querySelectorAll('.preset-chip').forEach(function(c) {
    var match = c.getAttribute('onclick').match(/\d+/);
    if (match) c.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(match[0]) === hari);
  });
}

document.getElementById('inputDurasi').addEventListener('input', updateAll);
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', updateAll);

document.getElementById('renewForm').addEventListener('submit', function() {
  document.getElementById('loadingOverlay').style.display = 'flex';
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
var serverError   = <%= error   ? 'true' : 'false' %>;
var serverSuccess = <%= success ? 'true' : 'false' %>;

function showLogout()  { document.getElementById('logoutModal').classList.add('show'); }
function closeLogout() { document.getElementById('logoutModal').classList.remove('show'); }
document.getElementById('logoutModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeLogout();
});

<% if (u.password) { %>
document.getElementById('settingsForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
  if (serverError || serverSuccess) return;
  var old = document.getElementById('old_password').value.trim();
  var nw  = document.getElementById('new_password').value.trim();
  var cfm = document.getElementById('confirm_password').value.trim();
  var alertBox  = document.getElementById('formAlert');
  var alertText = document.getElementById('formAlertText');
  alertBox.style.display = 'none';
  if (!old && !nw && !cfm) {
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    alertText.textContent = 'Silakan isi semua kolom password terlebih dahulu.';
    alertBox.style.display = 'flex';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    return false;
  }
  if (!old || !nw || !cfm) {
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    alertText.textContent = 'Semua kolom password harus diisi.';
    alertBox.style.display = 'flex';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    return false;
  }
  document.getElementById('loadingOverlay').classList.add('show');
  document.getElementById('loadingText').textContent = 'Menyimpan perubahan...';
});
<% } %>
</script>

<script>
function showLogout(){document.getElementById('logoutModal').classList.add('show');}
function closeLogout(){document.getElementById('logoutModal').classList.remove('show');}
document.getElementById('logoutModal').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===e.currentTarget)closeLogout();});

function toggleCard(id){document.getElementById('card-'+id).classList.toggle('open');}

function onKuotaSubmit(){
  const btn=document.getElementById('btn-cek-kuota');
  btn.classList.add('loading');btn.disabled=true;
}

(function(){
  const pre=document.getElementById('kuota-result-text');
  if(!pre)return;
  const raw=pre.textContent;
  const body=document.getElementById('kuota-parsed-body');
  if(!body)return;
  function ext(label){
    const esc=label.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&');
    const m=raw.match(new RegExp(esc+'[:\\s]+([^\\n]+)'));
    return m?m[1].trim():null;
  }
  const fields=[
    {k:'Nomor',     v:ext('📱 Nomor'),    e:'📱'},
    {k:'Tipe Kartu',v:ext('💳 Tipe Kartu'),e:'💳'},
    {k:'Status 4G', v:ext('📶 Status 4G'), e:'📶'},
    {k:'Dukcapil',  v:ext('🧾 Status Dukcapil'),e:'🧾'},
    {k:'Masa Aktif',v:ext('📆 Masa Aktif'),e:'📆'},
    {k:'Tenggang',  v:ext('⛔ Akhir Tenggang'),e:'⛔'},
  ];
  const pakets=[];
  const pRe=/🗂️ Paket (\d+): ([^\n]+)\n⏳ Aktif Hingga: ([^\n]+)\n🎁 Benefit:\n([\s\S]*?)(?=🗂️ Paket|$)/g;
  let pm;
  while((pm=pRe.exec(raw))!==null){
    const bRaw=pm[4];
    const benefits=[];
    const bRe=/🔹 ([^\n]+)\n\s*Sisa:\s*([^\n]+)/g;
    let bm;
    while((bm=bRe.exec(bRaw))!==null){
      const name=bm[1].trim();
      const full=bm[2].trim();
      const pctM=full.match(/\(([0-9.]+)%\)/);
      const pct=pctM?parseFloat(pctM[1]):null;
      const stripped=full.replace(/\s*\([^)]*%[^)]*\)\s*$/,'').trim();
      const parts=stripped.split(/\s*\/\s*/);
      benefits.push({name,sisa:parts[0]||'',total:parts[1]||'',pct});
    }
    pakets.push({num:pm[1],nama:pm[2],aktif:pm[3],benefits});
  }
  let html='<div class="kuota-info-grid">';
  fields.forEach(f=>{
    html+=`<div class="kuota-info-item"><div class="kuota-info-key">${f.k}</div><div class="kuota-info-val">${f.e} ${f.v||'-'}</div></div>`;
  });
  html+='</div>';
  if(pakets.length){
    html+='<div class="paket-list">';
    pakets.forEach(p=>{
      html+=`<div class="paket-card"><div class="paket-card-header">
        <div class="paket-num">${p.num}</div>
        <div class="paket-name">${p.nama}</div>
        <div class="paket-aktif-badge">${p.aktif}</div>
      </div><div class="paket-body">`;
      if(p.benefits.length){
        p.benefits.forEach(b=>{
          const pct=b.pct!==null?b.pct:0;
          const low=pct<20;
          const pc=low?'#ef4444':'#0d9488';
          const pbg=low?'rgba(239,68,68,.1)':'rgba(13,148,136,.1)';
          html+=`<div class="benefit-item">
            <div class="benefit-dot" style="${low?'background:#ef4444':''}"></div>
            <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
              <div class="benefit-name">${b.name}</div>
              <div class="benefit-bar-track">
                <div class="benefit-bar-fill ${low?'low':''}" style="width:${Math.min(pct,100)}%"></div>
              </div>
              <div class="benefit-sisa">
                <span>${b.sisa} / ${b.total}</span>
                <span class="benefit-pct-badge" style="color:${pc};background:${pbg};">${pct.toFixed(2)}%</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>`;
        });
      } else {
        html+='<div style="font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8;">Tidak ada detail benefit.</div>';
      }
      html+='</div></div>';
    });
    html+='</div>';
  }
  const esc=raw.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
  html+=`<div style="display:none"><pre id="kuota-result-text">${esc}</pre></div>`;
  body.innerHTML=html;
})();

let selectedBug=null;
function selectBug(el){
  document.querySelectorAll('.bug-chip').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('selected'));
  el.classList.add('selected');selectedBug=el.dataset.bug;
}

let ymlType='standard',ymlGroup='urltest',ymlMode='redir',ymlRules='norules',ymlBlob=null,ymlFilename='',ymlContent='';
function selectYmlType(el,v){document.querySelectorAll('[data-yml-type]').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('selected'));el.classList.add('selected');ymlType=v;}
function selectYmlGroup(el,v){document.querySelectorAll('[data-yml-group]').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('selected'));el.classList.add('selected');ymlGroup=v;}
function selectYmlMode(el,v){document.querySelectorAll('[data-yml-mode]').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('selected'));el.classList.add('selected');ymlMode=v;}
function selectYmlRules(el,v){document.querySelectorAll('[data-yml-rules]').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('selected'));el.classList.add('selected');ymlRules=v;}
function buildConfigType(){return`${ymlType==='cfm'?'cfm_':''}${ymlRules==='adblock'?'adblock_':''}${ymlGroup}_${ymlMode}`;}

async function convertBug(){
  const link=document.getElementById('bug-link').value.trim();
  hide('bug-result');hide('bug-error');
  if(!link)return showErr('bug','Paste link Xray terlebih dahulu.');
  if(!selectedBug)return showErr('bug','Pilih salah satu bug terlebih dahulu.');
  setLoad('bug',true);
  try{
    const r=await fetch('/tools/convert-bug',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({link,bug:selectedBug})});
    const d=await r.json();
    if(d.success){document.getElementById('bug-result-text').textContent=d.result;show('bug-result');}
    else showErr('bug',d.message||'Gagal convert.');
  }catch(e){showErr('bug','Error: '+e.message);}
  setLoad('bug',false);
}

async function convertYml(){
  const link=document.getElementById('yml-link').value.trim();
  hide('yml-error');hide('yml-success');
  if(!link)return showErr('yml','Paste link Xray terlebih dahulu.');
  if(!/^(vmess|vless|trojan):\/\//.test(link))return showErr('yml','Format tidak valid. Gunakan vmess://, vless://, atau trojan://.');
  setLoad('yml',true);
  try{
    const r=await fetch('/tools/convert-yml',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({link,config_type:buildConfigType(),yml_type:ymlType})});
    const d=await r.json();
    if(d.success){ymlBlob=new Blob([d.content],{type:'text/yaml'});ymlFilename=d.filename;ymlContent=d.content;show('yml-success');}
    else showErr('yml',d.message||'Gagal generate YML.');
  }catch(e){showErr('yml','Error: '+e.message);}
  setLoad('yml',false);
}

document.getElementById('btn-yml-download').addEventListener('click',function(){
  if(!ymlBlob)return;
  const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(ymlBlob);a.download=ymlFilename;a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
});

function copyYml(){
  if(!ymlContent)return;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(ymlContent).then(()=>{
    const btn=document.getElementById('btn-yml-copy');
    if(!btn)return;
    const orig=btn.innerHTML;
    btn.innerHTML='<i class="fas fa-check"></i> Tersalin!';
    btn.style.background='linear-gradient(135deg,#059669,#10b981)';
    setTimeout(()=>{btn.innerHTML=orig;btn.style.background='';},1800);
  }).catch(()=>{
    const ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=ymlContent;
    ta.style.cssText='position:fixed;opacity:0;';document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();document.execCommand('copy');document.body.removeChild(ta);
    const btn=document.getElementById('btn-yml-copy');
    if(!btn)return;
    const orig=btn.innerHTML;
    btn.innerHTML='<i class="fas fa-check"></i> Tersalin!';
    setTimeout(()=>{btn.innerHTML=orig;},1800);
  });
}

async function runIPLookup(){
  const ip=document.getElementById('iplookup-input').value.trim();
  hideDns('iplookup');
  if(!ip)return showDnsErr('iplookup','Masukkan alamat IP terlebih dahulu.');
  setDnsLoad('iplookup',true);
  try{
    const r=await fetch('/tools/iplookup',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({ip})});
    const d=await r.json();
    if(d.success){document.getElementById('iplookup-result-text').textContent=d.message;showDns('iplookup');}
    else showDnsErr('iplookup',d.message||'Tidak ada info untuk IP ini.');

async function detectMyIP(){
  const input=document.getElementById('iplookup-input');
  hideDns('iplookup');
  if(!document.getElementById('card-iplookup').classList.contains('open')){
    document.getElementById('card-iplookup').classList.add('open');
  }
  input.value='Mendeteksi...';
  setDnsLoad('iplookup',true);
  try{
    const res=await fetch('https://api.ipify.org?format=json');
    const data=await res.json();
    if(data.ip){
      input.value=data.ip;
      const r=await fetch('/tools/iplookup',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({ip:data.ip})});
      const d=await r.json();
      if(d.success){document.getElementById('iplookup-result-text').textContent=d.message;showDns('iplookup');}
      else showDnsErr('iplookup',d.message||'Tidak ada info untuk IP ini.');
    } else {
      throw new Error('Gagal mendapatkan IP.');
    }
  }catch(e){
    input.value='';
    showDnsErr('iplookup','Gagal mendeteksi IP: '+e.message);
  }
  setDnsLoad('iplookup',false);
}

function showDns(t){document.getElementById(t+'-result').classList.add('show');}
function hideDns(t){

  document.getElementById(t+'-error').classList.remove('show');
}
function showDnsErr(t,m){
  document.getElementById(t+'-error-text').textContent=m;
  document.getElementById(t+'-error').classList.add('show');
}
function setDnsLoad(t,s){
  document.getElementById(t+'-loading').classList.toggle('show',s);
  const b=document.getElementById('btn-'+t);
  if(b)b.disabled=s;
}

function copyDnsResult(id,btn){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!el)return;
  const orig=btn.innerHTML;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.textContent.trim()).then(()=>{
    btn.innerHTML='<i class="fas fa-check"></i>';

  }).catch(()=>{

    ta.style.cssText='position:fixed;opacity:0;';document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();document.execCommand('copy');document.body.removeChild(ta);
    btn.innerHTML='<i class="fas fa-check"></i>';
    setTimeout(()=>{btn.innerHTML=orig;},1800);
  });
}

function clearDnsInput(t){
  const el=document.getElementById(t+'-input');
  if(!el)return;
  el.value='';
  document.getElementById('clear-'+t)?.classList.remove('visible');
  hideDns(t);
  el.focus();
}

function hide(id){document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');}

  document.getElementById(t+'-loading').classList.toggle('show',s);
  const b=document.getElementById('btn-convert-'+t);if(b)b.disabled=s;
}

function clearInput(inputId,btnClearId){
  const el=document.getElementById(inputId);
  if(!el)return;
  el.value='';
  document.getElementById(btnClearId)?.classList.remove('visible');
  const rd=document.getElementById('kuota-display');if(rd)rd.classList.remove('show');
  el.focus();
}
function clearTextarea(taId,btnClearId){
  const el=document.getElementById(taId);
  if(!el)return;
  el.value='';
  document.getElementById(btnClearId)?.classList.remove('visible');
  if(taId==='bug-link'){hide('bug-result');hide('bug-error');}
  if(taId==='yml-link'){hide('yml-success');hide('yml-error');}
  el.focus();
}

(function(){
  const pairs=[
    {inp:'nomor-input',     clear:'clear-nomor'},
    {inp:'bug-link',        clear:'clear-bug'},
    {inp:'yml-link',        clear:'clear-yml'},
    {inp:'whois-input',     clear:'clear-whois'},
    {inp:'subfinder-input', clear:'clear-subfinder'},
    {inp:'hosttoip-input',  clear:'clear-hosttoip'},
    {inp:'iplookup-input',  clear:'clear-iplookup'},
  ];
  pairs.forEach(({inp,clear})=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(inp);
    const bc=document.getElementById(clear);
    if(!el||!bc)return;
    const toggle=()=>bc.classList.toggle('visible',el.value.trim().length>0);
    el.addEventListener('input',toggle);
    el.addEventListener('change',toggle);
    toggle();
  });
})();

function copyText(id){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.textContent.trim()).then(()=>{
    const container=el.closest('.result-success,.result-kuota');
    const btn=container?container.querySelector('.btn-copy-full,.btn-copy-sm'):null;
    if(!btn)return;
    const orig=btn.innerHTML;
    const origBg=btn.style.background;
    btn.innerHTML='<i class="fas fa-check"></i> Tersalin!';
    btn.style.background='linear-gradient(135deg,#059669,#10b981)';
    btn.style.color='#fff';
    btn.style.borderColor='transparent';
    setTimeout(()=>{btn.innerHTML=orig;btn.style.background=origBg;btn.style.color='';btn.style.borderColor='';},1800);
  });
}

    const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / limit);

    function pageRange(current, last) {
      const delta = 2;
      const range = [];
      const rangeWithDots = [];
      let l;
      for (let i = 1; i <= last; i++) {
        if (i === 1 || i === last || (i >= current - delta && i <= current + delta)) {
          range.push(i);
        }
      }
      for (const i of range) {
        if (l) {
          if (i - l === 2) rangeWithDots.push(l + 1);
          else if (i - l > 2) rangeWithDots.push('...');
        }
        rangeWithDots.push(i);
        l = i;
      }
      return rangeWithDots;
    }

    const pages = pageRange(page, totalPages);
  %>

  <% if (totalPages > 1) { %>

        <i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i>
      </a>
    <% } else { %>
      <span class="page-btn-nav disabled"><i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i></span>
    <% } %>

    <div class="page-numbers">
      <% pages.forEach(function(p) { %>
        <% if (p === '...') { %>
          <span class="page-dots">···</span>
        <% } else { %>
          <a href="/topup-history?page=<%= p %>"
             class="page-num <%= p === page ? 'active' : '' %>">
            <%= p %>
          </a>
        <% } %>
      <% }) %>
    </div>

    <% if (page < totalPages) { %>
      <a href="/topup-history?page=<%= page + 1 %>" class="page-btn-nav" title="Halaman berikutnya">
        <i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
      </a>
    <% } else { %>
      <span class="page-btn-nav disabled"><i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i></span>
    <% } %>

    <div class="page-info-text">
      Menampilkan <%= (page - 1) * limit + 1 %>–<%= Math.min(page * limit, total) %> dari <%= total %> transaksi
    </div>

  </div>
  <% } %>

  <% } %>

<script>
function selectServer(el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.server-option').forEach(function(o) {
    o.classList.remove('selected');
  });
  el.classList.add('selected');
  var radio = el.querySelector('input[type="radio"]');
  if (radio) radio.checked = true;
}

document.getElementById('trialForm').addEventListener('submit', function() {
  var btn = document.getElementById('btnSubmit');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm" style="width:16px;height:16px;border-width:2px;" role="status"></span> Membuat akun...';
});
</script>
