<script>
  function copyAllDetails(btn) {
    try {
      const type = `<%= vpnType %>`;
      const host = `<%= data.domain || serverLabel %>`;
      const user = `<%= data.user || '-' %>`;
      const pass = `<%= data.pass || data.auth || '-' %>`;
      const uuid = `<%= data.auth || '-' %>`;
      const exp = `<%= data.exp || '-' %>`;
      const isp = `<%= data.isp || '-' %>`;
      const city = `<%= data.city || '-' %>`;
      const limitIp = `<%= pkg ? pkg.limit_ip : '-' %>`;
      const quota = `<%= (pkg && pkg.limit_kuota > 0) ? pkg.limit_kuota + ' GB' : 'Unlimited' %>`;
      
      let text = `──────────────────────\n`;
      if (type === 'ssh') {
        text += `Status Create SSHWS Success\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ ISP   : ${isp}\n`;
        text += `✧ City  : ${city}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ Host  : ${host}\n`;
        text += `✧ User  : ${user}\n`;
        text += `✧ pw    : ${pass}\n`;
        text += `✧ Max   : Unlimited\n`;
        text += `✧ Port  : 443, 80, 1-65535\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ SSL   : ${host}:443@${user}:${pass}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ WS    : ${host}:80@${user}:${pass}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ UDP   : ${host}:1-65535@${user}:${pass}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
      } else {
        text += `Status Create ${type.toUpperCase()} Success\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ ISP   : ${isp}\n`;
        text += `✧ City  : ${city}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ Host  : ${host}\n`;
        text += `✧ User  : ${user}\n`;
        text += `✧ UUID  : ${uuid}\n`;
        text += `✧ Max   : Unlimited\n`;
        text += `✧ Quota : Unlimited\n`;
        text += `✧ Port  : 443, 80\n`;
        
        let path = '/vmess';
        <% if (vpnType === 'vmess') { %> path = '/vmess'; <% } %>
        <% if (vpnType === 'vless') { %> path = '/vless'; <% } %>
        <% if (vpnType === 'trojan') { %> path = '/trojan'; <% } %>
        
        text += `✧ Path  : ${path}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        <% if (data.tls && data.tls !== '-') { %>
        text += `✧ Tls   : <%= data.tls %>\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        <% } %>
        <% if (data.ntls && data.ntls !== '-' && vpnType !== 'trojan') { %>
        text += `✧ nTls  : <%= data.ntls %>\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        <% } %>
        <% if (data.grpc && data.grpc !== '-') { %>
        text += `✧ Grpc  : <%= data.grpc %>\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        <% } %>
      }
      
      text += `✧ Exp   : ${exp}\n`;
      text += `──────────────────────\n`;

      const el = document.createElement('textarea');
      el.value = text;
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      el.select();
      document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(el);
      
      const oldHtml = btn.innerHTML;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check"></i> Tersalin!';
      btn.style.background = '#059669';
      btn.disabled = true;

      setTimeout(() => {
        btn.innerHTML = oldHtml;
        btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7, #0369a1)';
        btn.disabled = false;
      }, 2000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Copy failed', err);
      alert('Gagal menyalin detail akun');
    }
  }
</script>

<script>
  function copyAllDetails(btn) {
    try {
      const type = `<%= trial.vpn_type %>`;
      const host = `<%= vpnDomain || displayServerLabel %>`;
      const user = `<%= trial.vpn_user || '-' %>`;
      const pass = `<%= (trial.vpn_type === 'ssh') ? vpnAuth : '-' %>`;
      const uuid = `<%= vpnAuth || '-' %>`;
      const exp = `<%= trial.vpn_exp || '-' %>`;
      const isp = `<%= vpnIsp || '-' %>`;
      const city = `<%= vpnCity || '-' %>`;
      const limitIp = `Unlimited`;
      const quota = `Unlimited`;
      
      let text = `──────────────────────\n`;
      if (type === 'ssh') {
        text += `Status Create SSHWS Success\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ ISP   : ${isp}\n`;
        text += `✧ City  : ${city}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ Host  : ${host}\n`;
        text += `✧ User  : ${user}\n`;
        text += `✧ pw    : ${pass}\n`;
        text += `✧ Max   : ${limitIp}\n`;
        text += `✧ Port  : 443, 80, 1-65535\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ SSL   : ${host}:443@${user}:${pass}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ WS    : ${host}:80@${user}:${pass}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ UDP   : ${host}:1-65535@${user}:${pass}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
      } else {
        text += `Status Create ${type.toUpperCase()} Success\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ ISP   : ${isp}\n`;
        text += `✧ City  : ${city}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        text += `✧ Host  : ${host}\n`;
        text += `✧ User  : ${user}\n`;
        text += `✧ UUID  : ${uuid}\n`;
        text += `✧ Max   : ${limitIp}\n`;
        text += `✧ Quota : ${quota}\n`;
        text += `✧ Port  : 443, 80\n`;
        
        let vpnPath = '/vmess';
        if (type === 'vmess') vpnPath = '/vmess';
        else if (type === 'vless') vpnPath = '/vless';
        else if (type === 'trojan') vpnPath = '/trojan';
        
        text += `✧ Path  : ${vpnPath}\n`;
        text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        
        const tls = `<%= (vpnTls && vpnTls !== '-') ? vpnTls : '' %>`;
        const ntls = `<%= (vpnNtls && vpnNtls !== '-' && trial.vpn_type !== 'trojan') ? vpnNtls : '' %>`;
        const grpc = `<%= (vpnGrpc && vpnGrpc !== '-') ? vpnGrpc : '' %>`;
        
        if (tls) {
          text += `✧ Tls   : ${tls}\n`;
          text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        }
        if (ntls) {
          text += `✧ nTls  : ${ntls}\n`;
          text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        }
        if (grpc) {
          text += `✧ Grpc  : ${grpc}\n`;
          text += `──────────────────────\n`;
        }
      }
      
      text += `✧ Exp   : ${exp}\n`;
      text += `──────────────────────\n`;

      const el = document.createElement('textarea');
      el.value = text;
      document.body.appendChild(el);
      el.select();
      document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(el);
      
      const oldHtml = btn.innerHTML;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check"></i> Tersalin!';
      btn.style.background = '#059669';
      btn.disabled = true;

      setTimeout(() => {
        btn.innerHTML = oldHtml;
        btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7, #0369a1)';
        btn.disabled = false;
      }, 2000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Copy failed', err);
      alert('Gagal menyalin detail akun');
    }
  }
</script>

<script>
/* =====================================================
   LOGOUT
===================================================== */
function showLogout()  { document.getElementById('logoutModal').classList.add('show'); }
function closeLogout() { document.getElementById('logoutModal').classList.remove('show'); }
document.getElementById('logoutModal').addEventListener('click', function(e){ if(e.target===this) closeLogout(); });

/* =====================================================
   HELPER KELAS
===================================================== */
function barCls(v){ return v<60?'bar-g':v<85?'bar-y':'bar-r'; }
function mbCls(v) { return v<60?'mb-green':v<85?'mb-yellow':'mb-red'; }
function pctCls(v){ return v<60?'pct-g':v<85?'pct-y':'pct-r'; }
function pingCls(v){ return v<100?'ic-ping-g':v<300?'ic-ping-y':'ic-ping-r'; }
function pillPingCls(v){ return v<100?'ping-g':v<300?'ping-y':'ping-r'; }

/* =====================================================
   CACHE COUNTDOWN — sinkron dengan server cache 5 menit
   Logika:
   - Parse checkedAt dari server (waktu cache dibuat)
   - Hitung sisa waktu = 5 menit - (sekarang - checkedAt)
   - Countdown mundur dari sisa itu, update setiap detik
   - Saat countdown = 0, fetch /api/uptime-stats lalu reset
===================================================== */
const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 menit ms

/* Parse "31/3/2026, 12.34.56" format id-ID */
function parseCheckedAt(str) {
  if (!str) return new Date();
  // Format: "31/3/2026, 12.34.56" atau "31/03/2026 12.34.56"
  try {
    // Coba parse langsung
    var d = new Date(str);
    if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) return d;
    // Format manual: DD/MM/YYYY, HH.MM.SS
    var m = str.match(/(\d+)\/(\d+)\/(\d+)[,\s]+(\d+)[.:](\d+)[.:](\d+)/);
    if (m) {
      return new Date(
        parseInt(m[3]), parseInt(m[2])-1, parseInt(m[1]),
        parseInt(m[4]), parseInt(m[5]), parseInt(m[6])
      );
    }
  } catch(e) {}
  return new Date();
}

var checkedAtStr = '<%= checkedAt %>';
var cacheCreatedAt = parseCheckedAt(checkedAtStr);
var countdownInterval = null;

function formatCountdown(ms) {
  if (ms <= 0) return '00:00';
  var totalSec = Math.ceil(ms / 1000);
  var min = Math.floor(totalSec / 60);
  var sec = totalSec % 60;
  return (min < 10 ? '0' : '') + min + ':' + (sec < 10 ? '0' : '') + sec;
}

function updateCountdown() {
  var now = Date.now();
  var elapsed = now - cacheCreatedAt.getTime();
  var remaining = CACHE_TTL - elapsed;
  var progress = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (remaining / CACHE_TTL) * 100));

  var fillEl = document.getElementById('cacheProgressFill');
  var textEl = document.getElementById('countdownText');
  var hintEl = document.getElementById('cacheHint');

  if (remaining <= 0) {
    // Waktu habis — fetch data baru
    if (fillEl) fillEl.style.width = '0%';
    if (textEl) textEl.textContent = '00:00';
    if (hintEl) { hintEl.textContent = 'Memperbarui data...'; hintEl.classList.add('refreshing'); }
    clearInterval(countdownInterval);
    doAutoRefresh();
    return;
  }

  if (fillEl) fillEl.style.width = progress.toFixed(1) + '%';
  if (textEl) textEl.textContent = formatCountdown(remaining);

  // Warna progress bar
  if (fillEl) {
    if (progress > 50) {
      fillEl.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg,#0d9488,#06b6d4)';
    } else if (progress > 20) {
      fillEl.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg,#f59e0b,#fbbf24)';
    } else {
      fillEl.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg,#ef4444,#f87171)';
    }
  }

  if (hintEl) {
    var minLeft = Math.ceil(remaining / 60000);
    if (remaining < 30000) {
      hintEl.textContent = 'Sebentar lagi data akan diperbarui...';
      hintEl.classList.add('refreshing');
    } else {
      hintEl.textContent = 'Data diperbarui otomatis setiap 5 menit';
      hintEl.classList.remove('refreshing');
    }
  }
}

function startCountdown() {
  clearInterval(countdownInterval);
  updateCountdown();
  countdownInterval = setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
}

/* =====================================================
   PAGINASI
===================================================== */
const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 3;
let currentPage = 1;

function renderPagination() {
  const container = document.getElementById('srvCards');
  const pagWrapper = document.getElementById('paginationContainer');
  if (!container || !pagWrapper) return;

  const cards = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('.srv-card'));
  if (cards.length === 0) {
    pagWrapper.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(cards.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
  if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;
  if (currentPage < 1) currentPage = 1;

  // Show/hide cards
  cards.forEach((card, idx) => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
    const end = start + ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
    if (idx >= start && idx < end) {
      card.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      card.style.display = 'none';
    }
  });

  // Render buttons
  if (totalPages <= 1) {
    pagWrapper.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  let html = `<div class="pagination-wrap">`;
  
  // Prev
  html += `<button class="btn-pag" ${currentPage === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="changePage(${currentPage - 1})">
    <i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i>
  </button>`;

  // Numbers
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    if (totalPages > 5 && i !== 1 && i !== totalPages && Math.abs(i - currentPage) > 1) {
      if (!html.endsWith('<span>...</span>')) {
        html += `<span style="color:#94a3b8;font-weight:800;padding:0 4px;">...</span>`;
      }
      continue;
    }
    html += `<button class="btn-pag ${i === currentPage ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="changePage(${i})">${i}</button>`;
  }

  // Next
  html += `<button class="btn-pag" ${currentPage === totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="changePage(${currentPage + 1})">
    <i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
  </button>`;

  html += `</div>`;
  pagWrapper.innerHTML = html;
}

function changePage(p) {
  currentPage = p;
  localStorage.setItem('uptime_currentPage', p);
  renderPagination();
  
  const label = document.querySelector('.section-label');
  if (label) {
    const yOffset = -15; // Jarak aman agar tidak terlalu mepet ke atas
    const y = label.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset + yOffset;
    window.scrollTo({ top: y, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }
}

// Initial call
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  let savedPage = localStorage.getItem('uptime_currentPage');
  if (savedPage) currentPage = parseInt(savedPage);
  renderPagination();
});

/* =====================================================
   AUTO REFRESH — fetch data, update DOM tanpa reload
===================================================== */
async function doAutoRefresh() {
  var overlay = document.getElementById('refreshOverlay');
  if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('show');

  try {
    var res  = await fetch('/api/uptime-stats');
    var json = await res.json();

    // Update checkedAt & restart countdown
    var newCheckedAt = json.checkedAt;
    cacheCreatedAt = parseCheckedAt(newCheckedAt);
    var lcEl = document.getElementById('lastCheckTime');
    if (lcEl) lcEl.textContent = newCheckedAt;

    // Hitung ulang summary
    var onlineCount  = json.stats.filter(function(s){ return s.status === 'online'; }).length;
    var offlineCount = json.stats.filter(function(s){ return s.status === 'offline'; }).length;
    var pings        = json.stats.filter(function(s){ return s.ping !== null && s.ping !== undefined; }).map(function(s){ return s.ping; });
    var avgPing      = pings.length ? Math.round(pings.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0) / pings.length) : 0;

    var hoEl = document.getElementById('heroOnline');
    var hfEl = document.getElementById('heroOffline');
    var hpEl = document.getElementById('heroAvgPing');
    if (hoEl) hoEl.textContent = onlineCount;
    if (hfEl) hfEl.textContent = offlineCount;
    if (hpEl) hpEl.innerHTML = avgPing + '<span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0;">ms</span>';

    // Update tiap card
    json.stats.forEach(function(srv) {
      var key  = srv.server_host.replace(/[.:]/g,'-');
      var card = document.getElementById('card-' + key);
      if (!card) return;

      card.classList.add('refreshing-card');
      setTimeout(function(){ card.classList.remove('refreshing-card'); }, 400);

      /* Badge status */
      var badge = card.querySelector('.badge-status');
      if (badge) {
        badge.className = 'badge-status badge-' + srv.status;
        badge.innerHTML = '<span class="badge-dot"></span>' + (srv.status === 'online' ? 'Online' : 'Offline');
      }

      if (srv.status !== 'online') return;

      /* CPU badge (metric-badge pertama) */
      var allBadges = card.querySelectorAll('.metric-badge');
      if (allBadges[0]) {
        allBadges[0].textContent = srv.cpu + '% avg';
        allBadges[0].className = 'metric-badge ' + mbCls(srv.cpu);
      }

      /* RAM badge */
      if (allBadges[1]) {
        allBadges[1].textContent = srv.mem_percent + '%';
        allBadges[1].className = 'metric-badge ' + mbCls(srv.mem_percent);
      }

      /* Disk badge */
      if (allBadges[2]) {
        allBadges[2].textContent = srv.disk_percent + '%';
        allBadges[2].className = 'metric-badge ' + mbCls(srv.disk_percent);
      }

      /* Ping pill */
      var pills = card.querySelectorAll('.pill');
      if (pills[0]) {
        pills[0].className = 'pill ' + pillPingCls(srv.ping);
        pills[0].innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> ' + srv.ping + 'ms';
      }

      /* Progress bars: RAM = n-2, Disk = n-1 */
      var fills = card.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill');
      var n = fills.length;
      if (n >= 2) {
        fills[n-2].style.width = srv.mem_percent + '%';
        fills[n-2].className   = 'bar-fill ' + barCls(srv.mem_percent);
        fills[n-1].style.width = srv.disk_percent + '%';
        fills[n-1].className   = 'bar-fill ' + barCls(srv.disk_percent);
        if (n === 3) {
          fills[0].style.width = srv.cpu + '%';
          fills[0].className   = 'bar-fill ' + barCls(srv.cpu);
        }
      }
    });

    // Restart countdown dari awal (cache baru)
    var hintEl = document.getElementById('cacheHint');
    if (hintEl) { hintEl.textContent = 'Data diperbarui otomatis setiap 5 menit'; hintEl.classList.remove('refreshing'); }
    window.location.reload();

  } catch(e) {
    console.error('Auto refresh error:', e);
    var hintEl = document.getElementById('cacheHint');
    if (hintEl) { hintEl.textContent = 'Gagal memperbarui, mencoba lagi...'; }
    // Coba lagi 30 detik kemudian
    cacheCreatedAt = new Date(Date.now() - CACHE_TTL + 30000);
    startCountdown();
  }

  var overlay = document.getElementById('refreshOverlay');
  if (overlay) {
    setTimeout(function(){ overlay.classList.remove('show'); }, 1500);
  }
}

/* =====================================================
   INIT — jalankan countdown saat halaman dimuat
===================================================== */
startCountdown();
</script>
</body>
</html>
